**Quest Type:** Task
**Group Size:** Solo
**Min. # of Players:** 1
**Max. # of Players:** 1

Anniversary events tend to run from mid-March to mid-April (sometimes to mid-May) each year. They are not available during the "off season".
For an overview and list of EverQuest Anniversary events, see this quest entry [quest=6782].
This is an anniversary quest available only during anniversary season (a few weeks during March and April). It was introduced in 2009 as part of EverQuest's 10th anniversary.
This is one of 16 deity quests. For an overview of how rewards work and how these quests are linked with one another, see this writeup [quest=4843].
Below here are the details for this particular quest.
This task begins with the Avatar of Cazic Thule, in front of the Cazic Thule zone.
You say, 'Hail, Avatar of Cazic Thule'
Avatar of Cazic Thule says 'Encountering me should fill you with fear, mortal, and yet you stand there, nonplussed. Perhaps you are one of those few who do not recoil from the sight of me? If that is [true] then perhaps I can have your service for a time.'
You say, 'It's true'
Avatar of Cazic Thule says 'All the gods are returning to Norrath, seeking fresh worshippers to aid them in their various purposes. Of course, my misshapen and frightening form does nothing to attract the appeal of the masses. I must operate in a different way. To extend my power, I require worship; to worship me, a being must embrace their fears and the ruin of all feelings of hope and joy and security. This both feeds me with worshipful energies and brings balance to all things. Do you not [see]?'
You say, 'I see'
Avatar of Cazic Thule says 'Many gods seek to inflate the fortunes of their chosen among the mortals; these are the ones who are the obvious recipients of thousands of happy new worshippers, year after idle year, thinking that their relationships with the friendlier gods of the pantheon are of singular importance in the grand scheme of things. They are wrong, for can there be hope without fear? Extinguish fear, and hope becomes an unwanted orphan. Mortals would grow lazy and brood over nothing, considering little, and [doing] even less.'
You say, 'Doing less?'
Avatar of Cazic Thule says 'With more worshippers, I could remedy this imbalance before it gets out of hand. To do this, I would have you endeavor to bring nightmares of hopelessness and fear to the world, and not relent until the task is complete. Will you [offer] me your allegiance in such a pact?'
You say, 'I suppose I'll offer my allegiance'
Avatar of Cazic Thule says 'You are willing; that is good. Go and seek out the counsel of Pirex Saulen, an arcanist outside the gates of Cabilis, in the ruins of the Field of Bone. He is organizing the tasks I have set before him, and is charged with assigning my worshippers to their duties. Go now and sow the seeds of fear, to return my harvest of terror and misery.'
You have been assigned the task 'A Taste of Fear - Cazic Thule's Favor'.
The god Cazic Thule has return to Norrath to reassert himself in the affairs of Norrathians, and has given you the task of spreading fear and doubt throughout the land.
Speak to Pirex [npc=33146] and learn what may be done in the name of Cazic Thule 0/1 (The Field of Bone)
Loc -2326.15, 2877.90, one of the ruins outside Cabilis - first building on the left as you go towards the city. You can hail while invis.
You say, 'Hail, Pirex Saulen'
Your task 'A Taste of Fear - Cazic Thule's Favor' has been updated.
Pirex Saulen says 'We are tasked with pruning the past, present, and future with fear as our tool. In the past, Lord Antonius Bayle entertains plans of forming a great alliance of the races. In the future, Galayna Idirin and Arthin Guinden plan to marry, and resurrect the hopes of the High Elves. In the present, Ierene Seldon desires to spend her wealth to increase the skills of her sons, and Agar Treebs wishes to become a renowned weapons dealer. Toward these ends, I will give you three different wands of fear, and it will be your job to use the correct wand on the right person, and shatter their hopes and dreams! Will you accept this challenge like a true implement of the gods?'
Obtain the Wand of Dire Doubtfall from Pirex 0/1 (The Field of Bone)
You say, 'Hail, Pirex Saulen'
Your task 'A Taste of Fear - Cazic Thule's Favor' has been updated.
Pirex Saulen says 'This is the Wand of Dire Doubtfall, it will give even the most optimistic person an uncontrollable wave of doubt, which will last long enough to stall their most fervent motive in its tracks.'
Obtain the Wand of Dire Hopecutting from Pirex 0/1 (The Field of Bone)
You say, 'Hail, Pirex Saulen'
Your task 'A Taste of Fear - Cazic Thule's Favor' has been updated.
Pirex Saulen says 'This is the Wand of Dire Hopecutting, this will flay the most earnestly-held hopes from an individual's mind. The victim will feel resolve and faith in their purpose be replaced with senseless despair and loss of will.'
Obtain the Wand of Dire Fearful Unminding from Pirex 0/1 (The Field of Bone)
You say, 'Hail, Pirex Saulen'
Your task 'A Taste of Fear - Cazic Thule's Favor' has been updated.
Pirex Saulen says 'This is the Wand of Dire Fearful Unminding. I tried to conjure up a better name for it, but none seemed to fit. With this little gem, one can instill all manner of irrational fears that can cause the victim to cower in fear at the apparitions falsely tormenting his mind. Know which wand to use on the right person, the best way to know will be to follow their conversation and listen for clues.'
Speak to Galayna Idirin [npc=33147] about her upcoming nuptials 0/1 (Dragonscale Hills)
Location: 1439.93, 1742.13, 241.64, 2nd level of Sisters of Light tower in Dragonscale Hills.
You say, 'Hail, Galayna Idirin'
Your task 'A Taste of Fear - Cazic Thule's Favor' has been updated.
Galayna Idirin says 'Hello. I don't know who you are, but you'll have to leave. My wedding is in a few days, Arthin and I are to be married, our ancient houses will join, and the fortunes of the High Elves will soon improve. There isn't a single doubt in my mind that ours is the right course!'
Use the correct wand to ruin Galayna's wedding plans 0/1 (Dragonscale Hills)
Use the Wand of Dire Doubtfall.
You have shattered the hopes of your victim!
Your task 'A Taste of Fear - Cazic Thule's Favor' has been updated.
Galayna Idirin says 'Perhaps, perhaps the time is not yet right. It may be folly to unite in marriage in such times as these, when Norrath is being flooded with darkness and doubt. I shall not encourage Arthin, but shall wait for him to influence me to the correct decision.'
Galayna Idirin is consumed with overwhelming feelings of doubt.
Use the correct wand to ruin Arthin's [npc=33148] wedding plans 0/1 (Dragonscale Hills)
Location: 1437.98, 1653.09, 241.71, near Galayna. Use the Wand of Dire Doubtfall.
You have shattered the hopes of your victim!
Your task 'A Taste of Fear - Cazic Thule's Favor' has been updated.
Arthin Guinden says 'I once thought Galayna was as willing to embrace a joyful future together with me. Uniting our families would have been very good for elven society. Now, however, I feel doubtful and at an impasse. It wouldn't do to rush into things. So many threats to consider, and so little time for joy awaits us in this world. I will not press her to marry, I will give us both the time to think things through even more.'
Arthin Guinden is consumed with overwhelming feelings of doubt.
Speak to Ierene Seldon [npc=33149] about her plans for her sons 0/1 (Erudin)
She may be found in the Blue Hawks building in Erudin.
You say, 'Hail, Ierene Seldon'
Your task 'A Taste of Fear - Cazic Thule's Favor' has been updated.
Ierene Seldon says 'Well met, stranger. Know that I am planning to spend my savings on tradeskill lessons for my two sons, that they might brighten their fortunes in life. Unless you are one of the tradesmen I summoned to interview with me, I'll have to ask you to go.'
Use the correct wand to alter Ierene's thinking 0/1 (Erudin)
Use the Wand of Hopecutting.
You have shattered the hopes of your victim!
Your task 'A Taste of Fear - Cazic Thule's Favor' has been updated.
Ierene Seldon says 'Oh, blast those miserable boys anyway, they would probably just take the lesson money and spend it away in a bar. The odds of them making it through an apprenticeship are so very uncertain, I'm surprised that I even entertained this idea. I'll take the money and buy some new dresses, and pay a real carpenter to improve my loft.'
Ierene Seldon has had her hopes magically shattered.
Speak to Agar Treebs [npc=33150] regarding his business 0/1 (Commonlands)
Location: -1600.88, -2506.45, inside the tunnel.
You say, 'Hail, Agar Treebs'
Your task 'A Taste of Fear - Cazic Thule's Favor' has been updated.
Agar Treebs says 'Hail, friend! I have just started my business, but you wouldn't know it by the coins in my pocket. I am waiting for my cart and inventory to arrive. I have no fear that I'll not be the wealthiest weapon dealer in Antonica in a few years! A well-armed populace will no doubt bring law and order and safety to these realms!'
Use the correct wand to cause Agar to think twice about his plans 0/1 (Commonlands)
Use the Wand of Fearful Unminding.
You have filled your victim's mind with overwhelming fear and dread.
Your task 'A Taste of Fear - Cazic Thule's Favor' has been updated.

The others see me as stiff new competition, how long until they sabotage me and steal my stock? Wild animals could get in here, and would anyone fight to protect me from them? No, no, I'll be moving on as soon as I can, and forget this crazy dream of becoming a respected merchant.'
Agar Treebs's mind has fallen prey to a wave of unreasoning fear.
Travel through time and speak with Lord Antonius Bayle [npc=31101] regarding his plans for his realm 0/1 (Oceangreen Hills)
Location: 5033.49, -984.66, 167.02, on top of the fortress close to zone-in.
You say, 'Hail, Lord Antonius Bayle'
Your task 'A Taste of Fear - Cazic Thule's Favor' has been updated.
Lord Antonius Bayle says 'Come to help defend Oceangreen, have you? A worthy endeavor. Not only will we build a mighty realm in these lands, but I believe it is within our power to assemble the great races of Norrath into a new empire, stretching from sea to sea! Think of it, with force of arms, wisdom, and magic shall we build a new world, free and proud! As long as I have Captain Callesh and Sephlin of Oceangreen fueling these inspirations, I really feel it is possible. Let not a single doubt enter their minds, or this lofty aim will never be realized!'
Use the correct wand to dissuade Captain Callesh [npc=33151] from his more outlandish plans 0/1 (Oceangreen Hills)
Location: 5120.68, -1015.51, 167.02, just north of Bayle, use the Wand of Dire Doubtfall.
You have shattered the hopes of your victim!
Your task 'A Taste of Fear - Cazic Thule's Favor' has been updated.
Sephlin of Oceangreen says 'Although Lord Bayle's ideas to unite the races of Tunaria into a single entity is both noble and inviting, I begin to have doubts that such things are even feasible. Though I would go anywhere with Lord Bayle, I fear I do not possess the will to encourage him or Captain Callesh any further with these fanciful dreams. We can't ask our people to press themselves that hard; they need to settle down and raise families and embrace a more modest tomorrow.'
Sephlin of Oceangreen is consumed with overwhelming feelings of doubt.
Use the correct wand to prevent Sephlin of Oceangreen [npc=33152] from inspiring Lord Bayle further 0/1 (Oceangreen Hills)
Location: 5101.95, -986.44, 167.02, just north of Bayle, use the Wand of Dire Doubtfall.
You have shattered the hopes of your victim!
Your task 'A Taste of Fear - Cazic Thule's Favor' has been updated.
Captain Callesh says 'Bah, it's preposterous of me to think we could unite all the races for longer than a fortnight, much less as long as it would take to confederate these lands. A fool's endeavor, and I have never been anyone's fool. Nay, I shall stay here, and apply my efforts to helping Lord Bayle build up a single nation, though if anyone could encourage me to reinvigorate our dreams of empire, it would be Sephlin here.'
Captain Callesh is consumed with overwhelming feelings of doubt.
Return to Pirex Saulen [npc=33146] and discuss your success 0/1 (The Field of Bone)
You say, 'Hail, Pirex Saulen'
Your task 'A Taste of Fear - Cazic Thule's Favor' has been updated.
Pirex Saulen says 'Good! You have banished those dangerous hopes and aspirations with good old fashioned doubt and fear. Too much of that hopeful and joyous thought, and we would soon forget our suffering, and discover how easy it is to use our minds and imaginations to reshape our world. Go now and speak with Cazic himself, I shall pray your fate be secure in his keeping.'
Speak with Cazic Thule's avatar [npc=33088] again, and make clear your accomplishments in his name 0/1 (The Feerrott)
You say, 'Hail, Avatar of Cazic Thule'
Your task 'A Taste of Fear - Cazic Thule's Favor' has been updated.
You have successfully completed the task of helping Cazic Thule spread fear and doubt throughout the past, present, and future.
Avatar of Cazic Thule says 'You have done well. At times the more positive developments of mortal life must be prudently smited with applications of fear and misery, for this preserves the natural balance in all things. For your fine service to this aim, I grant you this boon.'

# Healing Touch - Rodcet Nife's Favor

**Level:** 10 | **Maximum Level:** 130 | **Quest Type:** Task | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 10
**Maximum Level:** 130
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** Yes
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Task
**Group Size:** Solo
**Min. # of Players:** 1
**Max. # of Players:** 1

Anniversary events tend to run from mid-March to mid-April (sometimes to mid-May) each year. They are not available during the "off season".
For an overview and list of EverQuest Anniversary events, see this quest entry [quest=6782].
This is an anniversary quest available only during anniversary season (a few weeks during March and April). It was introduced in 2009 as part of EverQuest's 10th anniversary.
This is one of 16 deity quests. For an overview of how rewards work and how these quests are linked with one another, see this writeup [quest=4843].
Helera Garet is located in North Qeynos near the PoK book at /waypoint 000 .
You say, 'Hail, Helera Garet'
Helera Garet says 'Greetings _____. I am Helera Garet, a humble priestess of Rodcet Nife. Unlike some of the more fanatical members of my order over in the Temple of Life, who shun evil beings outright, I [view] things differently.'
You say, 'View?'
Helera Garet says 'The way I look at it, Norrath is a dangerous world, and whether you're a high elf or an orc, you cannot deny the power of Rodcet Nife. For without his wonderful gift of healing, many expeditions would have no doubt been cut short. It is because this force is so vital that Rodcet Nife could not visit in person, and must continue his unending vigil to heal the [wounded].'
You say, 'Wounded?'
Helera Garet says 'As I mentioned before, Norrath is a dangerous place, and as such, many creatures have become injured while fighting for survival. If you have a moment, I would like to ask a [favor] of you. It is a minor task, but it will show your appreciation for what Rodcet Nife and the wonderful healers of Norrath do on a daily basis.'
You say, 'Favor?'
You have been assigned the task 'Healing Touch - Rodcet Nife's Favor'.
Helera Garet says 'Thank you for undertaking this task. I shall entrust you with this item, which has the power to heal injured creatures. Please help them and return to me when you're done.'
Upon healing these NPCs, they turn into stronger versions of themselves, still non-aggressive. Use the Minor Trinket of Rodcet Nife given to you, to complete the following steps:
- Heal an injured rat - Qeynos Hills
Found it roaming the hills around the middle of the zone.
Turns into a mighty rat.
- Heal an injured skunk - Butcherblock Mountains
Found in the eastern region near the Greater Faydark.
Turns into a stinky skunk.
- Heal an injured drixie - Lesser Faydark
Looks like a fae drake. Found it at /waypoint -817, -872 .
Turns into a carefree drixie.
- Heal an injured drake - Crescent Reach
It is a red drake in the newbie area below the alligator pond.
Turns into a majestic drake.
- Heal an injured kodiak - Commonlands
Found it roaming hills in the middle of the zone.
Turns into a ferocious kodiak.
- Heal an injured coyote - North Ro
Found it around the inn closest to Freeport (Inn 1).
Turns into a feral coyote.
- Heal an injured rockhopper - Marus Seru
Found it in the northwestern corner of the zone.
Turns into a stout rockhopper.
- Heal an injured snake - Nedaria's Landing
Found it on a hill a bit away from the Magus.
Turns into a slithering snake.
- Heal an injured alligator - Innothule Swamp
Found it just south of the PoK book around /waypoint -580, -240 .
Turns into a wild alligator.
- Heal an injured scorpion - Field of Bone
Found it just outside the ruins leading to Kaesora, at /waypoint -2060, +362 .
Turns into an envenomed scorpion.
Upon completion:
Helera Garet thanks you for your assistance, and as she hands you your reward, a sudden surge of vitality empowers you. No doubt Rodcet Nife smiles upon your actions today.
- Celebratory Fireworks Caster (Only if this is the first deity task you have completed)
- Fireworks Focus of Rodcet Nife
- Potion of Adventure II
- The choice between seven different distillates (Scaled to the PC level)
- Player Flags (Being able to attune your fireworks to Rodcet Nife)
- Platinum (Varies by level: 1,800 pp at level 82)
- Experience
Submitted by: saroiny ; Revamped by iventheassassinRewards:
- Celebratory Fireworks Caster [item=83318]
- Fireworks Focus of Rodcet Nife [item=83345]
- Potion of Adventure II [item=83316]

Missing message

It is the time of your rebirth. You are no longer a broodling. You are now an apprentice of the dark circle. Your lessons shall begin immediately. Return this note to me. I await within your new home, The Tower of Death. The Harbinger
Harbinger Glosk is located on the 5th floor of the necromancer guild tower in West Cabilis at /waypoint +316, +778, +77 . He stands in front of your new character when it enters Norrath for the first time.

# Warrior Pike #7 (Warlord Mancatcher)

**Level:** 45 | **Maximum Level:** 130 | **Quest Type:** Quest | **Repeatable:** No | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 45
**Maximum Level:** 130
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** No
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Quest
**Group Size:** Solo
**Min. # of Players:** 1
**Max. # of Players:** 1

This is the seventh Warrior's Pike quest.
(How does this quest start? We have two completely different reports.)
1. Find Klok Scaleroot near the Tower of Death in West Cabilis. Hail her and listen to her story about mercenaries outside of Cabilis disrupting the trade. She will ask you to convince War Baron Eator to do something about it.
2. At the end of the sixth Warrior's Pike quest, Vygan mentions going to the War Baron about the welfare of Cabilis.
Either way, go ask the War Baron about the welfare in Cabilis.
You say, 'Hail, Klok Scaleroot'
Klok Scaleroot says 'What's that? Oh, I'm sorry I've been preoccupied with the recent [attacks] as of late.'
You say, 'What attacks?'
Klok Scaleroot says 'You don't know? I thought everyone was aware now. It seems as though, there have been [mercenaries] doing horrible things to the city.'
You say, 'What mercenaries?'
Klok Scaleroot says 'They wear the bands of Xyzith's troop. Unfortunately, War Baron Eator doesn't believe that the situation has gotten this bad. If only someone was able to find a way to [help] show him how bad the issue is.'
You say, 'I will help.'
Klok Scaleroot says 'Will you now? That is good. Bring me the bands and we will take it from there.'
If not where, at least we know what we are looking for.
You have to kill five Iksar Mercenaries in Field of Bone. They are wandering around near the Warsliks Woods zone line. They run very slowly and will stop chasing you quickly - most likely that was done so noobie Iksar aren't getting slaughtered by them.  Each Mercenary can drop one of three different lore bracers. Collect all three and bring them to Klok Scaleroot.
Klok Scaleroot says 'What's this? I see you have the proof that I have been looking for. Take this note and speak to Drill Master Kyg. She is a stubborn one but true to keeping the Legion safe.'
You gain party experience!!
You receive 'Klok Scaleroot's Note'
Upon turning in the note to Drill Master Kyg,
Drill Master Kyg says, 'What's this you have? Hmmm...I knew there were issues brewing by not of this magnitude. The War Baron has seemed preoccupied with [other issues]. These issues may be one in the same.'
You say, 'What other issues?'
Drill Master Kyg says, 'It seems as though a [Warlord] recently brought back news of Xyzith's fate. The War Baron could not understand how Xyzith could turn on his fellow brother so. The War Baron now seeks to find one that can solve this mystery.'
You say, 'Who was the Warlord?'
Drill Master Kyg says, 'The Warlord's name? I believe it was...wait a minute! Why does this concern you? All you need know is that the Warlord is very brave and serves this Legion proudly unlike you! If you wish to prove yourself you'll speak to War Baron Eator regarding his findings and give him this to show your worth.'
Drill Master Kyg gives you a note named Kyg's Approval for the War Baron. Deliver it and he will ask you to find out where Warlord Xyzith went, maybe that way you can find out why he changed in such a way. The War Baron also tells you that Xyzith went out to find a legendary metal that would bring new glory to Cabilis as it could be forged into a powerful weapon.
Find War Baron Eator in East Cabilis. Turn in Kyg's Approval to him.
War Baron Eator says 'Ah, I see you have gained the approval of another. I suppose you are the one I should [share our findings] with then.'
You gain party experience!!
You say, 'Share our findings, this will help.'
War Baron Eator says 'It seems we have no clue as to why Xyzith turned against us. We need you to find where he traveled and get down to the bottom of this mystery. Go speak to Geot. He was the closest to Xyzith. He may remember where Xyzith searched for the legendary metal.'
You say, 'What did I miss? What legendary metal?'
And then say to him, Kyg's Approval
Go and find Warlord Geot in Lake of Ill Omen. He was Xyzith's best friend. Ask him "Who was Xyzith?" and also ask him "Where did Xyzith search for the legendary metal?" Unfortunately Geot has no idea where Xyzith went.
Your next stop are the Mines of Nurga. That's where Xyzith hoped to find the metal but unfortunatley he didn't make it out alive. Kill A Rebellious Goblin, A Victorious Goblin, A Challenging Goblin and A Fearless Goblin. They spawn pretty close to the entrance of Nurga (Frontier Mountain side) and each possess one of Xyzith's belongings: his bracer, shield, badge and broken mancatcher.
For your Nurga map file:
P 844.1221, 2065.6187, -223.9042, 240, 0, 0, 2, challenging_goblin
P 483.8747, 1555.4758, -191.9354, 240, 0, 0, 2, rebellious_goblin
P 968.6270, 1954.7889, -223.9042, 240, 0, 0, 2, fearless_goblin
P 1174.5126, 1367.9830, -175.9354, 240, 0, 0, 2, victorious_goblin
Upon handing the bracer to Warlord Geot:
Warlord Geot says 'This was the bracer of [Xyzith]. . .I can only fear the worst now. Take this satchel with you. It was a gift from Xyzith when I first became a Warlord. Please find the rest of his remains and bring me the filled satchel again.'
He will return the item you showed him and also gives you a satchel called "Geot's Pack". Put the four items you collected in Nurga and combine them to produce Xyzith's Belongings.
Give the Belongings to Warlord Geot:
Warlord Geot says 'I see you have found all of his belongings. If only we could find a way to [communicate] with him again to find out what information he found during his journey.'
You say, 'How can we communicate with him again?'
Warlord Geot says 'That is a good question deserving of an answer. Go seek out members of brood with necromantic origin and see if any of them know how to [speak to the dead].'
Head to West Cabilis and talk to Master Rixiz in the Tower of Death, saying "Can you speak to the dead?":
You say, 'Hail, Master Rixiz'
Master Rixiz says 'You are on the grounds of the Brood of Kotiz. If you do not belong, you must leave at once. There shall be no [third rank skullcap] for you.'
You say, 'Can you speak to the dead?'
Master Rixiz says 'How dare you ask of such a thing! I am a Master of the Necromantic Arts. If you wish to have me conjure this spirit you must first seek out a traitor to our cause. His name is Ixzec. He can be found roaming with a group of renegades in a jungle not far from here. Return with his head and some items from the soul you want summoned and I will aid you in your request.'
Ixzec (called "an Iksar traitor") can be found in the Emerald Jungle. He hangs around at a Forsaken camp at the base of the cliff near the NW corner of the zone. Be careful, he has three friends hanging around there with him. Kill the traitor and loot his head. Bring it to Master Rixiz along with Xyzith's Belongings.
Master Rixiz says 'Ah, this brings me great joy. Now I shall have full control over this fool in his death. As for your request, here is what you asked for. . .'
As you hand Master Rixiz Xyzith's belongings, you can see black smoke begin to arise from the cracks in the floor. In a bright flash of light, the spirit of Xyzith appears in front of you and attacks!
You gain party experience!!
Warlord Xyzith regards you indifferently -- he appears to be quite formidable.
You have slain Warlord Xyzith!
--You have looted a Xyzith's Destroyed Belongings.--
Turn in Xyzith's Destroyed Belongings to Master Rixiz:
Master Rixiz says 'You should return back to your brethren and give them the news of what has happened here young one. To make sure War Baron Eator recognizes the truth I shall give you my seal.'
Receive a Seal of Rixiz, which you need to take to War Baron Eator:
War Baron Eator says 'What is this?! This cannot be true. What has happened to Xyzith to make him so against those he served so proudly? I must get to the bottom of this. I shall however reward you for courage against him. Take this and replace that which you have defeated!'
You receive "Warlord Crown Plans".
Ask Weaponsmith Grugl "How do I forge Warlord Mancatcher?" and follow his instructions. Smithing combines were trivial at 86.
We need all dialogues, faction hits, quest items, quest mobs, additional zones, etc.
- Warlord Mancatcher [item=29726]

**Maximum Level:** 130
**Monster Mission:** No

**Max. # of Players:** 1

After getting Warlord Mancatcher (Warrior Pike #7):
(Starting quest dialogues needed)
Head to Temple of Droga and kill Stone Seer Kaigek (has a PH at -885, -514).
Kaigek drops a Broken Medal. When identified it reads: "Bring us great honor on your mission -Geot"
Head to Warlord Geot in Lake of Ill Omen and give him the Medal.
You say, 'Hail, Warlord Geot'
Warlord Geot says 'Where did you find this?! No matter. This was a present I gave Xyzith when he first left on his final mission. Hmm, it seems as though there is a stone hidden inside of it.'
Warlord Geot says 'Warlord Xyzith may have fallen inside of those mines but that still does not explain his recent actions. Maybe the stone will shed light on this situation. I knew a shaman that practiced the art of alchemy. Maybe she can recall what kind of stone this is. Take this stone and search for her.'
You gain experience!!
He'll find a Black Stone in it and asks you to find someone who knows much about stones.
Head to Timorous Deep and approach the Chessboard where you will find a female Iksar shaman called Izatri (approx. loc. is neg. 6000, 3000). Give her the Black Stone.
You say, 'Hail, Izatri'
Izatri says 'Hello there yourself! If you don't mind I am quite busy here studying the rocks of this region.'
Izatri says 'Where did you find this? Never mind that, it doesn't matter. I hope you didn't have it for long. This stone has the power to drain the soul of the owner. In its pure form it can remove curses from creatures, but the one you have has been used already. In its [dark form] it does far worse.'
You gain experience!!
You say, 'What is it's dark form?'
Izatri says 'Well it slowly poisons the owner's mind eventually killing them. But it doesn't end at that, there's [more].'
You say, 'Tell me more'
Izatri says 'Yes. . .I'm afraid it also traps the soul of the owner in the stone. I cannot perform the ritual any longer but I believe there is another that may be able to. I'm sorry I don't remember where to find him but you can ask around for him if you can't find him. His name is Liyx. Take your stone and find him. You will need it to summon the spirit to finally put him to rest properly.'
She returns the item (a different item of the same name) and asks you to find Hierophant Liyx.
You can find him in Field of Bone due west of the Plane of Knowledge book, approximate location -3000, 2700.
You say, 'Hail, Hierophant Liyx'
Hierophant Liyx says 'Hello. You have caught me before I started another mission. What can I do for you? Do you need my [aid]?'
You say, 'I need your aid'
Hierophant Liyx says 'If that is the case you must know what I specialize in. Bring me the stone, a mirrored gem, and two celestial essences. I will do the rest by helping you set your friend free.'
Bring him the Black Stone, two Celestial Essences and a Mirrored Gem. The Mirorred Gem drops off "a reflective soul" in Emerald Jungle (can be found in one of the northern ruins).
Upon turning in those items:
Hierophant Liyx says 'He is here now. Send him off to the next plane.'
You gain experience!!
Hierophant Liyx summons Warlord Xyzith (skeleton version). He hits for a max ~150. Kill him, loot his spirit, and bring it to War Baron Eator.
Warlord Xyzith regards you indifferently -- looks kind of dangerous.
Hierophant Liyx says, 'Now he is free. Take his essence which is now pure, and return to your Head Master. He will know what to do from here. As for me, I have other errands to tend to.' As Hierophant Liyx finishes his words, he steps into the shadows and departs again.
You have slain Warlord Xyzith!
Upon turning in to War Baron Eator:
War Baron Eator says 'I see you have figured out the issue and ended it as well. The Legion. . .no. . .I owe you much thanks. It is regretful that Xyzith did not come back to us safely but we will all be in good hands with you here. Take these plans for the Pride of the Legion, and protect those as Warlord Xyzith did. Speak to Weaponsmith Gurgl to learn how to make your weapon of great power.'
You gain experience!!
You receive Pride of Legion Plans.
Head to Weaponsmith Grugl to find out how to make the weapon, asking "How do I forge Pride of the Legion?"
You say, 'Hail, Weaponsmith Grugl'
Weaponsmith Grugl sets down a blood-spattered mace. 'Come to assist in the testing of the bashing equipment? Nah. Not you. You are too small. You must be here to practice your forging.'
You say, 'How do I forge the Pride of the Legion?'
Weaponsmith Grugl says 'You must be special indeed to have gained the Baron's prize possession, the Pride of the Legion. To forge Pride of the Legion, a blacksmith of great skill would need a titanium rod, a forge hammer, and an unfinished mancatcher. The unfinished mancatcher is forged with a geozite tool, a blue diamond, Pride of the Legion Plans, and a Warlord's Mancatcher.'
Combine the Plans, Warlord Mancatcher, Geozite Tool and Blue Diamond to receive an Unfinished Mancatcher.
Combine the Unfinished Mancatcher with a Titanium Rod and Forging Hammer to receive the Pride of the Legion.
Combines were trivial at smithing 85.
- Pride of the Legion [item=29722]

# Underfoot Pre-Launch: They Came From Below

**Level:** 50 | **Maximum Level:** 125 | **Quest Type:** Task | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 50
**Maximum Level:** 125
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** Yes
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Task
**Time Limit:** 06:00:00
**Group Size:** Solo
**Min. # of Players:** 1
**Max. # of Players:** 1

This task was a part of the lead-in events to the Underfoot expansion. It is no longer in the game.
This task began with:
- a concerned citizen (in Paineel at +805, +240, +5 -- directly to the right after zoning in and leaving the tunnel)
- Protector of the Ruins (in the Hole)
- Elanna Noraka (near the Paineel pod)
- Surveyor Lodestone (in Corathus Creep at -190, +180: same general area as Cartographer Slipgear)
The task had a six-hour time limit and an 18-hour lockout timer.
Opening with a concerned citizen:
You say, 'Hail, a concerned citizen'
a concerned citizen says 'It is horrible.  Some horrible insect creatures have managed to crawl up from the ruins of Old Paineel.  Can you please [destroy] some for me?  I will compensate you for your actions.'
You say, 'I will destroy them!'
You have been assigned the task 'They Came From Below'.
a concerned citizen says 'Very good.  When you have killed a good amount of them come back to me.  I have heard rumors that others are encountering problems.  I expect that they will reward you as I will if you prefer to talk to them.'
Opening with the Protector:
You say, 'Hail, Protector of the Ruins '
Protector of the Ruins  says 'It is worse than I originally thought.  The Guardian of the Seal has [Fallen].'
You say, 'The guardian has fallen?'
Protector of the Ruins  says 'Yes.  My greatest creation has fallen.  Now these invaders have spread out through much of the lower levels of these ruins.  Some have even managed to escape into Paineel and Toxxulia.  Rumor has even reached me of an incursion in a set of caverns off of Nektulos Forest.  I need you to [assist] me and kill some of the invaders.'
You say, 'I will assist you!'
You have been assigned the task 'They Came From Below'.
Opening with Elanna:
You say, 'Hail, Elanna Noraka'
Elanna Noraka says 'I've never seen anything like it, _____. These [invaders] are breaking through Paineel's defenses and are on the march.'
You say, 'Invaders?'
Elanna Noraka says 'I know not what they are, but they appear to have the physiology of a common insect. My colleagues and I have a [plan] that will play on those details, but we'll need your help to put the plan in action.'
You say, 'A plan?'
Elanna Noraka says 'It's simple: Insecticide. We don't know how effective it will be, but the best we can do is amass a large supply. We, however, need the supplies to make it happen. If you could [gather] the [supplies] we need to make the concoction, we'll be greatly appreciative. Or, if you just want to [kill them] directly, if that's your prerogative, that works, too.'
You say, 'I want to kill them'
Elanna Noraka says 'It is by no means a long-term solution, as the insecticide is, but you might be able to thin the ranks enough to distract them. If you're [up for it], let me know.'
You say, 'I'm up for it'
Elanna Noraka says 'Sounds like a plan. Go ahead and kill a few, then get back to me on your progress.'
You have been assigned the task 'They Came From Below'.
Opening with Surveyor Lodestone:
You say, 'Hail, Surveyor Lodestone'
Surveyor Lodestone says 'Blast it all! I was out surveying and these freakish bug men showed up out of nowhere. Now I can't continue my surveys. Hey, you look tough. Maybe you could [do something] about it?'
You say, 'I will do something'
Surveyor Lodestone says 'I'm glad to hear that! Now go out there and kill as many of those things as you can. You'll find them to the Northwest of here.'
You have been assigned the task 'They Came From Below'.
Task Steps
Kill 40 cliknar invaders 0/40 (ALL)
Task Window Says: Eliminate the Cliknar Invaders.
These creatures are found in multiple areas:
- Bottom of the Hole outside the Underfoot seal
- Toxxulia Forest near the entrance to Paineel and surrounding areas; also around the orc camps
- Paineel (location information needed)
- Corathus Creep (location information needed)
Report your success to one of the four interested people 0/1 (ALL)
Task Window Says: You may return to the individual that gave you this quest, or any of the individuals most involved with recruiting adventurers.
You can finish off the task with one of the four NPCs who give it out.
You say, 'Hail, a concerned citizen'
Your task 'They Came From Below' has been updated.
You have assisted in the elimination of many Cliknar Invaders
You receive 2520 platinum.
a concerned citizen says 'Thanks for clearing out some of those bug men. Maybe now I can get back to my surveying.'
Reward:
2520 Platinum
Flavor Text (before the task was available):
You say, 'Hail, Protector of the Ruins'
Protector of the Ruins says 'Oh No. It is horrible. My creation, the Guardian of the Seal has failed. Something has caused a horrible [earthquake] that has broken through the seal from the Underfoot. I came up here to see if I could think of anything different to do to make it stronger. It is much too dangerous to assist the Guardian. I would not ask that of myself, so I will not ask it of anyone. If you can, keep an eye on things. I expect The Guardian can hold his own, but one can never be too careful.'
You say, 'An earthquake?'
Protector of the Ruins says 'I do not know conclusively where it originates since it has been reported over all of Norrath, and even a few of the planes. But the extent of the earthquake causes me to believe it is from the Underfoot itself.'Rewards:

# Nights of the Dead: Digging Their Graves

**Level:** 1 | **Maximum Level:** 125 | **Quest Type:** Task | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 1
**Maximum Level:** 125
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** Yes
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Task
**Group Size:** Solo
**Min. # of Players:** 1
**Max. # of Players:** 1

This is a shared Halloween task, available only while Halloween events are open. Its purpose is to serve as task updates in a grand task called "The Hunt for Tattooed Flesh [quest=4900]" (you'll be automatically assigned this after completing "Digging Their Graves" the first time).
It begins with Edmund Strangeways in the Plane of Knowledge and has an 18-hour lockout timer.
You say, 'Hail, Edmund Strangeways'
Edmund Strangeways leans on his shovel and peers at you from beneath a wrinkled brow. 'You fool, step carefully! You're disturbing my graves! And aren't you a brash one, running here and there without a care during Harvester's Haunt, oblivious to the [danger] lurking beneath your feet!'
You say, 'What danger?'
Edmund Strangeways says 'This time of year the dead are [restless]. They can't lie still.'
You say, 'Restless?'
Edmund Strangeways says 'I know the dead. I've been putting them in the ground for many [years], and they've taken me to every corner of Norrath. If there's a fire, a plague, a battle, I am there. The dead need burying. But you best bury them deep, for every Harvester's Haunt they toss and turn, yearning to breach the barrier of earth and rejoin the living. It's the right time to [find] them.'
You say, 'Years?'
Edmund Strangeways says 'I've been digging graves since I was but a lad. The disease came swiftly, decimated my village. I buried my friends, my sister, my brother. I buried my father and mother on the hill overlooking our farm. I buried them all, every last one. The village square looked freshly tilled by a herd of oxen, sewn with the seeds of death. The wind in the trees and the rasp of metal was all I heard when I scraped my shovel over the last pile of dirt, packing the soil over the face of the village elder. Not one voice called after me as I walked out of town, carrying my shovel. Somewhere there were more people dying. Somewhere there were more graves to dig.'
You say, 'How can we find them?'
Edmund Strangeways says 'The twitching of the dead churns the soil, and disturbed earth rises. You see a gopher's burrow, I see revealed graves of men long dead and [hidden].'
You say, 'Hidden?'
Edmund Strangeways says 'Ah, made you curious, did I? You may be naive and foolhardy, but I know an adventurer when I see one. I'm old and stiff. . .too many years with the shovel. My legs won't carry me far. But you could go in my stead. You could [bring] me what I [seek].'
You say, 'What do you seek?'
Edmund Strangeways says 'Many corpses have I seen, and many coins have I earned for disposing of them. But money can rot for all I care. I'll be dead soon, and someone will bury me. All that matters is my [collection].'
You say, 'Your collection?'
Edmund Strangeways says 'That ephemeral art that dissolves with a man's flesh--tattoos. Before I cover the dead, I search every inch of their bodies. Such beautiful paintings on rotting canvas. . .I cut them free and preserve them. You should see the [images] that hang on my walls.'
You say, 'Tell me about the images'
Edmund Strangeways says 'A mother, a father, a town, a ship's maiden voyage, a lover's face--things we wish were eternal but know are not. Images of the dead on the skin of the dead, all fading from time and memory. [Bring] them to me, and I'll preserve them.'
You say, 'I'll bring them to you'
Edmund Strangeways says 'Now is the time to find the ancient corpses. Those long dead reveal themselves in the disturbed earth. The art they hide on their bodies hasn't been seen for hundreds of years. Just imagine what beautiful sights and mysteries have been lost from the world all this time. Dig up the corpses and bring me any tattooed skin you find. Here, take my shovel. By the looks of you, I'd say you should head to the Field of Scale or the Loping Plains. The dead there are worth your while. But be careful: restless as they are, the dead don't take kindly to your disturbing their place of slumber. If you forget where to dig, come to me, and I'll remind you.'
You have been assigned the task 'Digging Their Graves'.
NOTE: The zones to which you are directed depend on your level:
- Field of Scale or the Loping Plains (level 85)
- Loping Plains or the Steppes (~75)
- the Steppes or the Buried Sea (~65)
- Barren Coast or Goru`kar Mesa (~55)
- Goru`kar Mesa or Emerald Jungle (~45)
- Emerald Jungle or Firiona Vie (23-32)
- Nektulos Forest or Lake of Ill Omen (1-22)
You receive Edmund's Shovel.
- Loot 1 intricately tattooed skin 0/1 (ALL)
In the zones Edmund mentions, you will find piles of brown rocks called "disturbed earth". You cannot /open or attack them, but you can use the click effect on your shovel. If you do so in a zone you're not supposed to be in, you see:
The graves in this area have nothing of interest to you.
If you use it in a proper zone, either a disturbed spirit or a tattooed zombie spawns. Only the zombie drops the skin, so you may need to go through multiple spawns.

# Nalla's Problem: A Grahzkel Orc Ambush

**Level:** 45 | **Maximum Level:** 125 | **Quest Type:** Quest | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 45
**Maximum Level:** 125
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** Yes
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Quest
**Group Size:** Solo
**Min. # of Players:** 1
**Max. # of Players:** 1

This quest begins with Nalla in the Commonlands. She is found at location 190, -3495, 13 (where the desert turns to grass).
You say, 'Hail, Nalla'
Nalla stops sobbing and looks up at you with a tear-streaked face. 'Oh, hello there, stranger,' she says sofly. 'Please forgive me for being in such a state. I have done something terrible, and my [brother] will surely never forgive m-' She breaks off in another sob.
You say, 'Your brother?'
Nalla sighs and wrings her hands. 'My brother Darrin. He's always been so kind to me. He knew I wanted to go out on an adventure, so he loaned me some of his armor and items.' Her lip quivers as though she is going to cry again. 'But I was ambushed by some [orcs] out here and they took it all! I barely got away!' She bursts into tears. 'What will I tell him?'
You say, 'What orcs?'
Nalla sniffles. 'They called themselves the Clan of Grahzkel, though they didn't seem to be too numerous. They laughed and jeered when I got away, saying they'd be back.' Her eyes dart around for a moment, then she sighs. 'I feel so horrible about those items,' she whispers. 'They were special to my brother because they reminded him of his adventures, but they weren't very strong. So the orcs probably just destroyed them. I wish I could replace them, but I don't know where he found them all.' She sobs again.
You say, 'I will help you'
Nalla stares at you.  'You mean it?  You would really help me?  I'm afraid I would have very little to pay you.  Are you certain about this?'
You say, 'I am certain'
Nalla stops sobbing and smiles.  'This is truly kind of you.  _____, is it?  I never met a _____ so nice as you on my journeys.'  She glances around, picks up a large ornate box, and hands it to you.  'This is the box where he kept it all.  I think I can remember everything, if you are ready?'
You receive a container called "Darrin's Box".
You say, 'I am ready'
Nalla taps her fingers as she thinks.  'Let me see.  Some Dusty Rusted Shackles and Rotbone Sleeves, a Dulled Silver Paineel Earring, a Sebilite Scale Mantle, some Jarsath Scale Boots, a Burnished Wooden Stave, Phase Spider Blood, and... there was one more.'  She purses her lips.  'Oh yes!  A Centi Longsword.'  She shakes her head a bit.  'I wish I could help you with more directions, but I'm afraid he got them all long before I was old enough to go out with him.  I hope you can find them all.'  She smiles again.  'Good luck!  I really can't thank you enough for doing this.'
Your shopping list:
Dusty Rusted Shackles (from golems in Charasis)
Rotbone Sleeves (from skeletons in Charasis)
Dulled Silver Paineel Earring (from undead erudites in the Hole)
Sebilite Scale Mantle (from the froglok ostiary in Sebilis)
Jarsath Scale Boots (from Spectral Turnkey, many PHs in Karnor's Castle basement)
Burnished Wooden Stave (most common from reanimated/undead mobs in Chardok)
Phase Spider Blood (from phase spiders in Dragon Necropolis)
Centi Longsword (from centi in Maiden's Eye and Akheva Ruins)
Combine these items in Darrin's Box to produce "Darrin's Box of Treasures". Hand this to Nalla.
Nalla gasps as she peers inside the box.  'Oh, thank you so much!'  she exclaims.  'I don't know how you could have found it all!'  Suddenly she drops the chest and screams.  'The orcs!  They are back!'
You gain experience!!
Nalla despawns and, for a few minutes, nothing happens. Then "a snarling orc" spawns in her place. He cannot be targetted and despawns after 30 seconds. At this point, "a mean orc" and "a vicious orc" spawn.
a mean orc says 'The Clan of Grahzkel will crush you!'
a vicious orc says 'The Clan of Grahzkel will crush you!'
The mean orc drops a "Bent Sword" (a 3/27 statless 1HS) along with some platinum.
The vicious orc drops a standard newbie weapon, a Cracked Staff and some coin.
After a bit, "an angry orc" spawns and attacks. He drops "Twisted Armor" (unequipable) and change.
Nothing else happens after a 15 minute period, so it is unknown where it goes from here.Submitted by: Arun of Aâ€™Horanos Clan, Antonius BayleRewards:
- Bent Sword [item=55895]
- Twisted Armor [item=56113]

# Anniversary Solo Task: Gifts of Steel

**Level:** 1 | **Maximum Level:** 125 | **Quest Type:** Task | **Repeatable:** No | **Monster Mission:** No

Anniversary events tend to run from mid-March to mid-April (sometimes to mid-May) each year. They are not available during the "off season". Note that the augment rewards are currently flagged as "prestige" items.
For an overview and list of EverQuest Anniversary events, see this quest entry [quest=6782].
This is a task introduced with EverQuest's 11th anniversary (and expected to be available only during anniversary season). There are versions of this task for players of every level.
The tasks are all set up in the same manner:
Deliver 10 (item a) to (npc) 0/10 (Zone)
Deliver 1 (item b) to (npc) 0/1 (Zone)
Speak with (npc) 0/1 (Zone)
In addition to the aug rewards listed below, you also receive experience and a positive faction hit with any of the (useful) factions from the Dragons of Norrath expansion and onward.
You must be at least the required level of the aug in order to request the corresponding task.
The tasks have lockout timers of 18 hours (from the point of request). This lockout is shared among the different level versions.
Level 5 (begins in the Everfrost Peaks)
NPC: Fenworth Iceflinger (near the guards at the entrance to Halas).
10x Coldsteel Ore - from Ice Goblin Orehoarders in Everfrost (roam the valleys between Halas and Blackburrow).
1x Hammer of the Coldforge - from Minotaur Brawlers in the Steamfont Mountains (in the valley outside the minotaur mines leading to the Dragonscale Hills and Loping Plains).
Reward:
Eleventh Shard of Jade
AC: 10
HP: +10 MANA: +10 ENDUR: +10
Recommended level of 5.
Level 15 (begins in South Ro)
NPC: Gnorble Iceflinger (-539, -626, by entrance from Innothule Swamp)
You say, 'Hail, Gnorble Iceflinger'
Gnorble Iceflinger says 'Ah! An adventurer. Just what I need! How would you like to go on a grand [adventure] to collect some items for me?'
You say, 'I would like to go on a grand adventure.'
Gnorble Iceflinger says 'Well, I will be honest. It isn't such a grand adventure, but you would be helping a poor gnome out. I need to collect some [items], but I haven't had much luck finding them.'
You say 'What items?'
Gnorble Iceflinger says ' I seek ten Flameforged Daggers and Ring of the Steel Legions. It is said that the orcish flameforgers in South Ro carry the daggers and the undead ringbearers in Butcherblock sometimes possess the rings. Think you could [find] these items for me?'
You say 'I will find them for you.'
Gnorble Iceflinger says 'You will? Thank you! I need the items to give to my boss, Karl. You see, our anniversary of when we started to work together is coming up soon and he would love to have those items. Good luck with your search. I will be waiting here for your return.'
You have been assigned the task 'Gifts of Steel'.
10x Flameforged Daggers - from Orcish Flameforgers in South Ro (roam in various parts of the zone - no known specific PHs)
1x Ring of the Steel Legions - from Undead Ringbearers in Butcherblock (these are the size of Dwarf skeletons and roam along with them in the zone)

# The Dungeon Rot Infected

**Level:** 1 | **Maximum Level:** 125 | **Quest Type:** Task | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 1
**Maximum Level:** 125
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** Yes
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Task
**Group Size:** Solo
**Min. # of Players:** 1
**Max. # of Players:** 1

This task begins with Skal Nethus [npc=35460] in the Plane of Knowledge. He's an Erudite found at location -320, 1200, -111 (close to Franklin Teek [npc=30481]).
You say, 'Hail, Skal Nethus'
Skal Nethus says 'Come closer! You smell...odd. Yes, have you been crawling around in dungeons? I smell the bacterial spores on your armor. You should be careful: [dungeon rot] will make you unpleasant in ways worse than odor. '
You say, 'Dungeon rot?'
Skal Nethus says 'Adventurers pass through here all the time, wreaking of the stuff. It seems to be spreading through dungeons everywhere. Just last week I was accosted by a putrid, infected halfling. He accused me of wanting to steal his powers. His skin was boiling red, and a cloud of spores billowed about his body. He lifted me above his head and tossed me into a fountain. His [anger] was five times his body size, and I was afraid for my life.'
You say, 'Anger?'
Skal Nethus says 'Creatures infected with Dungeon Rot have augmented [strength] and rage. How else would a halfling overpower someone as large and fit as I? I am not positive, but I think the Rot spreads more easily to creatures with anger running through their veins. That is why I resisted the halfling's infection: I am a naturally calm, composed individual.'
You say, 'Strength?'
Skal Nethus says 'Ah, you know me too well. Yes, my interest in the Rot is not wholly selfless. I would like to find a way to cure adventurers of this blight, but I am sure it would be possible to manipulate the compounds of the disease in order to safely [augment] one's strength. Doubtless, it would be safer than my previous experiments with those [Voidsouls].'
You say, 'How can you safely augment it?'
Skal Nethus says 'Bring me samples of Dungeon Rot from dungeons and caves around Norrath. If I can synthesize the various strains of the disease, a power increase is almost certain...and we can cure any adventurers that are unlucky enough to become infected. Will you [collect] some samples?'
You say, 'I'll collect some'
Skal Nethus says 'Thank you! Look for the stronger creatures in these dungeons. I am sure they are more susceptible to the disease because of their propensity for aggression. But be careful that the Rot does not spread from them to other nearby angry creatures.'
You have been assigned the task 'The Dungeon Rot Infected'.
Search for creatures infected by Dungeon Rot in Upper Guk, Solusek's Eye, the Crystal caverns, Kaesora, Lower Guk, the Howling Stones, the Crypt of Nadox, Ssraeshza Temple, the Bastion of Thunder, the Fortress of Zek, the Vergalid Mines, Zhisza, Toskirakk, and Kaesora Library.
1. Deliver 1 Dungeon Rot Spores of Upper Guk to Skal Nethus 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
2. Deliver 1 Dungeon Rot Spores of Solusek to Skal Nethus 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
3. Deliver 1 Dungeon Rot Spores of Crystal to Skal Nethus 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
4. Deliver 1 Dungeon Rot Spores of Kaesora to Skal Nethus 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
5. Deliver 1 Dungeon Rot Spores of Lower Guk to Skal Nethus 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
6. Deliver 1 Dungeon Rot Spores of Stones to Skal Nethus 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
7. Deliver 1 Dungeon Rot Spores of Nadox to Skal Nethus 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
8. Deliver 1 Dungeon Rot Spores of Ssraeshza to Skal Nethus 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
9. Deliver 1 Dungeon Rot Spores of Thunder to Skal Nethus 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
10. Deliver 1 Dungeon Rot Spores of Zek to Skal Nethus 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
11. Deliver 1 Dungeon Rot Spores of Vergalid to Skal Nethus 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
12. Deliver 1 Dungeon Rot Spores of Zhisza to Skal Nethus 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
13. Deliver 1 Dungeon Rot Spores of Toskirakk to Skal Nethus 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
14. Deliver 1 Dungeon Rot Spores of Kaesora Library to Skal Nethus 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
15. Speak with Skal Nethus 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
You say, 'Hail, Skal Nethus'
Skal Nethus says 'My, this Dungeon Rot is potent! I am surprised you have not come to me with your face like magma and your arms waving in a frenzy. With my extensive knowledge and capabilities, I will extract the strength-giving compounds from the spores...ah, here we go. This substance I have synthesized will grant you power without ill effects. Here, take some of it as compensation for your efforts. Now I must consider whether I can concoct a cure for the blight...'
The above 13 items come from the 13 hot zones added with the December, 8, 2010, patch.
These drops may come from specific mobs or mob types. While fighting them, they'll transform into a Dungeon Rot infected mob and drop the item.
This is a list of confirmed mobs. Please let us know if you have any to add here.

2. Solusek's Eye - gnome miners (note: they give negative Ak`Anon faction); east side of the zone.
3. Crystal Caverns - a stalag terror (bottom of zone, left tunnel); a crystal crawler (near stalags).
4. Kaesora - a skeletal guardian
5. Lower Guk - an urd ghoul wizard; a kor ghoul wizard

9. Bastion of Thunder - a Vann Stav (from the stormrider area, use the southwest port-up to the towers).
10. Tactics - Hendin Shadow Master (found in the halls that lead up to Rallos Zek? above the pit, north).
11. Vergalid - a spawn of Vergalid and a Vergalid Elite both turn into Dungeon Rot mobs; these are past the keyed area just before you get to Vergalid at the bottom of the pit.
12. Zhisza - a Shissar deathmaker inside the pyramid in the north. Possibly other Shissar types inside the pyramid.
13. Toskirakk - Rallosian ogres (certain types?)
14. Kaesora Library - a corrupt defiler; a corrupt warlock

# Frostfell - Gathering Holiday Cheer

**Level:** 10 | **Maximum Level:** 125 | **Quest Type:** Task | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 10
**Maximum Level:** 125
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** Yes
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Task
**Group Size:** Solo
**Min. # of Players:** 1
**Max. # of Players:** 1

This is a seasonal Frostfell task that begins with Kuutas Gigglegibber in the Plane of Knowledge (located next to the Plane of Tranquility portal).
You say, 'Hail, Kuutas Gigglegibber'
Kuutas Gigglegibber says 'Hey, bud. I need to talk to you about something important. There may not be any Frostfell celebrations this year. Ol' Santug has been upset lately about how every time Frostfell rolls around, there are always some evil jokers out there who try to spoil everyone's good time by stealing the kids' toys, kidnapping Santug and holding him for ransom, ransacking and burning someone's village, and so on. Well, Santug has decided he's had enough, and is going to lay off all of us Gigglegibber goblins and just not do Frostfell at all this year. I don't have to tell you, this is not only bad for the Gigglegibbers, but it's bad for you too, if you get my [drift].'
You say, 'I get your drift...'
Kuutas Gigglegibber says 'Yeah. We Gigglegibbers depend on Frostfell for more than just the warm feeling of doing good things for others; it's our only paying gig, see, and Frostfell brings in enough plat for us to stay financially flush the whole year 'round. Of course, if we lost our connection with all that good holiday coin, we'd wind up with lots and lots of idle time on our hands. Time that we could fill with say, acts of petty larceny and hooliganism and whatever other kinds of trouble aimless goblins can get themselves into. You don't want that, and I don't want that. So why don't you help us help Santug; I've got a plan to help Santug get his holiday [cheer] back.'
You say, 'How can we get the cheer back?'
Kuutas Gigglegibber says 'It's difficult, but it just might work. If we don't want Santug to lie in bed drinking himself stupid and feeling like no one on Norrath deserves to have a nice Frostfell, we've got to take some steps to find another source of holiday cheer. There are lots of creatures running around Norrath that are hard to even look at, they're so ridiculously carefree and cheerful. I figure we can harvest the brainstems of these overly happy creatures and distill out a potion of Frostfell Cheer that will wake Santug out of this funk he's in, and get him back into the spirit of things. I've sent out twelve Gigglegibbers into various parts of the world to find these brainstems, but of course, they now send messages back that they need the help of some adventurers to hunt down their prey. Are we in [agreement] that this is the best way to save Frostfell this year?'
You say, 'Of course we're in agreement'
Kuutas Gigglegibber says 'I knew you'd come through for Frostfell. I thank you, and my legion of underpaid Gigglegibber goblins thanks you. If you can get this done for us, bring back the Frostfell Cheer potion and I'll send you on a mission to inject Santug with it. If you've already brought back the syringe, you're ready to [start] the mission.'
You have been assigned the task 'Gathering Holiday Cheer'.
You must help Santug recover his holiday cheer in time to save Frostfell this year! Providing the greatest good for the greatest number means Frostfell must not be cancelled! Unfortunately, the only way to restore Santug's holiday cheer is to create it artificially. Kuutas Gigglegibber in the Plane of Knowledge believes that the brainstems of some of the happier and more cheerful creatures in Norrath and elsewhere may contain the key ingredient for a holiday cheer potion.
You are assigned a task in which you're sent to kill five of a certain mob type in a certain zone and to collect their brainstems. Your kill targets depend on your level.
Kill Targets & Hand-In Mobs
At 10-15: "a cuddly bear" & Skwaath Gigglegibber in Crescent Reach. (Cuddly bears are found in the central part of the Hollows as well as the bear caves, while Skwaath is found at the entrance to the Hollows, just outside the city area.)
At 20-25: "a merry aviak" & Gritt Gigglegibber in South Karana. (Merry aviaks are found in the southern part of the zone by aviak village while Gritt is at -5420, -2705 just outside the hermit's hut.)
At 30-35: "a happy zelniak" & Lokrok Gigglegibber in Dawnshroud Peaks. (Happy zelniaks are found throughout much of the zone among regular zelniaks while Lokrok is in the NPC camp just north of the lake in the southwestern corner of the zone.)
At 40-45: "a cheerful Othmir knave" & Trev Gigglegibber in Cobalt Scar. (Cheerful Othmirs are found all along the beach area while Trev is found in the southwestern part of the beach in the vicinity of -830, 330.)
At 50-55: "a playful corathus" & Uddmut Gigglegibber in Corathus Creep. (Playful corathus are found in the south-central part of the zone while Uddmut is found at -315, 450 in the east-central area.)
At 60: "a frisky chromadrac" & Xerkus Gigglegibber in the Skyfire Mountains. (The frisky chromadracs are found in the southeastern part of the zone while Xerkus is located at the southeastern corner.)
At 65: "a delightful siren" & Yukorg Gigglegibber in the Buried Sea. (Delightful sirens are found on Maiden's Grave (the northwest island) while Yukorg is found in the southwestern part of the same island.)
At 70: "a cheerful unicorn" & Saako Gigglegibber in the Elddar Forest. (Cheerful unicorns are found around the lake in the eastern part of the zone while Saako is found next to the tree zone-in to Tunare's Shrine in the southern part.)
At 75: "a frisky shadowcat" & Baint Gigglegibber in the Dragonscale Hills. (Shadowcats are in the central part of the zone, east of the citadel, while Baint is found in a camp on the north-central boundary of the zone.)
At 80: "a playful sea turtle" & Hurhak Gigglegibber in the Hills of Shade. (Sea turtles are found along the shoreline while Hurhak is found at about 1300, 390 -- a little ways south.)
At 85: "a happy frog" & Gruuk Gigglegibber in the Fungal Forest. (Happy frogs are found in the western part of the zone while Gruuk is found just outside the Pellucid Grotto zoneline.)
At 90 and above: "a convival gorilla" & Dorik Gigglegibber in the high level Feerrott. (Gorillas are in the southeastern part of the zone while Dorik is found outside the Rathe Mountains zoneline.)
Task Steps
Kill five XXXXX in XXXXX 0/5 (XXXXX) (The kill targets listed above.)
Loot five XXXXX in XXXXX 0/5 (XXXXX) (The brainstems of the above kill targets.)
Deliver the five Brainstems to XXXXX in XXXXX 0/5 (XXXXX) (To the hand-in mob, listed above, in the same zone.)
Hail XXXXX 0/1 (XXXXX) (Hail the hand-in mob once turn-ins are done.)
Turn-Ins and Rewards
The Fungal Forest closing, for example:
Gruuk Gigglegibber says "There, very good. You've brought me just the right kind of ingredient I asked for. Soon we'll have that potion for Santug ready."
You say, 'Hail, Gruuk Gigglegibber'
Gruuk Gigglegibber says "I think I have enough to put in the phial now. Presto-ka-zam! Your syringe of Frostfell Cheer. Take this, and ask Kuutas where Santug is hiding so you can inject him with it. Then we won't go hungry three months from now when our gold runs out."
Though it was sad to have to sacrifice so many cheerful creatures for the sake of gathering enough raw materials for a potion remedy, the Gigglegibber goblin successfully distilled enough Frostfell Cheer to fill a syringe for Santug!
You receive a Frostfell Cheer Potion (used in the group mission that follows this task).
Additional Rewards:
Experience

# Anniversary Solo Task: Let's Have Some Fun!

This is a seasonal group task that was introduced at the end of March 2011 as part of April Fool's Day 2011 events. It's expected as available only around April for a relatively short period of time. On progression servers, this quest unlocks during Seeds of Destruction.
It begins with Bobo Gleemaker who can be found next to a tree in the Plane of Knowledge (near the Plane of Tranquility stone).
You say, 'Hail, Bobo Gleemaker'
Bobo Gleemaker says 'What a boring place! How do you stand it here? I think it's time to spice things up with a bit of [fun], don't ya think?'
You say, 'Some fun?'
Bobo Gleemaker says 'I just so happen to have a recipe for fun that never fails! All we will need is a few ingredients and then, bang, boom, bam! Fun will abound! That is unless you want to stay a dour, insipid, vapid, solemn, no-fun, boring, serious nillybilly? I didn't think so! Are you [ready] to get those ingredients for me?'
You say, 'I'm ready'
Bobo Gleemaker says 'Good! Here's a list of what I need. Now scadattle and return when you have the items I need! This is going to be so much fun!'
You have been assigned the task 'Let's Have Some Fun!'.
Task Steps
There are several versions of this task. You'll be assigned kill targets based on your level.
Every version of the task involves killing five mobs in a zone, looting items from their corpses, delivering the items to Bobo, and then hailing Bobo to complete the task.

sad wooly spiders; Wooly Spider Tears; Everfrost Peaks

aquatic sabertooths; Sabertooth Tiger Gills; Lake of Ill Omen

bolvirk beauticians; Beauty Supplies; The Devastation

Level 85-89:

yodeling gorillas; Music Books; Feerrott, the Dream (western half of the zone)

# Only The Blind Will See (Level 65)

**Level:** 60 | **Maximum Level:** 70 | **Quest Type:** Task | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 60
**Maximum Level:** 70
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** Yes
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Task
**Group Size:** Group
**Min. # of Players:** 1
**Max. # of Players:** 6

This task was available in August 2011 in the lead-up to the Veil of Alaris expansion release, and from September 3 to September 24, 2014 as part of "Stone Cold Summer" tasks [quest=7689] and mission [quest=7688].
NOTE: There are multiple versions of this task. Which one you get depends on your level.
This is a shared task (1-6 players) that begins with Arima Fae (click for map image), located near 890, -230 (far north-central boundary of the zone -- due north of the northernmost curve in the path).
Note: You can use Meeka Gharn in the Plane of Knowledge (next to the Main Bank at approximately 410, 465, -124) to port directly to Arima Fae.
You say, 'Hail, Meeka Gharn'
Meeka Gharn says 'Greetings adventurer! I am wondering if you could [help].'
You say, 'Help?'
Meeka Gharn says 'My associate Arima Fae is in danger. He is being sought by the leader of a guild of thieves who calls himself Ven Baga. Arima received a book from Baga thought to lead to many treasures, if it could be deciphered. This was months ago, and now Baga grows impatient and believes Arima is trying to take the treasure for himself. Arima has sent me here to find someone who can help him. He has hired mercenaries for his personal protection, but he needs someone who is capable enough to do some outside work. If you are interested, you will find him in Misty Thicket.'
You have entered The Misty Thicket.
You say, 'Hail, Arima Fae'
Arima Fae says 'You must have been sent by Meeka! Excellent! I have been having trouble finding the clues necessary to decipher this blasted Tome. It doesn't help that Ven Baga and his men are searching for me and making it difficult to travel. Will you [help] me?'
You say, 'I will help.'
Arima Fae says 'Excellent! I'll make sure you are handsomely rewarded for your efforts. Should we find anything, I will gladly cut you in on whatever we find. Now, to the [business] at hand.'
You say, 'Business?'
Arima Fae says 'I am certain that this Tome is related to the [statues] that have been appearing in Norrath. I will need you to track down and find these statues and see what clues you can get from them. I would go myself, but I suspect that Baga will no doubt think the same thing and be waiting for me. But you? I am sure you can handle a couple of low-rent thugs. Will you [do this] for me?'
You say, 'I will do this.'
Arima Fae says 'Your help is much appreciated! '
You have been assigned the task 'Only The Blind Will See [65]'.
Arima is looking for information about unusual statues that have been appearing throughout Norrath. He has asked for your help in investigating them.
You are sent to find Driggles Sparkwaddle in Fungus Grove, located in the second-to-last building on the left leaving the vendor area, at -1225, -560.
Need dialogues & task steps.
Driggles Sparkwaddle says 'Statues! I don't really want to talk about statues. The last one I saw gave me a serious fright. It's like it snuck up on me. Made me drop my best kerchief. It was in... a place they called Skyfire. I can see why, it's got a lot of scary flames and hot spots all over it. Once that statue snuck up on me, I left, fast. You'll have to find your own way there, I'm not interested in going back. I feel safer here.'
The statue location is -2200, -3585, -114 in Skyfire (between druid port-in and Overthere zoneline.)
You find a singed handkerchief that was probably a very expensive item before it was left on the volcanic ground. The handkerchief has a large D stitched into one corner. It is obvious that Driggles thought that this was the appropriate statue, but you know that this ancient dragon statue is not what you seek.
Samson's location is 290, -3535, 253 in Firiona Vie (on a hill behind the new Outpost.)
You say, 'Hail, Samson'
Samson says 'I know the Irontoes, every seller of mead knows the Irontoes. They haven't mentioned statues to me. Come to think of it, though, there were some fellows here asking about statues. They looked a bit seedy, but I didn't have any information for them any more than I do for you. They headed west and then south out of here when they left, if you're looking for them.'
When you leave Samson, head out of the Outpost. When you exit the building/tunnel, turn south (left). You will receive an update at about /loc 25, -1980 and be ambushed by three thieves.
Give Arima the note you found 0/1 (Misty Thicket)
Arima Fae says 'Oh, I see you found some of Ven's bunch. I guess I may as well tell you what I can. You see, those thugs had an invaluable text because I think I can figure out how to read it. But to get it from them I had to tell them a small lie. I told them that the text would lead me to great treasure once I deciphered the language. Unfortunately it has taken longer than I expected to decipher the language. Not that there is any real treasure to be found, at least not for thugs like them. I wonder if we can use this to our [advantage]...'
You say 'Advantage?'
Arima Fae says 'Yes. Yes! It sounds like they've been looking for me by seeking the statues that I've been looking for. I suspect that they have people all over waiting near possible statues. If they have found one of the statues I seek then maybe we can find out where it is from them! Go find my contact in Kithicor Forest. He'll know where they think they can ambush me. Get that information from him and then go there and find the statue! I am quite brilliant, I must admit.'
Question Thimble, Arima's contact in the rogue thieves guild 0/1 (Kithicor Forest)
Thimble can be found in the merchant cabin with Darvon & Grace near the Commonlands zone line:
You say 'Hail, Thimble Thrasher'
Thimble Thrasher says 'I can't take it anymore! Everyone pressuring me to find Arima, find some stupid statues, do everything or we'll kill you! Enough already! I give up. I'll tell you where Ven thinks the statue is. Anything to get you away from me!'
Search for the mysterious statue 0/1 (Everfrost Peaks)
More details needed from here.Submitted by: MerfRewards:
- Ancient Artifact [item=97704]

This task was available in August 2011 in the lead-up to the Veil of Alaris expansion release.
It will be available in September 2014 for an unspecified amount of time as part of "Stone Cold Summer" tasks [quest=7689] and a mission [quest=7688].
NOTE: There are multiple versions of this task. Which one you get depends on your level.
This is a shared task (1-6 players) that begins with Arima Fae (click for map image), located near 890, -230 (far north-central boundary of the zone -- due north of the northernmost curve in the path).
Note: You can use Meeka Gharn in the Plane of Knowledge (next to the Main Bank at approximately 410, 465, -124) to port directly to Arima Fae.
You say, 'Hail, Meeka Gharn'
Meeka Gharn says 'Greetings adventurer! I am wondering if you could [help].'
You say, 'Help?'
Meeka Gharn says 'My associate Arima Fae is in danger. He is being sought by the leader of a guild of thieves who calls himself Ven Baga. Arima received a book from Baga thought to lead to many treasures, if it could be deciphered. This was months ago, and now Baga grows impatient and believes Arima is trying to take the treasure for himself. Arima has sent me here to find someone who can help him. He has hired mercenaries for his personal protection, but he needs someone who is capable enough to do some outside work. If you are interested, you will find him in Misty Thicket.'
You have entered The Misty Thicket.
You say, 'Hail, Arima Fae'
Arima Fae says 'You must have been sent by Meeka! Excellent! I have been having trouble finding the clues necessary to decipher this blasted Tome. It doesn't help that Ven Baga and his men are searching for me and making it difficult to travel. Will you [help] me?'
You say, 'I will help.'
Arima Fae says 'Excellent! I'll make sure you are handsomely rewarded for your efforts. Should we find anything, I will gladly cut you in on whatever we find. Now, to the [business] at hand.'
You say, 'Business?'
Arima Fae says 'I am certain that this Tome is related to the [statues] that have been appearing in Norrath. I will need you to track down and find these statues and see what clues you can get from them. I would go myself, but I suspect that Baga will no doubt think the same thing and be waiting for me. But you? I am sure you can handle a couple of low-rent thugs. Will you [do this] for me?'
You say, 'I will do this.'
Arima Fae says 'Your help is much appreciated! '
You have been assigned the task 'Only The Blind Will See [55]'.
Arima is looking for information about unusual statues that have been appearing throughout Norrath. He has asked for your help in investigating them.
Arima Fae sends you to Gulf of Gunthak to speak to Whimbly Cottonbottom. He is located outside the lighthouse near the Drogmor pen.
You say, 'Hail, Whimbly Cottonbottom'
Whimbly Cottonbottom says 'Statue... statue... oh, yes, I remember one. I was working on the Maiden's Voyage when I saw it. We were near that Firiona Vie place, rowing about in the small boat trying to find something that captain needed, I don't know what. I saw this ugly statue, so I threw my bottle of Kalish at it. I'm pretty sure I hit it. I wasn't going on shore to get a closer look, no matter what the captain said. You see, I don't like grass. Hate the way it tickles my feet. You'll have to go look for it.'
Your task 'Only The Blind Will See' has been updated.
Whimbly Cottonbottom sends you to Firiona Vie to find the statue, which may be found at -1420, 2380, -64.
You look up at the statue of some ancient Iksar, noticing the smashed Kalish bottle at its feet. This is certainly the statue Whimbly was talking about, and is just as certainly not the statue that you seek.
Your task 'Only The Blind Will See' has been updated.
You say, 'Hail, Arima Fae'
Arima Fae says 'Well, that's unfortunate, but expected. I've been following hundreds of false leads. I've got another one for you. I've heard that one of the Irontoe brothers, or cousins, or whatever, has been talking about strange statues to one of the many barkeeps that they visit. I need you to go and talk to one of those barkeeps and see if you can find out which Irontoe it was and what they might have said.'
Your task 'Only The Blind Will See' has been updated.
Arima Fae sends you to Erud's Crossing to speak to Renna, who is located in a hut to the right near the dock the translocator puts you on in Erud's Crossing.
You say, 'Hail, Renna'
Renna says 'Sure, various Irontoes come in here, they visit just about anyone that sells mead. I've never heard them talk about statues, though. I did get some folks in here a little while ago asking about statues, though. I didn't have any answers for them, and they were a bit rude to me. I wouldn't mind if you asked them about the statues and were rude to them in kind. They headed out west from here.'
Your task 'Only The Blind Will See' has been updated.
Three ambushing thieves spawn around -1450, 1230, 100. West of Renna, up the hill.

This is a group task (3-6 players) that was introduced in October 2005, and is available every year around Halloween.
It's one of five tasks required to receive a Bone Mask of Horror [quest=5371] (illusion click item).
It begins with Barsin, the Bone Collector at location -110, 25 in Kithicor (north edge of the lake in the southeastern part of the zone).
You say, 'Hail, Barsin, the Bone Collector'
Barsin, the Bone Collector says 'You there! Yes you! You look like the type that isn't scared off easily. I have a few projects that I'm working on and need someone to retrieve a few [bones] for me.'
You say, 'What bones?'
Barsin, the Bone Collector says 'I can use all types really. I have a rare give with bones you see. I'm able to fashion just about anything out of an adequate collection of them. The problem is that I'm running low on bones for my [projects].'
You say, 'What projects?'
Barsin, the Bone Collector says 'I don't have any specific projects at the moment. It's the bones that tell me what to make. If you can collect this [list] of bones I'd be happy to see what sort of things I could make with them.'
You say, 'What list?'
You have been assigned the task 'The Bone Collector'.
There are many places you could collect bones from, but some of the more exotic bones are harder to obtain. Here's a list of some of the more interesting bones I'd like. See if you can collect them and then we'll see what sort of creation they will make.
NOTE: This task varies by your group's average level. You may be sent to different zones from what's shown here depending on level.

- Wait for Barsin to examine the bones 0/1 (Kithicor Forest)
- Destroy the bone construct 0/1 (Kithicor Forest)

- Deliver 2 Iced Bone Chips to Barsin, the Bone Collector 0/2 (Kithicor Forest)
