/loc 4730, -4150, -94 (underwater tunnels in the north-central part of the zone -- center room at the hidden portal, north wall). For non-Necromancers, this is a simple location update. For Necromancers, this initiates an event (for class event details, see the next section in this writeup).
- 12. Explore Fizzlethrope's Gallery 0/1 (Plane of Mischief)
Task Window Says: 'Seek the walls adorned with Fizzlethorpe's visage within a single chest sits atop a pedestal.'
/loc 20, -390, 125 (first room in the castle). For non-Rogues, this is a simple location update. For Rogues, this initiates an event (for class event details, see the next section in this writeup).
- 13. Explore the Sanctum of the Tortured God 0/1 (Acrylia Caverns)
Task Window Says: Legend has it that Khati Sha, first Vah Shir Beastlord, became the subject of a failed Ssraeshzaen experiment to bestow godhood among a mortal being.
This updates at the zone-in. For non-Beastlords, this is a simple location update. For Beastlords, this initiates an event (for class event details, see the next section in this writeup).
- 14. Explore the Site of the Ancient Games 0/1 (Butcherblock Mountains)
Task Window Says: Not far from Greater Faydark, tucked away in the hills, is an ancient stone board. Its origins remain a mystery...
/loc 700, -2350, 11 (at the chessboard north of the Greater Faydark zone). For non-Warriors, this is a simple location update. For Warriors, this initiates an event (for class event details, see the next section in this writeup).
- 15. Explore the Master's Worldly Keep 0/1 (Castle Mistmoore)
Task Window Says: Faydwer is not home to many beings called 'The Master'. So it should be no surprise that a trip to the castle of Mayong Mistmoore is in order.
This updates at the zone-in. For non-Paladins, this is a simple location update. For Paladins, this initiates an event (for class event details, see the next section in this writeup).
- 16. Explore the Ascended Home of Wun and Po 0/1 (Plane of Sky)
Task Window Says: Having ascended past their worldly existence, Wu and Po serve in the training grounds under the watchful eye of the Wyrm Queen.
This updates at the zone-in. For non-Monks, this is a simple location update. For Monks, this initiates an event (for class event details, see the next section in this writeup).
- 17. Recount your tale to Lady Carolline 0/1 (Northern Felwithe)
Hail her for the final update.
The Event
An Epic Request / An Epic Retelling - Shadow Knight event
* Get your epic weaponry out of the bank.
* Make sure you are solo -- no group and no mercenary.
* Start the task "An Epic Request" in Felwithe.
Throughout the Shadow Knight event, you will be given a number of choices. You can choose the good path like a Paladin, or you can choose the path of evil; the path of the Shadow Knight; the path of Lhranc. During at least one run-through of An Epic Request, follow the path that is the paragon of darkness to earn An Epic Retelling achievement.
* Travel to North Ro and head to the task update spot in the northwest corner of the zone at 9600, -500.
As a Shadow Knight, you will receive "Brittle Stone" on your cursor.
* Click the Brittle Stone to be assigned the 1-person task 'Innoruuk's Curse' (The Shadowknight's Journey) and it also points you southeast.
If you ever find yourself needing to re-enter an instance zone while the task is active, click the Brittle Stone again from North Ro.
If you don't receive a Brittle Stone, check to see if you already have one in inventory from a previous task run.
If you click the Brittle Stone while you are in a group, it gives you the error "This is a journey that must begone [sic] alone. Cast off the bonds of your allies!". Simply disband your group and click the stone again.
You begin casting Look Into the Eyeball.
Your eyes feel stronger.
As you concentrate your gaze on the stone it takes the form of an eye that blinks quickly and then instantly repetrifies. You feel yourself drawn in this direction!
As you near the small wooden huts you notice something interesting. A merchant beating the life out of a fallen-battered man...
You have been assigned the task 'Innoruuk's Curse'.
The direction to someone related to your current Task has been marked on your compass.
'Innoruuk's Curse' task step 1: Locate the Disturbance 0/1 North Desert of Ro
-- The brittle eye-shaped stone calls out to you, beckoning you to seek the nearby conflict.
There is a line on your compass indicating where to go.
* Run southeast to 8190, -1645 in North Ro to find an irate merchant beating a starving beggar.
* Hail an irate merchant.
An irate merchant says, 'The merchant roars, 'Miserable fink! This is the third time this week I've caught this freeloading lump of refuse stealin' from my store!''
'Innoruuk's Curse' task step 2: Settle the Dispute 0/1 North Desert of Ro
-- You are posed with a simple question of morality. Decide the fate of each man.
The wounded human lies broken and beaten as the merchant continues to attack him. In his hand rests a bag of stolen goods...
You get a pop-up window called "A Question of Morality".
A simple question of morality:
Do you take pity on the weak and staving criminal or side with the merchant in defending his livelihood? [Help Merchant] [Save Thief]
Evil choice: [Help Merchant]
An irate merchant says, 'Ah, a fine and fair citizen. Let's spare the militia the hassle of ridding the fields of another pest!'
A starving beggar groans...
* Kill a starving beggar.
The two figures fade from sight and are replaced by two opposing human females. They face each other but each speaks as if only to herself...
The Apotheosis of Hope says, 'There is hope for this one, her judgment is impartial. She knows better than to let her emotions cloud her decisions.'
The Apotheosis of Enmity says, 'Your optimism will be your undoing. This one is clearly the paragon of our cause.'
The Apotheosis of Hope says, 'We shall see...'
Good choice: [Help Thief]
An irate merchant roars, 'Miserable scoundrels, the lot of you! I'll have your heads for this!'
A starving beggar coughs, 'Thank you, stranger.'
* Kill an irate merchant.
The two figures fade from sight and are replaced by two opposing human females. They face each other but each speaks as if only to herself...
The Apotheosis of Hope says, 'Such compassion... This is the one I choose! That is, unless you intend to take back your word. I would hardly put it past you.'
The Apotheosis of Enmity laughs, 'Predictable until the end. This one shall do, I sense the familiar fire burning within them.
The Apotheosis of Hope says, 'We shall see...'
The Apotheosis of Enmity says, 'Fair Knight, I sense in you the will of the Father. I shall spare you the back-story, as I sense your accomplishments already. Tell me, are you [willing] to look back through the eyes of history to settle a little bet of ours?'
* Target The Apotheosis of Enmity and say, 'willing'
The Apotheosis of Enmity says, 'Very well, we shall see you soon...'
'Innoruuk's Curse' task step 3: Witness Lhranc's escape from Freeport 0/1 The Northern Desert of Ro
-- Strange visions have overtaken your consciousness. You find yourself many years in the past viewing life through the eye of Lhranc. Witness his wounded escape from Freeport.
You have entered The Northern Desert of Ro.
You are transported to old, original North Ro (map: nro) facing south, and shrouded as a level 35 warrior. You are affected by the aura Severe Wounds: "You appear to be missing an eye..."
You cough violently; your vision is blurred and sporadic. The expansive desert before you is dark with radically unseasonable weather.
Escape... This word is at the forefront of your consciousness.
It begins to rain.
In the distance you hear the yelling of the militia. You must head south!
* Move south toward the huts.
Your wounds are becoming more severe! You won't make it much further without aid...
Your body is wracked with intense pain.
As you reach the huts, you will start losing health, then fall unconscious.
You fall to the ground in blind agony.
Stranger?
...
You did this to me! You don't... You can't love her as I do!
Brother, we are in love... My heart does not love her to spite you. Do you find no comfort in knowing she is happy?
Happy? She is blinded by your deceit... No... She will be mine!
You are out of food and drink.
...
You alive?
You are completely healed.
Your eyes open, your vision is blurred but you can make out the silhouette of a Barbarian against the cloudy sky.
Guthren Sandfisher says, 'Didn't think you were gonna' make it there, stranger. Not too many folks come crawlin' out'uh Freeport missin' an eye like tha'...'
Your hands are wound tightly with bloodstained bandages. You muster the strength to raise a hand to your face. The soft cloth of an eye patch clings tightly to your skin, bound by a film of dried blood.
The Barbarian walks over and offers you a flask of water. He looks down, ' 'ere, you'll need this. The desert ain't kind tah those without drink...'
You receive 2x Pod of Water on your cursor.
You are healed to full.
Guthren Sandfisher says, 'Yeh should be gettin' along after yeh've rested up, I kin't imagine the guards are far behind yeh... I won't lie if they come askin' about yeh, but I offer yeh this head-start now...'
The Apotheosis of Enmity shakes her head, 'He would so easily hand you over... Seems like you would be better off without guards on your trail.'
The Apotheosis of Hope says, 'You would harm the stranger that saved your life and offered you respite from your abusers simply for not wanting to lie?
Guthren Sandfisher says, 'Yer sword is over there stranger. Travel on in good health.'
You are no longer stunned.
* Stand up and look a bit to the south to find a sword lying on the ground. Pick up and equip Damaged Fine Steel Greatsword - 2HS.
You get a pop-up window called "A Question of Survival".
A question of survival:
Do you silence the fisherman now or risk being followed further by the militia? [OK]
Guthren Sandfisher stands along the shore fishing with his back to you.
* Evil choice: Kill Guthren Sandfisher.
The Apotheosis of Enmity grins, 'Well?'
The Apotheosis of Hope shakes her head...
The mysterious figures vanish.
You have gained the ability "Lifetap" at a cost of 0 ability points.
Your blade quickly fells the fisherman. He falls dead, a look of confusion frozen on his face.
You have slain Guthren Sandfisher!
Your Monster AA Window automatically opens. Make a hotkey for Lifetap from the Class tab. You will need it.
* Good choice: Leave Guthren Sandfisher to his fishing.
The Apotheosis of Hope says, 'Well?'
The Apotheosis of Enmity says, 'It means nothing! A trail of blood is as bad as a trail of words...'
The mysterious figures vanish.
'Innoruuk's Curse' task step 4: Witness Lhranc's escape to the Oasis 0/1 The Northern Desert of Ro
-- After receiving aid from the fisherman Lhranc made his way further south through the desert.
* Start traveling south along the shoreline toward Oasis.
Through the haze you spot the faint glow of torches. It would appear the guards are patrolling the coast, you will have to take the south-west road to the Oasis...
A gust of wind whips over the hills and kicks sand into your face... 'Why do you run, coward?'
You think you hear whispered voices cursing... Watch your step!
The tired sobbing of a woman fills your ears... 'You don't deserve her, you never will...'
* Turn slightly southwest away from the shoreline to avoid the guards. Continue toward the southern zoneline to Oasis while avoiding guards and guard encampments in the desert. If you do get guard aggro, running away seems to leash them. If they kill you, you'll respawn back at the fisherman's hut.
The southwestern road into the Oasis looks clear...
As you reach the zone to Oasis, you are beset by either one guard or three.
A voice breaks through the din of the storms,'Hah! You didn't expect to escape that easily, did you?'
Evil:
The guards laugh, 'The Barbarian led us right to you!'
Wayguard Ginfur shouts, 'You shall not pass into the Oasis!'
Wayguard Sanwell shouts, 'You shall not pass into the Oasis!'
Wayguard Thrinn shouts, 'You shall not pass into the Oasis!'
* You will need to kill all three guards before you can continue - don't forget to use your Lifetap ability.
Good:
Wayguard Thrinn shouts, 'You shall not pass into the Oasis!'
* Kill the guard.
Lhranc roamed the unforgiving deserts of Ro for weeks. His torment continued even as the militia's interest in his capture waned. As time passed he became indistinguishable from any of the nameless madmen roaming the Oasis. His thoughts were fraught with maddening voices. His brother's, his unrequited love's, unyielding multitudes of tormentors left him without solace... His disdain for humanity matured until he had been deemed ready...
Don't actually zone to Oasis. Instead, the script sends you to Plane of Hate B.
'Innoruuk's Curse' task step 5: Make your way to the seat of Innoruuk's power 0/1 The Plane of Hate
-- The morality play grows more severe. Your consciousness has returned to your body but you find yourself in the Plane of Hate. Make your way to the seat of Innoruuk's power to witness a pivotal moment in history.
You have entered The Plane of Hate.
You are now your own character instead of a monster shroud.
A slow tune begins echoing down the Maestro's halls...
The Apotheosis of Enmity sighs before speaking, sounding as if she is in the throes of carnal pleasure, 'The plane is alive with the will of the Father. It was on this day he gave his greatest gift to humankind.'
The Apotheosis of Hope says, 'However, Innoruuk's ritual did not proceed without interruption. A battalion was sent forth by the Lightbringer to end Lhranc's life before he became an unmanageable threat...'
Your mind clouds with images of suffering as The Father's voice shakes the foundations of the plane. The words are unclear but the intent is unmistakable. The denizens of Hate are to keep intruders at bay until the ritual is complete.
You hear what sounds to be the grinding of planks to the south. The din fades and the sound of music in the hall grows louder.
You get a pop-up window called "A Fond Memory".
As you near the Maestro's chamber you come upon a curious duel. A minion of Marr stands in furious combat against one of the Father's pets. The ashenbone drake rears back, its decrepit hide invoking "fond" memories of your past. The Knight of Marr looks to be losing the fight... What do you do? [Kill Drake] [Kill Paladin]
You say, 'Hail, Valorian Rholek'
Valorian Rholek turns toward you quickly with a look of fear and disbelief, 'I can only hope you're here to help defeat this vile foe...'
You say, 'Hail, a decrepit ashenbone drake'
A decrepit ashenbone drake flaps its skeletal wings angrily as it strikes at the paladin!
Evil choice: Kill both the paladin AND the drake. To receive the item Decayed Decrepit Hide, choose to kill the Drake first, followed by the Paladin. If you're not going for the Hide, then the order doesn't matter.
If you choose "Kill Drake":
The Apotheosis of Hope smiles, 'Nobility in camaraderie!'
The Apotheosis of Enmity says, 'Perhaps just blind hatred for the beast...'
* Kill a decrepit ashenbone drake.
Valorian Rholek turns to you and salutes, 'You have my eternal gratitude fair knight. I would not have been able to vanquish that foul beast without your help. I shall sing your praises to my brothers of Marr when I return to my battalion.'
If you choose "Kill Paladin":
The Apotheosis of Enmity grins, 'Yes, rid Father's domain of these pests!'
The Apotheosis of Hope shakes her head, 'Blinded by loyalty, such a shame.'
* Kill Valorian Rholek.
The voice of Innoruuk overwhelms your thoughts, 'One less miserable pest tainting my plane. Perhaps you shall earn the right to suffer here eternally after I've killed you... This one shall return to my temple now.'
If you killed both the drake and the paladin:
The Apotheosis of Hope shakes her head is dismay...
The Apotheosis of Enmity breathes deeply and speaks with a voice tinged with euphoric pleasure, 'Such ruthless hatred, more!'
If you killed the drake and the paladin in the correct order:
The Maestro raises a hand to conduct his choir, their voices cry out in unison with the howl of the bleak organ. You can't help but feel the piece is being performed in your honor...
Innoruuk's voice booms through the open doorway, 'Fools, debauched and worthless souls! You will soon know the power of an elder god!'
You get a pop-up window called "Course of Action".
The denizens of Innoruuk's realm are unusually indifferent to your presence. It would seem their focus is on battling the invading minions of the Lightbringer. The unmistakable presence of Marr's soldiers radiates from the north. To the south, Innoruuk's temple emites a comforting aura of corruption. You may choose to beat back the forces of Mithaniel Marr or simply travel to Innoruuk's temple to bear witness to the ascension of Lhranc. [OK]
* Exit the Maestro building where you will find denizens of Hate battling paladins. You can ignore them, they don't count for anything.
* Evil choice: Before heading south, go north toward the normal zone-in spot to find Squire Baerson on the platform, and kill him.
For Decayed Drecrepit Hide, you may have to pause while killing Squire and make sure he turns twisted before finishing him off.
The area around you shakes as Baerson's form shifts into that of a twisted knight!
Squire Baerson's twisted form falls and disappears from sight, his soul returning to the Temple of Marr.
The Apotheosis of Enmity's disembodied voice shrieks euphorically, 'Truly, you've earned the right to serve Father!'
The Apotheosis of Hope is quick to retort, 'What you see as service to hatred is just as likely devotion to order...'
You have slain Squire Baerson!
* Head south toward Innoruuk's den.
You will meet Ashenbone Skullbreaker, who throws you backwards.
The pile of bones begins to shake and reform. The enormous drake drags its wings across the floor emitting an ear piercing screech.
Your veins are filled with a fast-acting venom.
Ashenbone Skullbreaker rears back, ready to defend Innoruuk's temple.
* Attack Ashenbone Skullbreaker
For Decayed Drecrepit Hide, you may have to pause while killing Ashenbone and make sure it turns twisted before finishing it off.
While fighting:
The drake's skeleton oozes a sickly sweet pus. The putrid substance begins to solidify into a glistening decrepit hide!
The Ashenbone Skullbreaker crumbles and shatters into a host of tiny fragments.
* Ashenbone Skullbreaker is replaced by 10 Ashenbone Fragments -- kill them.
With the ashenbone drakes defeated the door to Innoruuk's hall swings open. There is an unnatural silence throughout the plane.
If you have followed the hidden path, you will receive Decayed Decrepit Hide on your cursor.
As you survey the remains of the fallen drakes, something interesting catches your eye...
'Innoruuk's Curse' task step 6: Witness Lhranc's revenge 0/1 North Freeport
-- Lhranc returned to Freeport to exact revenge upon his brother and claim Kyrenna for himself.
* Move south into Innoruuk's room and witness the ritual on Lhranc.
You survey the room, the perfume of burnt flesh is almost enough to knock you backwards. The ground is wet with blood. Ahead you see an impressive ritual pyre. The denizens here seem to pay no attention to you.
Suddenly the hall doors slam shut. A cold wind whips around the room causing the ritual flame to dance. The Avatar of Hate appears, in the pyre bellow him the body of Lhranc spasms violently.
The avatar lifts a hand, the bodies of the tortured are thrown into the fire. A brilliant flash blinds you as the mass of bodies fuels the flame.
You open your eyes to see Lhranc standing before Innoruuk's dark gift, dominion over the spirits that broke him.
The Apotheosis of Enmity stares longingly into Lhranc's eyes.
The Apotheosis of Hope turns away, looking to the floor.
Lhranc reaches out and grabs the blade. In an instant the plane begins to rumble, spirits of the forsaken coalesce around him. You feel yourself pulled toward the flame as your vision returns to darkness...
Lhranc traveled the lands after receiving Innoruuk's dark gift. His skillful mastery of combat paired with the powers of necromancy left him unrivaled. The seething hatred in his heart brought him back to this place. His brother would pay for taking Kyrenna from him...
When the ritual finishes, you are transported to old, original North Freeport (map: freportn) facing west, and shrouded as a level 50 Shadow Knight. The Monster AA Window automatically opens. Make hotkeys for your monster abilities from both the Class and General tabs.
You have entered North Freeport.
You get a pop-up window called "A Question of Tact".
Do you take the guard's armor or risk being spotted as you search for Glohnor? [Take Uniform] [Leave Uniform]
You must make a choice before you can move.
Evil choice: [Leave Uniform]
* Walk north out of the water outside the Hall of Truth. You are beset by several paladins and other NPCs.
* Kill every NPC in the Hall of Truth building. Kill the bodies they leave, too. Check the two upstairs areas and kill those NPCs as well as their bodies. Some will be level 50 even-cons, others will be level 30 easy kills. Leave none alive.
These peons are not worth dealing with. Continue through the city to find your brother...
At this hour, Glohnor must still be home. Make your way there...
Good choice: [Take Uniform]
* Ask the NPCs in the Hall of Truth 'Where is Glohnor?'
* Once you have cleared the Paladin guild, you are then allowed to leave that area. Travel west then south then east to Glohnor's house which is in the southeast, next to the bank. Open the door and walk inside.
The house is quiet. As you look around you notice something on the table in the corner...
* Click the book on the table.
You look down at the table. A small ring sits in front of a book with freshly scribbled ink on its open pages... 'My darling love Kyrenna, the temple has seen fit to allow us to marry. Your praises I cannot sing high enough for it is your purity and beauty I wish to spend the rest of my happy life in hopes to be worthy of. I have only this simple ring, but with it I pledge to you my heart...' The writing trails off at this point.
You feel a sudden shock of heat, your vision blurs as your mind fills with rage. 'The backstabber, he has usurped your love away from you... The scars you carry are his doing! He would have killed you if you hadn't gotten away that day...'
You rip the pages out of the book and throw them into the lamp-fire. The ring you place in your pocket. Your thoughts coalesce into a single notion, 'The Temple of Marr'.
* Evil choice: You might have to kill all roaming guards between Hall of Truth and Temple of Marr. Not sure on this one. You do not have to kill merchants or guards which are inside other buildings.
* Travel west to the Temple of Marr (Cleric guild).
A nameless voice booms loudly, I give you this last chance to turn back and leave your brother unharmed.'
The cold, cruel voice of Innoruuk whispers quietly, 'Leave none alive. Let them bear witness to the power of Hate!'
Glohnor must be somewhere in the temple. Find him.
* Evil choice: Kill every NPC in the Temple of Marr, including the basement and outside on the two ledges. Leave none alive.
* Travel inside the temple and up several sets of stairs.
When you reach the top level inside the temple:
The Apotheosis of Enmity whispers, 'The shadows... You must hide in the shadows.'
* Cast your Gather Shadows ability from your shroud AAs.
'Innoruuk's Curse' task step 7: Put an end to these visions 0/1 North Freeport
-- Your final trial appears to be reliving these visions and putting an end to the tormented memories that have claimed your consciousness.
It was here Lhranc sneaked into the shadows and waited for his brother...
You feel a slow tugging at your soul as you fall away from the eyes of Lhranc...
You are restored to your own character, no longer a monster shroud.
Glohnor kneels down and begins to pray, 'Lord Mithaniel, Queen Erollisi, bless this eve. I give thanks for my life, my service and my love. I ask that you watch over her as she rests in these halls tonight...'
Lhranc speaks, his tone is mocking, almost sarcastic, Hail, 'brother'...'
Glohnor says, 'My Lord! ... What... What has become of you, brother? Your face... Your eyes?'
Lhranc glares angrily into his brother's eyes before speaking in a cold, uncaring tone, 'Kyrenna! Where is she?'
Glohnor shakes his head and turns his back, 'I am sorry, brother...'
Lhranc says, 'Very well...'
In a flash, Lhranc leaps forward and brings his blade through his brother's shoulder. Glohnor's body screams in agony as it falls limp and lifeless to the floor, blood oozing from his torn chest...
From the hall below comes a familiar female voice, 'Glohnor?!'
Kyrenna falls to the ground and runs her hand along Glohnor's cold face. She turns from him to Lhranc and sobs, 'Why!? ... I hate you! I HATE YOU!'
The walls tremble. A deep, rumbling voice bellows, 'Agent of Hate, your despicable actions have earned you a punishment far more fitting than execution!'
The imposing figure of The Lightbringer stands above you.
Mithanial Marr shouts, 'I shall see to it you spend eternity in the spiritless void of Torsis!'
Lhranc's skin begins to melt away, his bones fade into the ether and he is gone from sight.
Kyrenna sits over the body of her love, tears streaming down her face. You look up to see the Apotheoses, each with identical tearstained faces...
The Apotheosis of Hope says, 'The hatred she harbored for Lhranc allowed Innoruuk to banish her to Torsis alongside his shadowknight.'
The Apotheosis of Enmity says, 'He spent untold years trying to twist her - To love him, to help him break Mithaniel's curse.'
The Apotheosis of Enmity says, 'He was forsaken by his god as she was hers.'
The Apotheosis of Hope says, 'She would eventually escape, only to fall prey to a trap in an effort to bring life back to her slain love.'
The Apotheosis of Enmity turns her gaze from Kyrenna and looks toward you, 'She would die in that prison, many long and painful years after her time on Norrath was due to be up...'
The Apotheosis of Hope says, 'Her spirit was fractured on the day she died. The lingering hatred from Lhranc's torture split from the purity and innocence of her life as a priestess of Marr.'
The Apotheosis of Hope says, 'The fractured aspects would exist within the heart of the innocent, which you once wore around your neck...'
The Apotheosis of Enmity says, '...and eventually attached themselves to the blade that killed the man she loved.'
You get a pop-up window called "A Final Decision".
It is here you stand on the precipice of history. Kill the Apotheosis of Hope: To finish what Lhranc had started, parting the light from Kyrenna's soul. Kill the Apotheosis of Enmity: Or to reclaim the honor that all knights, even those of shadow, must have.
* Evil choice: Equip Innoruuk's Curse (SK epic 1.0) and attack The Apotheosis of Hope. She will succumb with one swing.
But if you have any other weapon equipped: "Your attacks have no effect on the Apotheosis of Hope. This weapon will not harm her."
Innoruuk's Curse glows with a deathly black aura. The young woman screams in agony as she falls to the floor, limp, lifeless.
The Apotheosis of Enmity breathes a deep sigh of relief. As the two figures fade from sight you catch a glimpse of Lhranc's spectral form, to the side his obedient and enraptured servant, the dark mistress Kyrenna...
Kyrenna's soul has been rent of its light!
If you have succeeded in following the path of the Shadow Knight completely:
Along your journey you have proven to be the true paragon of Evil.
The story of a true Shadowknight should make for a more interesting telling of this tale.
A Shadowknight Class - X of X.
Your task 'Innoruuk's Curse' has been updated.
Your task 'An Epic Request' has been updated.
Your vision dims as you feel yourself being pulled away from this place.
You have entered North Desert of Ro.
For completing this quest in the "most evil way" (10/10)
Along your journey you have proven to be the true paragon of Evil.
The story of a true Shadowknight should make for a more interesting telling of this tale.
A Shadowknight Class - X of X.
You are rewarded with:
Hatred [item=125913]
You must do this quest at least 3 times, and during any of these 3 times you must do this with 10/10 max evilness, to get the Hatred reward upon the 3rd time.
There is another bonus item you can get, Decayed Decrepit Hide [item=111245], if you defeat the dracholiche inside plane of hate in a certain way, that I do not remember now.  This item is useful for the ammo slot for certain Charms that increase your stats if you are wearing class-specific armor.
We need info on how these steps are completed.
Rewards are 1 AA, plus:
Option #1: Epic 1.0 Ornament
Option #2: Epic 1.5 Ornament
Option #3: Epic 2.0 Ornament
This task is repeatable with a 20-hour lockout.Rewards:
- Innoruuk's Curse Ornamentation [item=110429]
- Innoruuk's Dark Blessing Ornamentation [item=110431]

# An Epic Request (Shaman)

**Level:** 100 | **Maximum Level:** 125 | **Quest Type:** Task | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 100
**Maximum Level:** 125
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** Yes
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Task
**Group Size:** Solo
**Min. # of Players:** 1
**Max. # of Players:** 1

This task begins with Lady Carolline of Thex in Northern Felwithe. She is located at 0, -170 (on the balcony overlooking the entrance: you can use the Find Feature, CTRL+F, to get to her).
Initiating the Task
You say, 'Hail, Lady Carolline of Thex'
Lady Carolline of Thex smiles, trying to hide an obvious air of sadness, 'Greetings adventurer, such a lovely day isn't it?' The pained look on her face clearly gives away that something is [wrong].
You say, 'What's wrong?'
Lady Carolline of Thex says 'Wrong? Oh, nothing really. My beloved is off again on some [excursion] and has yet to return. I'm quite sure he will be fine though. How I miss our adventures together, the time we would spend exploring the hidden beauty of Norrath. We were especially fond of [Antonica].'
You say, 'Why were you fond of Antonica?'
Lady Carolline of Thex says 'A lovely land, despite the efforts of humans to ruin it...' The Koada`Dal's smile becomes more sincere. 'Lake Rathetear, oh the [stories] I could share of moonlit nights sitting on the docks. The noble aviaks keeping ardent guard over the sacred flame, the sunken towers and legend of the Megalodon...' She sighs and looks up to the sky.'
You say, 'What stories could you share?'
Lady Carolline of Thex blinks and looks back to you, her demeanor changing. 'Tell you what stranger, you come up with an [interesting tale] to distract me from my boredom, and I'll see if I can find something to [reward] you for your effort.'
You say, 'What reward would that be?'
Lady Carolline of Thex says 'Hmm, already pondering your riches before the effort of imagination? I suppose not many adventurers care to put any effort into their journeys these days.' The young high elf sighs. 'Anyway, what you will be rewarded with is something befitting a _____ such as yourself.'
You say, 'I have an interesting tale to tell'
Lady Carolline of Thex says, 'Something grand, truly epic and interesting! Just let me know when you've thought of a suitable story.'
You have been assigned the task 'An Epic Request'.
Be sure to carry your epic artifact with you!

The Event
At the update spot shamans get following emote:
The familiar ruins of the once proud city of Torsis bring to life all the haunting memories of the Ashiir nightmare. The fear, pain, and death of thousands at the hands of a spiritual failing... The clouded memories are pierced by a novel sight in the distance, a small flickering light!
You sense something in this direction!
Following this direction you will find a wisp, what brings up the next emote:
A flicker of light appears before you, insubstantial and weak. Whispering without a voice, and the light is gone. A dim apparition appears along the road to the north...
You sense something in this direction!
You will find there another wisp with following emote:
As you approach the flickering light, a feeling of warmth overcomes your being, like a tugging at your incorporeal senses. A small voice calls. You reach out a hand, and the light is gone. There is a small gust that seems to urge you to the north end of the broken road...
You sense something in this direction!
The last wisp there, but another emotes:
You watch as the light flickers, as if it is struggling against a great weight. Its voice murmurs about you, pleading. Asking you to... see. The light vanishes, leaving a faint trail leading north to the lake...
You struggle to listen to the voice above the din of the jungle life. It seems to gather itself a moment, and then a shrill cry echoes in your mind. 'SEE!' ... Across the lake you spy the outline of two figures.
Across the lake you find Thalger and his pet. Hail him.
You say, 'Hail, Thalger'
Thalger says 'Welcome, Heyokah. I am glad. Glad that you have seen the signs, and heard the will of the spirits. Do not be alarmed, this man died for our cause. I have summoned you here for a very important [task].'
You say, 'task'
Thalger says 'Do you know who I am?'
You say, 'i know who you are'
Thalger says 'Then you know of Miragul? His dark magic threatened my people, and the spirits tasked me with destroying his experiment, his gateway of negative spiritual energy. I was successful, but did not survive.'
Thalger says 'The spirits thought me destroyed, did you know that? I struck into the heart of the black hole with the Spear of Fate, and true enough my body and, yes, most of my spirit, was snuffed out in the act. The spirits took my Spear and forgot me. But a part of me remained, and I have watched. You...you do not [have the spear], do you?'
You say, 'i have the spear'
Give him the spear.
Thalger says 'Interesting that you would lie to me...'
Thalger says 'Well. On to the task at hand. I have kept careful vigilance out for any remnants of Miragul's work resurfacing. The sorcerer was dabbling in powers he did not yet comprehend, and they have taken on a life of their own. The darkness he evoked has spread like a corruption through the spirit world, and now I fear it means to bridge the connection into this world of flesh and blood. We must stop it. Will you [help me]?'
You say, 'i will help you'
The jungle hushes. Thalger smiles.
Thalger says, 'Good. We must combine our powers. I sought you out because I needed a connection to the living world. What is in the spirit world cannot fully destroy what is in the living world, and what lives cannot completely vanquish what does not. That is where the spirits failed last time. They sent me against the black hole, and I was successful, but only in the world of the living. Together, we can surround this corruption, and suffocate it.'
Thalger says, 'Do you know why so many spirits manifest in this form, Heyokah?' He motions toward the spirit wolf beside him, 'In times long before we walked this world on two legs, the spirits whispered to other creatures. They favored the wolves. It was through a wolf that the spirits first spoke to me.'
Targeted (NPC): a spirit wolf
Thalger says, 'I was a hunter in the North once, and saw a great wolf on the frigid tundra. I tracked it by myself for days, and as hunger gripped my bones and I grew weak, the wolf approached, and spoke to me with a thousand voices. The wolf was my companion from that day onward, watching as I crafted the Spear of Fate.'
Thalger gazes sadly at the spirit wolf.
Thalger says, 'The components of the spear were not enough to imbue it with its power. A sacrifice was needed. Blood to soak the spear. As I slew the wolf, who was my friend, the passing of its spirit from our world to the next allowed the other-side to touch the Spear, to give it the power it needed.'
Thalger says, 'I hope you are not shocked at what I tell you, for that is what it means to be a shaman. Those other priests ... those clerics. They fall to their knees and grovel for the gods, the Great Spirits, to give them the power to save what is living. They refuse to acknowledge what we know. Death is meaningless.'
Thalger says, 'All things exist in their natural state. Living or dead, spirits live on. Our cousins, the druids, they hear the spirits, but lack direction. They flit about like fools, thinking they know the way. But they do not. They do not have a shaman's strength, a shaman's wisdom. They cannot accept sacrifice as we do.'
Thalger says, 'We must sacrifice again. This spirit wolf will be the bridge. You must slay it. Through its death, I will reach out, and our powers shall connect.'
Small voices call to you...
Thalger says 'Do not be alarmed if it resists. It is not in their nature to surrender to death. You must fight for the blood. It is our way!'
Fight the wolf and kill him. You should use your epic to attack. During the fight Thalger will say this, if you have your epic as weapon:
Thalger eyes your engraved totem, 'That is a fine ritual staff, my friend. Perhaps once we are done, I could inspect it...'
The spirit wolf barks furiously as your engraved spirit totem bludgeons its body.
Upon death of the spirit Wolf:
The wolf raises its head, as if to howl. Black smoke pours out of its mouth and eyes as its form fades from view. Your weapon is stained with blood.
Thalger's image shimmers. You feel a great tearing as the small voices cry out in dismay.
Thalger shouts above the din of the crackling void, 'Do not be alarmed! We have drawn the corruption into the open. Now stand aside, and I will do what needs to be done.'
Thalger closes his eyes and begins to chant. His form is becoming increasingly solid.
The Dark Mantle begins to cast a spell.
Darkness clouds your eyes.
The Dark Mantle begins to cast a spell.
Your body is encased in ice.
The lights around you are fading, weak. One final whisper reaches your mind, 'See!'
You close your eyes.
You hear the quiet of the forest. You feel the coldness of the air. You see...wrongness!
The ice falls away from your body.
You are no longer stunned.
A strong urge to [STOP] the ritual overcomes you!
You say, 'stop'
Thalger smiles at you. You reach out a hand to grip his arm, and pass through him like water. His features begin to melt, skin peeling away into mist, hair igniting and disintegrating, clothing rotting away. He sinks into the ground, leaving behind nothing but a black stain in the forest floor.
Thalger died.
A Risen Host appears.
Dark tendrils creep out of the nearby vortex, lashing on to the man's corpse at your feet. The body lurches, muscles tensed, and you sense a great dark presence rushing around you.
The previously ashen body glows with a dark crimson hue. It lurches backwards and tilts forwards with no apparent sense of balance. It turns its head toward you and speaks, 'So... Shaman... I thank you for your help, but I've much work to do now you see...'
a Risen Host raises its arms and freezes your body in place!
Your body is encased in ice.
a Risen Host says, 'I've come to appreciate many schools of magic, but had paid no attention to the primitive superstitions of your kind... Despite your ignorance, you turned out to be quite the useful pawn. Thanks to your little sacrifice I was able to breach that unbearable void and find a mortal host again...'
a Risen Host says, 'You'll be happy to know you were at least amusing throughout the ordeal. So hopeful in your attempt to reclaim the soul of that lumbering Barbarian.' The human laughs, 'I may even make your death swift ... once I've found a way to separate my life from yours...'
a Risen Host sighs, 'Always a caveat to the arcane arts, I could not cheat death in necromancy, and am bound by such ridiculous limitations through possession. You're no threat to me now Shaman, so you may as well know. Your life is precious! You should be honored to be my bridge to this plane...'
The surrounding wind spirits begin to flicker with the intensity of burning flame. They cry out in a unified voice, 'Heyokah! You know what must be done!'
You have to fight the enemy, but doing that you must yourself cannabalize to death!
a Risen Host roars furiously, 'Fine! If you insist on making this difficult then I will subdue you by force!'
A Risen Host bashes YOU for 275 points of damage.
You begin casting Cannibalization.
Sigrit hit Sigrit for 30000 points of non-melee damage.
You notice the Host's image waver as your own body takes damage...
During the fight the enemy changes several times its appearance.
You begin casting Ancestral Pact.
Sigrit hit Sigrit for 4564 points of non-melee damage.
The Host's form begins to crack as ashen blood pours from its wounds. Suddenly, dark tendrils lash out from its hands and begin pulling at your spirit!
The wounded Host ceases his assault and shouts, 'Enough of this, BEGONE SHAMAN! Do not return and I will let you live!' His faded ethereal form is showing signs of mortal wounds...
The flickering spirits cry out weakly for your attention. You strain to hear their voices. They urge you to recall the ways of the shaman. Dedication. Sacrifice. The body must suffer so the spirit may strengthen.
Upon your own death following emotes appear:
Miragul`s Broken Possession says 'You miserable waste of life! You would die to stop my return? I shall make your next existence an everlasting nightmare!'
Miragul`s Broken Possession died.
You are bleeding to death!
As life flees your body, you feel your spirit rising, drifting away towards the cosmos. Your consciousness of the world around you fades. Memories drift away, and lucidity becomes feeling and sense...with a jolt, your mind comes back to you, as the wind spirits do their best to hold you back.
You are brought back to life as Spirit Wolf. Now you should give your last sacrifice!
a greater wind spirit begins to cast a spell.
You have been healed for 40000 points.
You are conscious again!
You find yourself in a familiar, yet altogether novel state of being. A physical loss and a spiritual awakening. You peer down to find the remains of your former self, and then look up to see the true form of the being whose physical body you severed from existence.
Targeted (NPC): Miragul`s Spiritual Remains
You feel your grasp on consciousness fading. You know that you must act swiftly to remove Miragul's chance of finding a new host!
You throw yourself into Miragul, your spiritual force against his. Miragul screams as your essences burn at each other. You feel his momentary surprise, his shock at your self-sacrifice, before he is banished back into his phylactery. The two contrary spirits, unable to exist as one, negate one another. The wind spirits struggle to keep you bound to your body, but you are fading...fading.
You crush Miragul`s Spiritual Remains for 1 point of damage.
A lengthy interlude follows...
a wind spirit begins to cast a spell.
As the spirits enter your body, you feel a flash of sensations. The crunch of snow underfoot, the feel of a spear's haft in your hands, the satisfaction of a successful hunt. You know that what remains of Thalger's true spirit rests within you now, thankful for what you have done to banish the ancient sorcerer.
A young elf stands before you. She pulls her hands away in shock as your eyes open. She backs away, as if uneasy by your brutish appearance. She speaks, 'Oh! You're awake. You were so weak, I wasn't sure I could keep you alive.'
Targeted (NPC): Rogarsh
Melyndra says 'Thank Tunare! I did all I could, though I've never felt anything like that. You weren't badly hurt, but...'
Rogarsh says 'Hurry along Melyndra, we've no more time to waste on these random savages!'
Melyndra says 'Just a moment, Rogarsh. We can't just leave her here to die!'
Rogarsh says 'We must. This is a dangerous land. We have to keep moving. We don't have time to care for every wounded animal in our path. Or have you forgotten that we're unarmed. Unless you expect me to be firing my last [broken arrow] at our attackers?!'
Melyndra says 'I will not have it, Rogarsh! We can't go!'
Rogarsh says 'I doubt it even wants our help... Come, we must be about our business.'
Melyndra sighs...
You say, 'broken arrow'
Rogarsh looks at you oddly, and then shrugs off your comment. He turns to Melyndra, 'See, now it's talking to us. Let us be away from here!'
Melyndra looks at you regretfully as Rogarsh draws her away. As they vanish into the jungle, you lie still, attempting to gather yourself. You feel as if great parts of you are missing.
The nearby spirit drifts towards you. You feel its essence filling the voids left in your soul. With a whisper of gratitude for your sacrifice, the last spirit vanishes, and you feel the strength to rise.
Your task 'An Epic Request' has been updated.
Back to Lady Carolline of Thex:
You say, 'Hail, Lady Carolline of Thex'
The young elf nods as you recount your epic tale of the miraculous and extraordinary. The trials you overcame and feats others have endured keep the Koada`Dal enthralled, hanging on your every word... As your story comes to a close the young elf begins to applaud.
Lady Carolline of Thex says 'Simply amazing, such adventures I can only ever dream of experiencing again. You have my personal and eternal gratitude, Sigrit. I shall give you the finest artifact of your choosing. Please pick whichever one you like best and return to me should you ever need more copies of it. If you would like to earn other artifacts then you will simply have to [retell] the tale of your adventure.'
Your task 'An Epic Request' has been updated.
Your story has lifted the spirits and cheer of the lovely young elf.
You have completed achievement: An Epic Request
Rewards are 1 AA, plus:
Option #1: Epic 1.0 Ornament
Option #2: Epic 1.5 Ornament
Option #3: Epic 2.0 Ornament

- Blessed Spiritstaff of the Heyokah Ornamentation [item=110316]
- Crafted Talisman of Fates Ornamentation [item=110423]

This task begins with Lady Carolline of Thex in Northern Felwithe. She is located at 0, -170 (on the balcony overlooking the entrance: you can use the Find Feature, CTRL+F, to get to her).
Initiating the Task
You say, 'Hail, Lady Carolline of Thex'
Lady Carolline of Thex smiles, trying to hide an obvious air of sadness, 'Greetings adventurer, such a lovely day isn't it?' The pained look on her face clearly gives away that something is [wrong].
You say, 'What's wrong?'
Lady Carolline of Thex says 'Wrong? Oh, nothing really. My beloved is off again on some [excursion] and has yet to return. I'm quite sure he will be fine though. How I miss our adventures together, the time we would spend exploring the hidden beauty of Norrath. We were especially fond of [Antonica].'
You say, 'Why were you fond of Antonica?'
Lady Carolline of Thex says 'A lovely land, despite the efforts of humans to ruin it...' The Koada`Dal's smile becomes more sincere. 'Lake Rathetear, oh the [stories] I could share of moonlit nights sitting on the docks. The noble aviaks keeping ardent guard over the sacred flame, the sunken towers and legend of the Megalodon...' She sighs and looks up to the sky.'
You say, 'What stories could you share?'
Lady Carolline of Thex blinks and looks back to you, her demeanor changing. 'Tell you what stranger, you come up with an [interesting tale] to distract me from my boredom, and I'll see if I can find something to [reward] you for your effort.'
You say, 'What reward would that be?'
Lady Carolline of Thex says 'Hmm, already pondering your riches before the effort of imagination? I suppose not many adventurers care to put any effort into their journeys these days.' The young high elf sighs. 'Anyway, what you will be rewarded with is something befitting a _____ such as yourself.'
You say, 'I have an interesting tale to tell'
Lady Carolline of Thex says, 'Something grand, truly epic and interesting! Just let me know when you've thought of a suitable story.'
You have been assigned the task 'An Epic Request'.
Be sure to carry your epic artifact with you!

NOTE: There are 16 "explore" locations. Each location represents one class and, for that one class, will trigger an event. The other 15 classes only need to explore the location.

# Erollisi Day: The Perfect Companion

**Level:** 1 | **Maximum Level:** 125 | **Quest Type:** Task | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 1
**Maximum Level:** 125
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** Yes
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Task
**Group Size:** Solo
**Min. # of Players:** 1
**Max. # of Players:** 1

This is a seasonal task (offered around Valentine's Day) given by Grimble Grumblemaker in the Plane of Knowledge. He's located at -280, 1510 (just northwest of the entrance to the Guild Lobby).
You say, 'Hail, Grimble Grumblemaker'
Grimble Grumblemaker shuffles his feet on the stones. He sighs and looks at you from under his wrinkled brow. 'Why don't [they] like me?! I followed all the steps in 'A Tinkerer's Guide to Love:' Compliment Target, Demonstrate Superior Skill, Create Desire, and Kindle Love! I don't know what's wrong with me!'
You say, 'Who is 'they'?'
Grimble Grumblemaker says 'You don't know who THEY are?! They're only the most beautiful, talented women in all of [Norrath]! They're elegant, determined, caring, lovely... everything that I would want my lady to be!'
You say, 'All of Norrath?'
Grimble Grumblemaker says 'Yes, all of Norrath! I am an equal-opportunity appreciator of the female gender! From dark elves to iksar, there is no specimen of woman that I would kick out of my laboratory. For some reason, though, these Special Sixteen -- as I have come to call my beauties -- have all [rejected] my advances!'
You say, 'Rejected?'
Grimble Grumblemaker says 'Yes, most of them cannot stand to look at me. But I have figured out how to secure their love! If you would be so kind as to [help] me, you will be rewarded. I may be small, but my brain is large, and I know how to use it!' Grimble mumbles under his breath, 'Why did that line never work on them?'
You say, 'I will help'
Grimble Grumblemaker says 'Oh, thank you! You are such a kind and beautiful soul! You will not regret this! Here is a list of their names and locations. I merely need a few gifts... a few hairs or pieces of loose skin from them. Don't worry! I don't want you to hurt them! Just a little pluck here or there when they're not looking... I just need at least five of them, please.' Grimble rubs his hands together and says to himself, 'This is going to be so good!''
You have been assigned the task 'The Perfect Companion'.
Grimble Grumblemaker has made an odd request for you to bring him hair and skin -- 'gifts' he calls them -- from sixteen women of Norrath with whom he is infatuated. Despite any misgivings you might have, he has promised you a reward.
Once you have collected at least five 'gifts', return to Grimble and let him know what you have done.
Note: All NPCs for this task show up on the Find feature (CTRL+F to bring it up in game).
Get close to the NPC, and hail them. They tend to run away, so this may take a few attempts.
Note: While you only need to collect five (there is no actual item; only hail updates) before returning to Grimble Grumblemaker, there is an achievement [quest=7480] and special item rewarded for getting all 16 updates.
Take a lock of hair from Marnia McMensen 0/1 (Halas)
Take a lock of hair from Sylnyk T`Vok 0/1 (Neriak Commons)
Take a lock of hair from Tilliki 0/1 (Crescent Reach)
Take a lock of hair from Myra Denghop 0/1 (South Kaladim)
Take a lock of hair from Veintana Uralia 0/1 (Paineel)
Take a piece of skin from Gilbina 0/1 (Mountains of Rathe)
Take a lock of hair from Mekinti 0/1 (Ak'Anon)
Take a lock of hair from Kirilin 0/1 (Northern Felwithe)
Take a lock of hair from Smarta Bragglethin 0/1 (Rivervale)
Take a lock of hair from Lalanis 0/1 (Southern Felwithe)
Take a lock of hair from Karon 0/1 (South Qeynos)
Take a piece of scale from Zarkrys 0/1 (East Cabilis)
Take a lock of hair from Grenda 0/1 (Oggok)
Take a lock of hair from Gorble 0/1 (Grobb)
Take a lock of hair from Kalika 0/1 (Shar Vahl)
Take a lock of hair from Alleana 0/1 (Greater Faydark)
Tell Grimble Grumblemaker about all the 'gifts' you have collected for him 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
You say, 'Hail, Grimble Grumblemaker'
Grimble Grumblemaker claps his hands with joy. He stuffs the disturbing 'gifts' into his pockets. 'Yes! This is wonderful! I can now infuse my clockwork with their essences! It will be the ultimate companion, the greatest woman in all of Norrath! And she will love me unconditionally! They will love me! The Special Sixteen are mine, all mine!' Grimble laughs to himself and clasps his hands. 'I suppose I should pay you... now leave me alone... I have a lot of work to do in my lab!
You feel somewhat dirty fulfilling Grimble Grumblemaker's desires, but at least no one was hurt. And you did it for love, right? It might be a strange, unnatural, obsessive love, but love nonetheless. Perhaps you will sleep better tonight by telling yourself that.
1,237 platinum, 5 gold (at Level 100)
Experience ("a fair amount" -- about 0.7% experience in Level 100)
887pp and 3.75AA worth of xp (at Level 80)
There is also a bonus reward if you do all 16 steps:
Grimble Grumblemaker searches his packs and retrieves a small bouquet of half wilted roses. He gives you an unnerving grin and speaks excitedly, 'My perfect woman will have no need for these gifts. Please, consider it an extra reward for your diligent service.'
Erollisi Day Flowers
NO TRADE HEIRLOOM PLACEABLE
Slot: RANGE PRIMARY SECONDARY
This item is placeable in yards, guild yards, houses, and guild halls.
WT: 0.9 Size: SMALL
Class: ALL
Race: ALLRewards:

# 15th Anniversary: Magically Delicious

**Level:** 95 | **Maximum Level:** 125 | **Quest Type:** Task | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 95
**Maximum Level:** 125
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** Yes
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Task
**Time Limit:** 24:00:00
**Group Size:** Solo
**Min. # of Players:** 1
**Max. # of Players:** 1

Anniversary events tend to run from mid-March to mid-April (sometimes to mid-May) each year. They are not available during the "off season".
For an overview and list of EverQuest Anniversary events, see this quest entry [quest=6782].
This task became available on live servers on Wednesday, April 23, 2014, but was then taken offline. It returned on Tuesday, April 29, 2014, and will remain available through to Wednesday, June 11, 2014.
This is an anniversary timed solo task (24-hour timer) introduced with EverQuest's 15th anniversary. It begins with Jimothy the Delicious (click for map image) in the Plane of Knowledge at /location 270, 300 (a little ways southeast of the main bank).
NOTE: This task requires some running around and killing in static (non-instanced) zones. You'll want to leave yourself ample time to finish it before starting it.
Pre-Requisites for Requesting:
- No tasks
- Level 65
NOTE: It is strongly recommended you read up on (and acquire) tradeskill components (listed in a section below) before requesting this task, as some of the components are rare or out-of-the-way to acquire.
Shopping List
Vendor:
2 Bottle of Milk - PoK Chef
1 Cup of Flour - PoK Chef
8 Cup of Sugar - PoK Chef
1 Butter - PoK Chef
1 Almonds - PoK Chef
1 Dried Vanilla Beans - PoK Chef - NO TRADE
1 Vegetables - Crafted with ingredients from PoK Chef, or Foraged
2 Bottle - PoK Brewer
3 Water Flask - PoK Brewer
2 Short Beer - PoK Brewer
1 Anise - PoK Alchemist
1 Fennel - PoK Alchemist
1 Grande Wormwood - PoK Alchemist
1 Kiola Nut - Ocean of Tears - Cleonae Kalen on zone-in island - good race illusion or use sneak -- not stackable until you brew it into Tumpy Tonic
1 Blood Flower - Kael (Velious era) - Bjorak Stonefist - using sneak (shroud / persona) can help to raise the faction -- not stackable
Ground spawn:
3 Corn Rose - Oceangreen Hills and Oceangreen Village
Forage:
2 Drench Flower - Frontier Mountains
2 Koraskian Sprigget - Rathe Council Chambers
Forage or Farm:
1-2 Phoenix Egg - Dropped in Plane of Air, or Foraged in Temple of Marr
Farm:
2 Treant Flower - The Grounds, Morell's Castle, Valley of Lunanyn, etc
Skill:
you need Baking skill minimum 30, even though the task combine is no fail
you need Brewing skill minimum 30, even though the task combine is no fail
someone who can bake 151 trivial
someone who can brew 300 trivial
Steps & Summary
- Say "lend a matchmaking hand" to request the task.
Speak to Grand Librarian Maelin 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
Defeat tomes to recover Recipe Pages (Bloodstained) 0/5 (Dreadspire Keep)
Defeat tomes to recover Recipe Pages (Smudged) 0/5 (The Library)
Defeat tomes to recover Recipe Pages (Singed) 0/5 (Erudin Burning)
Speak to Jimothy the Delicious 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
Bake Magically Delicious Cookies 0/1 (ALL)
Brew Magically Delicious Sweetwater 0/1 (ALL)
Speak to Jimothy the Delicious 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
Arrange a Beautiful Bouquet 0/1 (ALL)
Speak to Jimothy the Delicious 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
Give the Beautiful Bouquet to Bemienn Grinrain 0/1 (Surefall Glade)
Give the Magically Delicious Cookies to Bemienn Grinrain 0/1 (Surefall Glade)
Give the Magically Delicious Sweetwater to Bemienn Grinrain 0/1 (Surefall Glade)
- Kill animated books in Dreadspire Keep, The Library, and Erudin Burning until you've gotten five updates from each zone.
--- Grand Librarian Maelin will port you to the zones upon request.
- Hail Jimothy the Delicious.
- Bake "Magically Delicious Cookies".
- Brew "Magically Delicious Sweetwater".
- Hail Jimothy the Delicious.
- Make a "Jimothy's Beautiful Bouquet" in the container provided.
- Hail Jimothy the Delicious.
- Hand in all three items Bemienn Grinrain in Surefall Glade.
- NOTE: If you want the bonus reward, give the items to Maghee Thunderwood in Surefall Glade.
--- This spawns a KOS "Jimothy the Delicious" - kill him for the "Jimothy Junior" item.
Triggering the Task
You say, 'Hail, Maghee Thunderwood'
Maghee Thunderwood sobs, barely able to speak, 'I... love him... but he... doesn't even... NOTICE meeeeeee.'
You say, 'Hail, Jimothy the Delicious'
Jimothy the Delicious says 'Poor Maghee. It crumbles my gingerbread heart to see her in such an unsettled state. She hasn't moved from this spot for hours, perhaps even days. I worry for her well-being. Just look at her, _____! Have you ever seen someone so broken up over a case of [unrequited love]?'
You say, 'Unrequited love?'
Jimothy the Delicious says 'The man she has eyes on has not returned her affections.' Jimothy pauses, dramatically wiping a bead of frosting out of his eye. 'You know, we have to do something. A romantic picnic will bring the poor, deluded dolt around for sure. And sure as I'm standing here, Surefall Glade is clearly the perfect place. So that leaves the task of cooking up a basket of delightful delicacies. Seeing as how this is a serious matter, not any delicacy will do. I've heard of a [certain recipe book]...'
You say, 'A certain recipe book?'
Jimothy the Delicious says 'Yes! 101 Delicious Recipes. The esteemed Maelin, head librarian of Knowledge, will know where to find it. I must stay here to comfort Maghee. If you're [half as sweet] as I am, you'll [lend a matchmaking hand].'
You say, 'Half as sweet?'
Jimothy the Delicious shrugs, flecks of sugar shedding from his shoulders, 'I can't help but be sweet. It's in my nature.'
You say, 'I'll lend a matchmaking hand...'
Jimothy the Delicious says 'Splendelicious! See to Maelin at once and ask him to retrieve 101 Delicious Recipes from the stacks. Meanwhile, I'll [stay here and comfort] Maghee.'
You have been assigned the task 'Magically Delicious'.
Maghee Thunderwood needs to catch the attention of the man she adores! A strange gingerbread gentleman with a sweet disposition who goes by Jimothy the Delicious has enlisted your help.
You say, 'You stay here and comfort her...'
Jimothy the Delicious shrugs, flecks of sugar shedding from his shoulders, 'I can't help but be sweet. It's in my nature.'
Speak to Grand Librarian Maelin 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
Task Window Says: Speak to Grand Librarian Maelin in the pinnacle of the Plane of Knowledge library about a book titled 101 Delicious Recipes.
You say, 'Hail, Grand Librarian Maelin'
Grand Librarian Maelin says 'I do know where the recipe book is and you're welcome to it. Well, you're welcome to what's left. Many of the pages have been [borrowed].'
You say, 'Borrowed?'
Grand Librarian Maelin says 'Unfortunately for you, many pages of the recipe book you seek have been borrowed. Over time, subsequently, they were scattered about to different realities and locales across Norrath. But fortunately for you, I know where to find them: [Dreadspire Keep], the [House of Thule Library], and [Erudin Burning]. The animated tomes in these places will have the missing pages of 101 Delicious Recipes, and they won't [give them back willingly]. I can teleport you to each of these locations; just say the word.'
Defeat tomes to recover Recipe Pages (Bloodstained) 0/5 (Dreadspire Keep)
Defeat tomes to recover Recipe Pages (Smudged) 0/5 (The Library)
Defeat tomes to recover Recipe Pages (Singed) 0/5 (Erudin Burning)
Task Window Says: Grand Librarian Maelin gave you 101 Delicious Recipes, but many pages were missing. Animated tomes in several out-of-the-way libraries have the pages and they won't give them up without a fight.
Grand Librarian Maelin will port you to the mentioned zones if you ask him to.
You say, 'Send me to Dreadspire Keep'
Grand Librarian Maelin says 'Say hello to Mayong's underlings for me, and don't forget: the tomes in the library have the missing recipe pages you'll need!'
You port into Dreadspire Keep in front of a large door. Click on it to port over to the Keep, then head north until you come to the ballroom. The library is located east of the ballroom. Kill tomes in the library of Dreadspire until you get all five updates.
You say, 'Send me to the House of Thule Library'
Grand Librarian Maelin says 'There isn't a whole lot to see or do in the Thule library, so you shouldn't be distracted from your task. Don't forget: the tomes have the missing recipe pages you'll need!'
In The Library are several tome mobs. Kill animated books (scattered throughout the entire zone) until you've gotten five updates.
You say, 'Send me to Erudin Burning'
Grand Librarian Maelin says 'Watch out for agitated erudites, and flames, and paper cuts. Mark my words, paper cuts are the worst. Don't forget: the tomes in the library have the missing recipe pages you'll need!'
In Erudin Burning, kill tomes (found in and around the library in the far southern part of the zone) until you've gotten your five updates.
Speak to Jimothy the Delicious 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
Task Window Says: Jimothy the Delicious will want to see the completed 101 Delicious Recipes.
You say, 'Hail, Jimothy the Delicious'
Jimothy the Delicious gasps, 'You recovered the missing pages of 101 Delicious Recipes! Now let me have a look.' He rips the recipe book from your pack and flips through it excitedly. You can't help but notice how his clumsy gingerbread hands deposit crumbs between the pages. 'Yes, yes, YES. Here are two surefire candidates: cookies and a tasty tonic guaranteed to satisfy even the sweetest teeth. They will make for memorable picnic fare. I've jotted down the recipes in your journal. They won't require much skill on your part, but you will need to locate the appropriate ingredients.'
You have learned the recipe Magically Delicious Cookies!
You have learned the recipe Magically Delicious Sweetwater!
Bake Magically Delicious Cookies 0/1 (ALL)
Magically Delicious Cookies (Baking, 15 Trivial)
- 1x Bottle of Milk
- 4x Cup of Sugar
- 1x Phoenix Dough
- 1x Butter
- 1x Almonds
- 1x Dried Vanilla Beans
"Bottle of Milk" and "Cup of Sugar" are common vendor items (see Klen Ironstove in the Plane of Knowledge).
"Butter", "Almonds", and "Dried Vanilla Beans" are bought from Chef Dunrun [npc=43311] in the Plane of Knowledge.
"Phoenix Dough" is a Baking combine (151 Trivial) - click here for recipe.
Brew Magically Delicious Sweetwater 0/1 (ALL)
Magically Delicious Sweetwater (Brewing, 15 Trivial)
- 1x Tumpy Tonic
- 4x Cup of Sugar
- 1x Rose Absinthe
- 1x Vodka
To obtain a "Tumpy Tonic", either combine 1x "Kiola Nut" (bought from Cleonae Kalen in the Ocean of Tears) + 1x "Water Flask" (135 Brewing), OR hand those two items to Tumpy Irontoe in South Kaladim.
The "Rose Absinthe" is a Brewing combine (300 Trivial) - click here for recipe.
"Vodka" is a Brewing combine (135 Trivial) - click here for recipe.
Speak to Jimothy the Delicious 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
Hail Jimothy the Delicious to receive "Jimothy's Flower Vase".
Arrange a Beautiful Bouquet 0/1 (ALL)
Beautiful Bouquet (Non-Tradeskill)
Inside the container, combine the following items to produce "Jimothy's Beautiful Bouquet":
2x "Corn Rose"
2x "Drench Flower"
2x "Koraskian Sprigget"
2x "Treant Flower"
1x "Blood Flower"
"Corn Rose" is a ground spawn in Oceangreen Hills at 186, 762 (close to the village zoneline), with other nearby locations.
"Drench Flower" is foraged in the Frontier Mountains (common) and Swamp of No Hope (uncommon).
"Koraskian Sprigget" is foraged in the Rathe Council Chambers (common) and Pellucid Grotto (rare).
"Treant Flower" is a common drop from treants throughout House of Thule and Veil of Alaris (The Grounds; Morell's Castle; Valley of Lunanyn; among others).
"Blood Flower" is bought from Bjorak Stonefist in Kael Drakkel's arena - only confirmed from the low-level Kael in Velious (requires apprehensive+ faction with Kromzek in order to buy).
Speak to Jimothy the Delicious 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
Give the Beautiful Bouquet to Bemienn Grinrain 0/1 (Surefall Glade)
Give the Magically Delicious Cookies to Bemienn Grinrain 0/1 (Surefall Glade)
Give the Magically Delicious Sweetwater to Bemienn Grinrain 0/1 (Surefall Glade)
Bemienn Grinrain is found at the small bridge over the stream just inside the Surefall Glade zone-in tunnel.
BONUS ITEM: For the bonus loot item, "Jimothy Junior", instead of giving these items to Bemienn Grinrain, hand them to Maghee Thunderwood (all three items at one time), who stands next to him. Maghee hands the items back, and this spawns and aggro's "Jimothy the Delicious", who has a lot of hitpoints. Whoever summons Jimothy (in Surefall Glade, by doing turn in) is the only person who can loot the Jimothy Junior. You can kill him to loot this bonus item.
NOTE: Don't do the bonus item turn-in unless you're ready for the fight with Jimothy the Delicious. If you fail the fight, you won't be able to respawn him.
250 platinum
5 Commemorative Coins
Commemorative Coins are used to purchase items from "a jubilant merchant" (click for map image), found in the northernmost tent in the neutral district (close to The Nexus portal stone).Rewards:
- Commemorative Coin [item=116720]
- Jimothy Junior [item=116776]

# Where is Marcia Attamilgad?

**Level:** 1 | **Maximum Level:** 125 | **Quest Type:** Guide | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 1
**Maximum Level:** 125

**Max. # of Players:** 1

Certain "Noble Exchange" vendors will give hints as to there current whereabouts of the "Rare Items" merchant Marcia Attamilgad. Those in the Bazaar and the Plane of Knowledge don't seem to help, but if you speak with those in Wayfarer camps, they'll be more forthcoming with information:
You say, 'Hail, Karoline'
Karoline says 'Hello, _____.  Here to do some [trading], or were you looking for my friend [Marcia]? You never know [where] she'll turn up.'
You say, 'Trading?'
Karoline says 'I'm happy to exchange [Nobles] for your platinum or gold pieces if you wish.'
You say, 'Nobles?'
Karoline says 'Well, that's what we call them, anyway.  Surely you must be a noble to have that much money!'
You say, 'Who is Marcia?'
Karoline says 'Marcia Attamilgad, of course.  She's a somewhat shady swashbuckler who seems to be able to get her hands on a new item every time she shows up.  She charges a lot, and she never has very much stock on hand, but she claims she's the only person on Norrath who can find what she sells.  She [travels] around a lot.  Always on the move, that one.'
You say, 'She travels? Where?'
Karoline says 'Marcia was here not too long ago. She was saying she might go to _____ or maybe _____.'
Check the zones suggested. Wherever she is, Marcia Attamilgad will always be on the Find feature (CTRL+F). If you don't see her on Find, then she's not in the zone.
Marcia Attamilgad is an adventure merchant and only deals with the Noble [item=118277] currency. Since her inventory is small and fleeting, you'll often find her empty. If you catch her at the right time, though, you may find some exceptionally rare items available for very, very high prices.

Bone Fragmented Necklace
Cold Visor of the Warlord
Dark Hoop of the Necromancer

Steel Ring of the Foot Soldier
Steel Rod of the Knight
You say, 'Hail, Marcia Attamilgad'
Marcia Attamilgad says 'Hi, my name is... Well, as far as YOU know, my name is Marcia Attamilgad.  I [travel] a lot, and sometimes I find a [few] [rare items] that you might be interested in. If I don't have what you want today, find me [tomorrow].'
You say, 'What rare items?'
Marcia Attamilgad says 'Well, you know how it is.  Travel around enough, meet enough people, you start finding out who has things, and how much they are.  I've got leads on quite a [few] items that I guarantee no one else will have.  If you can pay the [price], you're welcome to have one.'
You say, 'Just a few?'
Marcia Attamilgad says 'I never have many of these things.  I don't carry my whole inventory around at once like some people do.  If something's especially rare, I usually can just get my hands on one at a time.  Once I've made a sale like that, though, I don't have to worry about finding something else to sell until I [move] on.'
You say, 'What about the price?'
Marcia Attamilgad says 'I'll be frank with you.  This stuff costs a lot to get.  If you want it you'll have to make it worth my while, and my time is worth a lot.'
You say, 'Why move on?'
Marcia Attamilgad says 'I always said I was going to travel, and now that I'm grown that's my plan.  Never see the sun rise from the same place twice in a row.'
You say, 'Where will you be tomorrow?'
Marcia Attamilgad says 'Tomorrow?  I don't know where I'll be yet.  I'll be there when I wake up, and I'll have something else to sell from my stash.'Rewards:

This is a "Quests" achievement under the "Tradeskill" tab.
For an overview and listing of Tradeskill achievements, click here.
This achievement was stealth patched on or around the June 15, 2016 patch by Dzarn.
This achievement does not require speaking with anyone prior; you may start it at anytime.
This achievement is gained upon recovering all of Lebounde's lost equipment:
You say, 'Hail, Lebounde ab Dolmen'
Lebounde ab Dolmen says 'Gooddeh t' yeh, friend.
This is all he says to begin with. Hand in one of the required items (the easiest is the Halas item at the bottom of the well). Upon handing this in:
Lebounde ab Dolmen thanks you gratefully, 'A fine thing yeh did in findin' this. If yeh find anythin' else they took from meh, make haste back with it.'
You receive a "Scribbled Directions" (readable book describing the lost item locations).
If you hail Lebounde ab Dolmen now, he replies with:
You say, 'Hail, Lebounde ab Dolmen'
Lebounde ab Dolmen says 'Gooddeh t' yeh, friend. Wouldn't happen t' be lookin' fer [work], would ye?
You say, 'I'm looking for work.'
Lebounde ab Dolmen says 'Could use help finidin' some of meh lost equipment. Yeh see, a group of thugs ran off with most of it, left meh with nothin' but a handful of riddles. Bandits ain't never made much sense t' meh, but maybe yeh'll have some luck decipherin' meanin' outta this.'

# Adalora's Items

**Level:** 40 | **Maximum Level:** 130 | **Quest Type:** Quest | **Repeatable:** No | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 40
**Maximum Level:** 130
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** No
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Quest
**Group Size:** Solo

This is one of the finished Kunark quests added on the February 15, 2017, update.
You say, 'Hail, Taluran the Mindful'
Taluran the Mindful says, 'Greetings. I am Taluran the Mindful. It's a pleasure to meet you. I wish that I had more time to speak, but I am here on a quest and to divert my focus would disgrace [her memory:Whose memory are you speaking of?].'
You say, 'Whose memory are you speaking of?'
Taluran the Mindful says, 'Her name was Adalora. She was a monk of my esteemed order and follower of the teachings of Tranquility. She's been lost to us for many centuries. However, it is not her I seek, but the restoration of her legacy. I would venture into the lands of Kunark myself, but I [need the aid:What aid do you need?] of Kaelana and Levaios, which they cannot provide. Evidently they are consumed by searches of their own.'
You say, 'What aid do you need?'
Taluran the Mindful raises a brow and studies _____ carefully, 'If you're offering your assistance, I will not turn it down. The first item I need is Adalora's Focus. It's a small wooden pendant, and has been separated and likely scattered throughout the lands. Before dismissing me to perform the duties needed by her people, Kaelana allowed me to read through her ancestor's journal, written by the Ivyshae who traveled with Adalora for some time. I was able to ascertain the [locations:Tell me more of the locations of these items.] of the pieces of the pendant.'
You say, 'Tell me more of the locations of these items.'
Taluran the Mindful says, 'The separate pieces have been scattered across the Ruins of Kunark. The Ornately Carved Wooden Pendant can be found in the sprawling jungle that bears the dragon's name, still within the clutches of the monster that ended Adalora's life, one whose true name has been forgotten and replaced with an apt description -- the Tortured Wraith. The Runed Brass Disk is in the dusty depths of the Howling Stones. The final piece, Adalora's Oath, is in the grips of a deadly creature known as the Obsidian Wyvern.'
Head to Trakanon's Teeth.
- Loot Ornately Carved Wooden Pendant from Tortured Wraith in Trakanon's Teeth.
Head to Howling Stones.
- Loot Runed Brass Disk from golems in Howling Stones.
Head to Skyfire Mountains.
- Loot Adalora's Oath from Obsidian Wyvern in Skyfire Mountains.
Go back to Firiona Vie.

# Vitratul's Scrolls

**Level:** 1 | **Maximum Level:** 130 | **Quest Type:** Quest | **Repeatable:** No | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 1
**Maximum Level:** 130
**Monster Mission:** No

This is one of the finished Kunark quests added on the February 15, 2017, update.
You say, 'Hail, Vitratul K`Reil'
Vitratul K`Reil raises an eyebrow as he takes in the entirety of _____. He utters a disapproving 'hmph' before speaking in a calculated, callous tone, 'Good day to you. I am Vitratul K`Reil, and unless you have business to discuss, it would be best for your continued existence if you were to depart from my sight immediately. I have no interest in idle chatter when there are [greater concerns:What greater concerns?] more worthy of my attentions.'
You say, 'What greater concerns?'
Vitratul K`Reil draws in a deep breath and narrows his eyes, pausing for a moment to collect his thoughts before speaking again in a slow, regal tone, 'I come to this place in search of knowledge and power -- much like yourself, _____. Though I choose to refrain from the more vulgar, barbaric rituals of battle when the [true power I seek:What is the true power you seek?] lies in patience and study.'
You say, 'What is the true power you seek?'
Vitratul K`Reil chuckles softly, a faint, sinister smirk creeping into the corner of his lips, 'Ah, your inquiry is well earned. Of course, it can be answered -- but as with all things, _____, such knowledge comes with a price. If you wish to know what I'm seeking, then you shall [aid me:I will aid you.] and earn this knowledge and discipline.'
You say, 'I will aid you.'
Vitratul K`Reil straightens his posture, the sinister smirk washing away from his features, replaced by his default callous demeanor, 'And so you shall, _____. There are four scrolls that you shall retrieve for me, as your introduction to this study and discipline. The Scroll of Night which you may find in Talendor's domain, the Scroll of the Beguiler from the city enshrouded by mist, the Scroll of the Invoker from the sarnak stronghold, and the Scroll of the Conjuror from The Hole. Return only when you have all four of these scrolls, _____. I shall accept nothing less.'
Head to Skyfire Mountains.
- Loot a Scroll of Night from Nightwing in Skyfire Mountains.
Head to City of Mist.
- Loot Scroll of the Beguiler from A Spectral Beguiler in City of Mist.
Head to Chardok.
- Loot Scroll of the Invoker from a Di`zok Invoker or a Di`zok Channeler in Chardok.
Head to Ruins of Paineel (The Hole)
- Loot Scroll of the Conjuror from The Stone Caller in The Hole,
Head back to The Overthere.
- Turn in all 4 scrolls to Vitratul.
Vitratul K`Reil studies the scrolls carefully, taking in their words methodically and with great consideration before giving a subtle nod of approval, 'You have done well in this, _____. Now for your second task.' The necromancer hands you a scroll of fresh parchment covered with recently scribed words, the ink still shimmering and wet, 'These are the Words of Night. Take them to Nureya I`Rals once you have obtained a Thin Crystal Orb which can be found in the mines and an Essence of Night from the jungle. She will tell you what to do next once you have completed this task.'

Head to The Overthere.

Nureya raises one eyebrow as she scans the Words of Night, then she examines the pair of orbs carefully. Without a word, the beautiful Teir`Dal enchantress begins to chant in her haunting, otherworldy soprano. The pair of orbs in her hands radiate as she draws them together, where they meld into a single pitch black sphere that seems almost vulgar in Nureya's delicate hands. Slowly, she extends her arms toward _____, offering the orb, 'If you wish to continue your task, return this Orb of Night and the Black Orb of the Arcane to Vitratul. The latter can be found in the depths of Sebilis. My aid to you, Derresh, and he, ends here.'

Vitratul K`Reil raises his chin ever so slightly as he clasps one of the black orbs into each of his hands. His azure eyes roll back into his skull as he utters an eerie chant. The pair of orbs pulse and radiate brilliantly in a blinding aura of unholy energies, their pulse in perfect tempo to the pounding of the necromancer's voice. As Vitratul's chant grows louder and swifter, he joins the orbs together, melding them into one solid, round object. When the chanting ceases, the necromancer returns his gaze to you and offers the strange pulsating shield. 'This is the reward for your discipline and the answer to your questions about true power.'
