Ayslare N`Vor says, 'Ah, Tatrinek's Curse! This shall indeed be sufficient to rend the magic from the shield.' The priestess closes her eyes and recites the curse, already imprinted into her memory from her brief exposure to its ancient and nearly illegible words. As she speaks, the shield's once radiant holy light fades beneath a deep indigo hue of unholy magic. The priestess then opens her eyes, a dark, sinister smile stretched across her face, and she offers you the corrupted shield, 'Wield it, child, for it is the Dark Father's power that has blessed this once holy item. You have earned its power.'
Receive: Shield of the Dark.
Your faction standing with Venril Sathir has been adjusted by 5
- Shield of the Dark
- Kunark Archaeologist player title suffix if first per server

# Ivyshae Family Blade

**Level:** 1 | **Maximum Level:** 130 | **Quest Type:** Quest | **Repeatable:** No | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 1
**Maximum Level:** 130
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** No
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Quest
**Group Size:** Solo

This is one of the finished Kunark quests added on the February 15, 2017, update.
Kaelana Ivyshae can be found on the north side of Firiona Vie standing amongst some houses, /waypoint +2691, -2875.
You say, 'Hail, Kaelana Ivyshae'
Kaelana Ivyshae says, 'Greetings, _____. I am Kaelana Ivyshae, ranger of Tunare and recent arrival to this fine outpost as one of the master blacksmiths. I was sent here by order and an obligation to my people, but I had my own more personal motivations for coming to these lands. Unfortunately, my duties here at the forge keep me much too occupied to begin [my search:What are you searching for?].'
You say, 'What are you searching for?'
Kaelana Ivyshae says, 'Many centuries ago, the iksar invaded Faydwer under the command of Rile Sathir. My ancestor, Elyrian Ivyshae, and his companions came to these lands to fight back. They called themselves the Righteous Order. Unfortunately, all but one of them perished here. Elyrian alone survived and returned to see his homeland again. However, his journal was left behind. Furthermore, I believe I know where it [can be found:Where can Elyrian's Journal be found?].'
You say, 'Where can Elyrian's Journal be found?'
Kaelana Ivyshae says, 'One of the pilgrims that came to us related an unusual story. She was in the forest and eavesdropped on a dark elf speaking to a goblin about a long-lost journal. She couldn't quite make out the name of the goblin, but thought that it rhymed with 'edge rule' or something similar. It's my believe that the goblin has the journal or knows where it is. You must find this goblin and ask him about the journal!'
The Goblin she is referring to is Dajrool Waggletongue, he can be found in Firiona Vie wandering around generally east of the Lake of Ill Omen zoneline.  NOTE: He is aggressive towards the Drachnids of the area and dies to them often but respawns quickly.
You say, 'Hail, Dajrool Waggletongue'
Dajrool Waggletongue squints his left eye and chatters his teeth before speaking sharply in a high pitched, scratchy voice, 'What? What do you waaaaant, Froglok?! Hrm? I clearly see that all you provide is bit of... Hrm... nausea from hiiiideous face and that... rrreeepulive stench wafting about you! Go away before you make me ill... though it may be too late.' Dajrool curls his lip and smacks his tongue as if having a foul taste in his mouth.
You say, 'what journal'
Dajrool Waggletongue chatters his teeth for a moment and then ***** his head, 'So what of it, Human? You want journal? Well... nothing in this world is given without payment. I tell you what, Human. You do [something for me:What can I do for you as payment?], yes? And I... I will give you journal.'
You say, 'What can I do for you as payment?'
Dajrool Waggletongue says, 'Aaah! Of course you will, if you want journal, Human. I ask only one thing... and that is that you bring me ornate bracer that sniffling, wretched sarnak... even more wretched and rrreeepulsive than you, Human, stole from me. You will find thieving, dragon-lizard where sarnak gather. I believe that... parents would call him Rusdai. Yes... Rusdai the thieving little whelp that took bracer. Go, Human. Bring me bracer and I give you journal... good as new.'
Dajrool wants an Ornate Steel Bracer which drops from Rusdai in Chardok.  Rusdai can spawn from any of the "a treasury guard" located near the banker.
Give Dajrool the Ornate Steel Bracer.
Dajrool Waggletongue gives a hoarse, throaty chuckle and stashes the bracer in his taut loincloth, 'Good! Good, Froglok. Now, I keep my side of bargain. Here is journal. Oh... yes, there is one more thing I conveniently did not mention and that is journal is incomplete. Imbecile whelps in Nurga thought they could kill me... but they failed! You have journal... but missing pages there in Nurga still. Consider information courtesy for fine job in getting bracer. If you kill Nurga whelps, then good. If not, then fine... but go now! I cannot stand Froglok stench anymore.'
You gain experience!
Receive: Torn Journal
The journal is incomplete and requires four lost pages in order to be whole again.  These are Elyrian's Journal page(s) 15, 17, 18, and 22.  All of which are found as a random drop off any mob inside of Mines of Nurga. Once you have have all four pages combine them inside the Torn Journal to create "Elyrian's Journal".
Return to Kaelana Ivyshae in Firiona Vie and give her the Elyrian's Journal
Kaelana Ivyshae smiles as she quickly inspects the journal, flipping through its ancient, brittle pages with care, 'Thank you, _____. I'm forever in your debt. Please, allow me to repay you. Take this Sigil. It was the one worn by my ancestor. I will [need your aid:I will aid you again.] further, my friend, so that I might repay you in the fullest.'
Your faction standing with Inhabitants of Firiona Vie has been adjusted by 10.
Your faction standing with Emerald Warriors has been adjusted by 7.
Your faction standing with Storm Guard has been adjusted by 7.
Your faction standing with Legion of Cabilis has been adjusted by -1.
Your faction standing with Pirates Of Gunthak has been adjusted by -1.
You gain experience!
Receive: Sigil of the Righteous
You say, 'I will aid you again.'
Kaelana Ivyshae says, 'There is an elf known as Iryal. At one time, my ancestor called him friend. They were allies in the Righteous Order, until Iryal's callous betrayal. Now, ironically, the traitor suffers eternally. You see, Iryal was once my ancestor's apprentice, but he betrayed him in the pursuit of eternal life. Little did Iryal realize the torture that awaited him at the other side of the [dark bargain:What dark bargain did Iryal make?]. I have faith that Iryal will aid us... if we show that he has been forgiven. I will need you to show him this forgiveness, as he will certainly kill any Ivyshae on sight.'
You say, 'What dark bargain did Iryal make?'
Kaelana Ivyshae says, 'There is one known as Tivnesh, an ancient undead iksar of great power. Some say he was one of Drussela's apprentices, from the days before Rile's uprising. He should pay for his crimes against the Righteous Order. Killing the iksar who gave Iryal unholy unlife and returning the Blood Agreement that binds them will give Iryal the proof of such forgiveness. Once you attain the Blood Agreement, return it along with the Sigil to Iryal. He should give you a blade that was forged by my ancestor's hand, though you must understand that it is now likely worn with age and its enchantments broken. I will need you to return to me some [further items:What further items do you need?] with the blade, and then you shall have your reward, my friend.'
You say, 'What further items do you need?'
Kaelana Ivyshae says, 'The enchantments of Iryal's blade will need to be restored. I know of only two items that can do this for they are of the original materials used when the blade was forged several centuries ago. Upon an ancient golem, one known as the Mist Reaver, you will find the ore that will repair the blade. In the depths of the ruined city built by Venril Sathir, a rare and unique vine grows -- the Dankglow Ivy. Return those components to me, along with the blade, and I will give you a fitting reward.'
You will need three more items to complete this quest. The first is The Blood Agreement which can be found on Tivnesh, a named skeleton which spawns in the eastern wing of Howling Stones.  The second is Ore of Solidified Mist which drops from Mist Reaver a named golem who spawns on the upper levels of City of Mist.  The final is Dankglow Ivy (note: NOT Dankglow Vine Sap) which is a random drop off any of the Myconid type mobs found in Old Sebilis.
Find Iyral in the far north of Firiona Vie hiding amongst some rocks. He does not respond to hails. Location 3550, 715.
Give Iryal the Sigil of the Righteous and The Blood Agreement
Iryal sighs as the curse melts away. He pauses, taking a moment to look at his now flesh-covered hands, 'You've... you've saved me. I was in so much agony. So much pain. I wish I could take back what I've done. The betrayal... my betrayal... will haunt me for all time. Please take this and tell the world that I am sorry. So sorry... for what I've done.'
You gain experience!
Receive: Ancient Blade
Return to Kaelana Ivyshae in Firiona Vie. Give her the Ancient Blade, Dankglow Ivy, and Ore of Solidified Mist.
Kaelana Ivyshae says, 'Well done, _____! The Great Mother was surely with you on this endeavor. I have repaired the old blade... and wish you to carry it. For you have aided a descendant of the Righteous Order, you should now wield our most sacred blades.'

Your faction standing with Legion of Cabilis has been adjusted by -1.
Your faction standing with Pirates Of Gunthak has been adjusted by -1.
You gain experience!

- Kunark Archaeologist player title suffix if first per server

# Mouth of the Dragon

**Level:** 1 | **Maximum Level:** 125 | **Quest Type:** Quest | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 1
**Maximum Level:** 125
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** Yes
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Quest
**Group Size:** Solo

Finlay Kitoran in The Overthere outpost gives out this quest. He's on Find (Ctrl+F).
(Need dialog to get the quest)
Quest Window Says: This isn't like any journey youv'e ever taken before. This time your on a serious mission to find the one they call Morticaldon. No one knows what it looks like or even if it really exists, but legend says a creature of sinister power roams the lands in search of prey once every hundred years. Its time the search started for this mythical creature and your the one who's going to be at the forefront. The search has already begun but there are plenty of places to search. You should explore the dragon mouth on the lava flow west of Veeshan's Peak, to start. Think you can handle that?
Explore the dragon's mouth on the lave flow west of Veeshan's Peak. 0/1 Skyfire Mountains
Task updates at approx 2321 3816 -105 next to Enrid Ebonclaw and 4 Servants of Peak. Text in window after update:
Don't worry about it too much, there are plenty of other places to explore, and there is no doubt in anyone's mind this creature is real but highly elusive. Why don't you take a torch and explore the Northeast Crater? That seems like the next best place to look for it.
Explore the northeast crater 0/1 Burning Woods
Task updates at approx 1760 -1716 -654 down in the crater. Text in window after update:
No luck there either but don't fret. There will be plenty of chances to find the beast before your time in Norrath is done. Go find and speak to Khieka Ripclaw just to let them know you have begun to search.
Speak with Khieka Ripclaw. 0/1 Frontier Mountains
Click on Khieka and task updates with text:
The search for Morticaldon won't end not as long as there are intrepid explorers like you are on the trail. With this type of creature you never know when or where you will find it but one thing is for sure - finding this creature will be the most rewarding experience you'll ever have. In the meantime here's payment for the time you spent searching.
Reward(s):
35pp 8g 8cp
Experience

# An Epic Retelling (Bard)

**Level:** 65 | **Maximum Level:** 125 | **Quest Type:** Quest | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 65
**Maximum Level:** 125
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** Yes
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Quest
**Group Size:** Solo
**Min. # of Players:** 1

This achievement is gained during a third run through the quest "An Epic Request". It is achieved by receiving a perfect or " more interesting" telling of the story. You will see Your flawless performance should make for a more interesting telling of this tale. at the end of the class specific portion if you completed the portion in such a way as to complete the achievement
Explore the Stage of Baladric's Symphony 0/1 (Dreadlands)
Task Window Says: Baldric Slezaf's tale is the pursuance of impossible beauty -- a symphony to rival the works of Ayonae Ro.
/loc 780, 9690, 1070 (valley with the portals -- in a pyramid near Baldric Slezaf).
The Event
(Event details needed: Names of mobs and any items involved; emotes; mechanics; instanced zones, if any.)
- Explore the Stage of Baladric's Symphony 0/1 (Dreadlands)
Baldric Slezaf says, 'A most gracious welcome to you _________! How quickly the days have passed since our last exchange. You're just in time. Today is the day we bring the Maestro's symphony to life! Come quickly, the band is due to arrive...'
A familiar hum emanates from the surrounding spires. It sounds as if the band has chosen an arcane mode of travel...
Baldric Slezaf says, 'I thank you all for being here today. We are blessed with the presence of Norrath's greatest virtuosos, I'm quite sure you all know _________. Most importantly, may the gods themselves be in awe of what will occur this day. This one's for you Ayonae...'
Baldric Slezaf nods and looks out over his orchestra as the musicians begin focusing intently on the grand task at hand. Baldric looks at you intently, a silent but understood agreement that your performance will be vital in the success of this gathering!
(The instruments he will ask you to equip are random, the order below is to show which message to which instrument.)
Take note that instrument foci on your armor does NOT count for this. you MUST use actual instruments for this section.
Baldric signals to you. The band needs more Strings! (use stringed instrument)
Baldric signals to you. The band needs more Woodwind!(use wind instrument)
Baldric signals to you. The band needs more Percussion!(Use percussion instrument)
Baldric signals to you. The band needs more Brass!(use brass instrument)
Upon a successful instrument call, you will see:
Baldric nods approvingly.
Baldric Slezaf says, 'Absolutely incredible, such beauty has no rival in the whole of history. I thank you personally for your help and insist you stay and listen to the second movement.'
Baldric Slezaf pauses and looks over the members of the orchestra before beginning the next movement. You feel compelled to stay and listen.
The slow solemn beauty of the orchestra's piece is broken by a deafening screech! The once serene sound quickly cuts into a focused dissonance! A wrathful creature swoops down from the sky.
Blackwings shouts, 'Disgusting creatures! The Ring of Scale has tolerated your existence for far too long!'
The performers remain stoic, entranced in the symphony. You are on your own to deal with this interference.
Targeted (NPC): Blackwings
Right click on the NPC to consider it.

You say, 'Hail, Ginjleg Gigglegibber'

Task text: Ginjleg Gigglegibber is a peculiar gigglegibber goblin. He is taking his annual vacation in Timorous Deep and likes to watch the boats sail by. He has one delivery to make this holiday season but doesn't want to cut his vacation short. He has asked that you make his delivery for him, so he has more time to indulge his hobby.

You say, 'Why would I lose them?'
Your task 'Case of the Misplaced Dollies' has been updated.

You say, 'What do you mean reconnected?'
Belumb, the Yeti says, 'Well, that should be really apparent. I am from up north and have [been doing] a bit of traveling.'
You say, 'You've been doing a bit of traveling?'
Belumb, the Yeti says, 'This is the best season for it. I don't really do well in the [warmer] months.'
You say, 'Yes. I can imagine someone with your coat wouldn't do well in a warmer climate.'
Belumb, the Yeti says, 'I do try to keep my [coat nice] and healthy. Having a fresh fish diet helps.'

You say, 'Hail, an Iksar prisoner'
An Iksar prisoner squints at you and gasps when he recognizes notoriety within Iksar society. He scrambles to his feet and says, 'Please, brother! Get me out of these chains so that I may escape back to Cabilis! They intend to coerce me like the others. A more tragic fate no Iksar should endure. I implore you to [help] me!'
You say, 'help'
An Iksar prisoner says, 'Well some of the brainwashed short ones seem to know much of mechanical devices and such. Perhaps they have a tool that can get me out of these chains. If they have anything that looks useful bring it to me. I'm sure your help will be rewarded once I reach Cabilis.'
During the Trooper Scale Bracer quest, you're supposed to kill the prisoner and loot a Traitor's Heart. If you decide instead to help the prisoner, then kill the coerced dwarves around until one of them drops a Serrated Wire [item=5962]. Hand the wire to the prisoner :
An Iksar prisoner takes the wire and quickly saws through the rusted shackles. He hands you an icon and says as he runs off, 'Show that to the Arch Duke in Cabilis! He will reward you. Now I'm off to escape!'
You gain experience!
You receive a Greenmist Icon [item=26994]. If you hand this icon to Arch Duke Xog [npc=4711] in East Cabilis :
Arch Duke Xog takes the icon and stares at it. His face twists into a look of disdain and he suddenly throws the icon off the balcony. It lands in the water some distance away. Without even a glance at you he says in disgust, 'You're an idiot, _____. You fit your profession well. Leave my sight.'

A frightened guardian startles at your voice, 'Oh, I done! Not fight. Not going back to [castle]!'
A frightened guardian says, 'You go, not me.' A low growl comes from its tightly closed teeth. 'Crazy sarnak. Screaming! Can't stay there.
You say, 'want'
A frightened guardian says, 'I can show you how to get in, if you [ready]!'
Karnor's Castle: Mad Emperor is now available to you.
You say, 'ready'
A frightened guardian says, 'Grrrrr...'
LOADING, PLEASE WAIT...
You have entered Karnor's Castle: Mad Emperor.
When you zone in, a frightened guardian is there with you.
A frightened guardian regards you indifferently -- You could probably win this fight. (Lvl: 40)
You say, 'Hail, a frightened guardian'
A frightened guardian says, 'I will not blame you if you would like to [leave].'
In the next room are red con MOB's of seemingly 2 types. They are all inactive until the you activate the event.
A sebilite golem scowls at you, ready to attack -- what would you like your tombstone to say? (Lvl: 125)
This creature would take an army to defeat!
You suspect that this being can see you.
An Imperial construct scowls at you, ready to attack -- what would you like your tombstone to say? (Lvl: 125)
This creature would take an army to defeat!
You suspect that this being can see you.
If you cross the room to the far side and go into a room back there, you will find A Kar`Zok maniac.
A Kar`Zok maniac scowls at you, ready to attack -- what would you like your tombstone to say? (Lvl: 125)
This creature would take an army to defeat!
You suspect that this being can see you.
You say, 'Hail, a Kar`Zok maniac'
A Kar`Zok maniac says, 'You are just in time to hear them scream! Their pain is glorious! Have you come to bathe in my [revenge]?'
You say, 'revenge'
A Kar`Zok maniac says, 'Come and I will show you what true revenge is!'
A Kar`Zok maniac says, 'I have been betrayed more times than I can count, but this, this will be the last. Never again will such a thing happen. Love and family are for fools and my brief time as a fool has passed! As I was reborn, so shall I return to what I was meant to be!'
(He walks off back towards the first room. You can follow to see the scripted sequence. As a note, A Kar`Zok maniac is holding a flask, which is mentioned in the emotes.)
A Kar`Zok maniac says, 'I can never die. Mine is a destiny of empire! We shall rise again! Norrath will once again chant my name! But first, I must satisfy my revenge.'
A Kar`Zok maniac says, 'Scream, you pathetic creature. You betrayed me! I must admit that I was a fool to let you, to fall for your plea to save our son at my own expense. In the end power holds the truth and my power is the strength of empires!'
Inarticulate screams come from the glowing flask. Even without understanding the words, you can understand the pain that scream represents. Hearing those sounds is horrific. It is hard to imagine how feeling their cause must feel.
A Kar`Zok maniac says, 'Good! Suffer!' The Kar'Zok focuses closely on the bottle, 'You betrayed me and would have cast me away. And I must admit that you would have succeeded if it were not for our son's first-hatched. It was Atrebe that gave me this body even as you stole mine for our worthless hatchling.'
The horrific screaming from the flask continues.
A Kar`Zok maniac says, 'I have been born, reborn, and recreated, and every time I have been Emperor, Emperor Venril Sathir! I have tolerated your interruption long enough. Begone!' There is a frighteningly unhinged look on the creature's face. 'Stay and I will submit your spirit to the same pain as my treacherous wife and useless son! But you are not the only one that needs to be punished. These soft-skinned creatures have been at the heart of all that has gone wrong with my empire and it is time to make them suffer as well!'
Venril Sathir roars with laughter, shaking the walls and calling forth wailing spirits to destroy his foes.
Powerful magic engulfs the massive sarnak. It morphs in an obviously painful manner, taking on a familiar shape.
Venril Sathir scowls at you, ready to attack -- what would you like your tombstone to say? (Lvl: 125)
This creature would take an army to defeat!
Venril Sathir then aggros. He can hit for at least 100K.

# 24th Anniversary: Footloose and Fancy Free

**Level:** 120 | **Maximum Level:** 125 | **Quest Type:** Task | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 120
**Maximum Level:** 125
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** Yes
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Task
**Group Size:** Solo

This 24th anniversary task can be obtained from Erol Xybella in Plane of Tranquility at /waypoint 367, -2109, -927 outside of the building on the dock where you zone into Plane of Fire. They are on the find tool CTRL F.
You say, 'Hail, Erol Xybella'
Erol Xybella blows air aggressively into the horn and shakes a few drops of spittle out before addressing you. 'Terribly sorry about that mate, didn't mean to splash you like that. If you'll excuse me, I desperately need to get my nerves under control before I forget how to play any instrument at this point.' He attempts to play the horn he is holding but only warped, spit-filled, off-key air comes out. 'Blast this thing and throw it into the deep!' he notices that you are still watching him. 'Hey friend, I'd hate to bother you over something so trivial but I'm in [dire straights] and need of some help.'
You say, 'I don't get money for nothing, how can I help?'
Erol Xybella takes the horn in his hands and extends them out, investigating it further while speaking, 'My friends and I were a traveling band of musicians who parted ways a few years ago after a falling out over some, lets say financial issues.  You probably heard of us, we played all over Norrath! If you're a fan of  "Team Good Guys", well you're now talking to the hornist of that group!' He waits for you to acknowledge having heard of them. An awkward amount of time passes as a cricket chirps nearby. With a defeated tone, he continues, 'Ok, well, we were underground so I don't blame you for not having heard of us. We were a real [motley crew] and without them, I'm afraid I have lost the spark that would ignite the flames in my soul.'
You say, 'What do you need to kickstart your heart?'
Erol Xybella perks up to your words. 'Are you a lyricist as well? I felt that, as you said it. It felt like a breath of air, some oxygen to help the fire!' He is getting more and more excited. You can see the look on his face light up as he continues. 'Yes! That feeling! That's what we need. I cannot live like this, I need to entertain! I need to tell the tales of heroes! I need...' his eyes grow wide with realization, 'To get the band back together. Before we start the arduous journey through water, [earth, wind, and fire] trying to locate my fellow bards, I need to fix my current problem of not being able to play this thing. It's a poor craftsman who blames his tools, but as an artist I refuse to take the blame on this. I need a new horn.'
You say, 'That's the way of the world, isn't it?'
, -
Erol Xybella pretends to know what you are talking about, 'Indeed it is, my friend. Last year, I gave myself the task to visit as many taverns across Norrath and hear as many tales as I could along the way. I love learning the tales of heroes and the looks on peoples faces when you tell those tales over a warm fire. That is when I heard about a legendary clarion. A heroic horn, if you will. One that creates a sound so [sublime] that the gods themselves are moved to tears, or so they say. I want you to find this instrument for me. I had been following it across Halas when I ran into a snag.'
You say, 'What happened?'
Erol Xybella says, 'One thing I can say about the barbarians of Halas, they can take a punch but sadly they cannot take a joke. Apparently they don't find it funny when you poke fun of their essential oils. Anyway, the locals did not care for my presence before I could investigate the well next to some tavern that shares the same name as a legendary champion. The name escapes me but I know the tavern had a famous stout that they like to serve. The well, however, is holding a secret. Don't ask me how I know because if I tell you, you will think me craven. Head to Halas and explore the bottom of that well. If I'm right, then [WHAM], we will be in business!''
You say, 'I'm your man! I mean  person.'
You have been assigned the task 'Footloose and Fancy Free'.
Erol Xybella says, 'This is going to rock! I just know it!'
You have been given a mission from the gods to get the band back together. Erol Xybella has asked you for help in finding his bandmates and convincing them to get together again. Erol has also asked you to look into finding a legendary musical instrument that he believes is somewhere in Norrath.
Erol has asked that you investigate the well outside of a tavern in Halas that specializes in it's "Dark Stout", begin your search for the horn there.
- 1. Locate the legendary horn 0/1 Halas
The well is located outside of Mcquaid's Dark Stout. /waypoint 189, -212, -1. Swim down to the bottom of the well and pick up the horn looking object. Horn of Crescendoing Legends [item=145665].
Your task 'Footloose and Fancy Free' has been updated.
- 2. Bring Erol the Horn of Crescendoing Legends 0/1 The Plane of Tranquility
You say, 'Hail, Erol Xybella'
Erol Xybella says, 'Bards are overpowered. I mean, think about it. We get to choose how you look when we tell your stories. That's like having the ultimate last word.'
You offered 1 Horn of Crescendoing Legends to Erol Xybella.
Your task 'Footloose and Fancy Free' has been updated.
Erol Xybella stares in absolute shock for a moment. The disbelief on his face will be etched into your mind's eye for years to come. 'I was right?!' he says quietly, but then yells in assurance, "I was right!" After moment of vindicated laughter washes over him, he begins to speak. 'You're probably wondering how I knew it was there? Well, simply put, I had a dream. The dream started with me trekking across a large desert where it rained but everything felt very dry. In the far distance i discovered an [oasis] and the closer I approached, sounds of angelic singing as well as the clanging of metal began to get louder and louder. It sounded like I was standing in the middle of a blacksmith's forge. I finally reached the water and when I went to quench my thirst, the sun got brighter and brighter and it got hotter and hotter until my lips turned blue and I fell over, frozen to death.'
You complete the trade with Erol Xybella.
You say, 'Sounds like halfway the world away.'
Erol Xybella says, 'Well, most make little sense but some can be prophetic. On a hunch, I pieced together that something was waiting for me in that well. When I went to investigate, I could hear that angelic singing and clanging again when I was near the well, but the locals wouldn't appreciate me just diving into their well. Especially after I wore out my welcome. Now that I know that I am not going mad, I can tell you that before we broke up, my other bandmates confided in each other that they too have had weird dreams hearing the same sounds. I implore you to locate my bandmates, Rhysl Dorbint, Gael Le Rhytid, and Llaydo Tamms. Rhysl is known to haunt the Fool's Gold in Rivervale, look for him and tell him "Erol found it." He will know what you mean.''
- 3. Tell Rhysl Dorbint that 'Erol found it' 0/1 Rivervale
Quest Text: The discovery of the instrument means that Erol was right about their existence. Now that he is united with the Horn of Crescendoing Legends, he begs you to find Rhysl Dorbint in Rivervale and help him find his instrument.
Rhysl Dorbint [npc=58773] is located at /waypoint -219, -77, -2 in southwest Rivervale not far from Uma Sweetcookie. He's on Find (Ctrl+F).
You say, 'Hail, Rhysl Dorbint'
Rhysl Dorbint is whistling a tune as you greet him. 'I have this song in my head but I can't get it out. Maybe I should go back to the Fool's Gold for another pint. Who says Rivervale beer isn't as good as Kaladim's brew? Hogwash I say!'
You say, 'Erol found it'
Your task 'Footloose and Fancy Free' has been updated.
Rhysl Dorbint looks up from his glass and glares directly into your eyes. A deep, low voice grumbles, 'You're joking. You have to be. I refuse to believe you.' He takes a sip from the glass and collects his thoughts before continuing. 'You know that's what broke up the band in the first place right? Erol likes to tell people it was money problems but really it was because he cursed us with these-' he grows agitated, spitting as he says, 'Visions or whatever you want to call them. I bet he told you that we each also have had to deal with this same [madness]. Constant incessant clanging with singing that, at first, you think sounds pleasant. That's only pleasant for the first hour or two, after that it's a waking nightmare.'
You say, 'I didn't take you for a bed and breakfast man.'
Rhysl Dorbint looks around at his surroundings, giving a small defeated sigh. 'Normally, I would like to be at a place that is more accommodating for someone my size. Gods know that I have several bruises on my head because of it. However, I came here because this is where the music is the quietest. I can think if not but for a moment before I hear it again. My plan was to gather up some provisions and take a [journey] to Firiona Vie. That is where the music was the loudest. If you want to save my sanity, could you search around Firiona Vie? I'm at my wits end and my only respite is to give in to what Erol has told us. Finding this will help quell the noise, and I can go back to living in peace.
You say, 'Any way you want it!'
Rhysl Dorbint says, 'Thank you! I heard the sounds the closer I got to the shores. That may be where you want to start looking. You won't be able to hear the sounds, but a keen eye will be able to locate something that isn't supposed to be there.'
- 4. Locate the legendary flute 0/1 Firiona Vie
Quest Text: Rhysl has stated that he hears the same angelic noises and clanging as Erol and that is has driven him insane. He asked that you investigate the shores of Firiona Vie for an instrument, as that is where he said the noise was the loudest for him.
The Flute of Everlasting Gallantry [item=145666] is in the water on the ground outside the main city near northwest wall at /waypoint -2836, 3361, -146.
- 5. Deliver the Flute of Everlasting Gallantry to Rhysl 0/1 Rivervale
Hand Rhysl in Rivervale the Flute of Everlasting Gallantry.
You offered 1 Flute of Everlasting Gallantry to Rhysl Dorbint.
Your task 'Footloose and Fancy Free' has been updated.
Rhysl Dorbint clasps his hands around his ears as you approach. He looks like he is overwhelmed by the sound that only he can hear. You hand him the flute and a sense of calmness washes over him. He relaxes his shoulders and after wiping a small tear from his eye he says, 'Thank you. Thank you adventurer! It's quiet, the noise stopped. It seems we are destined to find these instruments. I hope the other bandmates are not losing their minds like I have been. Please adventurer, you need to find Gael Le Rhytid, she was our string instrument expert. She is incredibly talented and you can probably find her in her home in the treetops of Kelethin.'
You complete the trade with Rhysl Dorbint.
- 6. Speak with Gael Le Rhytid in Kelethin 0/1 The Greater Faydark
Gael Le Rhytid [npc=58793] is up on the far northwest platform in the city in Greater Faydark at /waypoint 973, 509, 119. She's on Find (Ctrl+F).
Hail her for the update.
You say, 'Hail, Gael Le Rhytid'
Your task 'Footloose and Fancy Free' has been updated.
Gael Le Rhytid is banging on a drum as you approach. There is a bucket in front of her with a small amount of silver and copper pieces. You suspect that this is supposed to be music but it just sounds like noise to you. 'Oh, another adventurer, could you spare a few coin for a musician down on her luck?' The drum she is using looks much like the other instruments that you have delivered. However, the music coming from it is off beat and truth be told, actually annoys you. You feel that paying anything would be an insult to rhythm itself, and you don't want to encourage her to keep going. 'Well then, are you going to keep gawking like some [daft punk], or are you going to help?'
You say, 'Are you sure that you are doin' it right?'
Gael Le Rhytid gives a glare that could burn a hole through Luclin, first the moon and then the God. She lets out a sigh of defeat before speaking. 'I suppose you are right, this thing isn't really my jam. This is more of an instrument for Llaydo Tamms than for me. He just made it look so easy that I thought I could try my hand at drums. This is much harder than it looks. I'm more of a luthier myself, but I had lost my favorite lute to the [pixies] when I was practicing out in the forest to the north. I must have been unknowingly in their territory and they felt threatened. If you really wanted help a lady out, could you find my barbat? I'm sure one of the pixies has it in their possession.'
You say, 'It's all I think about now.'
Gael Le Rhytid perks up when you agree, 'Really!? I've been asking the guards to help retrieve it for me but none of them seem too keen into kicking the hornet's nest just for me. I'll wait here for your triumphant return!'
- 7. Find Gael's lute amongst the pixies of Greater Faydark 0/1 The Greater Faydark
Quest Text: Gael said that she was in the forest and playing her instrument when she was attacked by pixies. "Convince" one to give up the instrument.
a pixie trickster [npc=25954] drops the Barbat of Unrelenting Chivalry [item=145667], they are roaming around the zone usually in the southwest to south part of the zone around the path between Butcherblock and Lesser Faydark. Bring a tracker if you want to speed this up.
- 8. Return the Barbat of Unrelenting Chivarly to Gael 0/1 The Greater Faydark
You offered 1 Barbat of Unrelenting Chivalry to Gael Le Rhytid.
You have been given: Drum of Legendary Unison [item=145668]
Your task 'Footloose and Fancy Free' has been updated.
Gael Le Rhytid's smile widens as you hand her the lute. You can almost see the breath of life fill into her. She looks as if she has been reunited with a long-lost friend. She speaks with a cracked voice, overwhelmed with emotion. 'I can't believe I have you back, my old friend.' she says, clearly speaking to the lute. Gael takes a moment to adjust the tuning knobs but is surprised to find that it is perfectly in tune. 'Ok, let's see if I can work out [the kinks].
You say, 'I could listen to this all day and all of the night.'
Gael Le Rhytid plucks at the strings so fast that you could swear that the noises coming out were from four hands instead of two. The sound is so beautiful that you feel a wide breadth of emotions, even though she's clearly just jamming out on her own. She finishes with a flourish and she leaves you stunned with her performance. She speaks up again, breaking her spell, 'Well you did it, you got me back into the band. Erol went a little mad trying to figure out the source of the sounds him and the others where hearing, but I never heard them. This barbat has been handed down in my family for generations. Turns out I was the only one who knew how to play it. That means that I owe that tone [deaf leopard] an apology.
You say, 'Let it go.'
Gael Le Rhytid sighs as she looks at the drum, 'Well, I'm guessing this will be his then. I actually found it when I was visiting the Hollowshade Moors on Luclin. Llaydo Tamms has always had a soft spot for West Freeport. Perhaps head there and see if you can find him in one of the taverns. Bring him the drum. I wouldn't suggest trying to play it, it seems that it will not play correctly for anybody who isn't who the instrument was meant for.'
- 9. Bring Bring Llaydo Tamms the Drum of Legendary Unison 0/1 West Freeport the Drum of Legendary Unison 0/1 West Freeport
Quest Text: Gael has given you a drum to return to Llaydo Tamms, a Vah Shir who frequents West Freeport. You may be able to find him in a tavern. Bring him the Drum of Legendary Unison.
Llaydo Tamms is inside Tassel's Tavern to the left at the entrance. He's on Find (Ctrl+F).
/waypoint -158, -435, -88
You say, 'Hail, Llaydo Tamms'
Llaydo Tamms raises his pointer finger on his right hand to protest whatever it is you are about to say, even though you haven't said anything.  His attention is interrupted as he stares at the tip of his finger. His eyes are crossed because of how close his finger is. He stretches out his arm, still staring at his finger, and moves it back and forth, trying to focus on the tip of his finger. He then moves the finger back to in front of his face, crossing his eyes again. He flicks his finger forward and drunkenly says, 'Heyo!' as if he figured out what it was he was doing. He waves you away.
You offered 1 Drum of Legendary Unison to Llaydo Tamms.
Llaydo Tamms is clearly deep in his cups as you approach him. He can barely function. As you hand him the drum, he takes it and immediately flips it and holds it close to his chest. He looks pale, as if he's about to get sick. Before your eyes, he perks up just a bit, some color returns to his skin as he burps through his words. 'Erol found them huh? and this one is mine?' He uncomfortably lets out a wet burp before continuing. 'Tell him I'm in.' He flips the drum and secures it to his belt before passing out. Erol would like to hear that the instruments have been returned.
- 10. Catch up with Erol 0/1 Plane of Tranquility
You say, 'Hail, Erol Xybella'
Erol Xybella is pleased to see you. 'Ah! Adventurer! I have received word from the others that they have gotten their instruments and we are ready to get the band back together! All of your hard work has come to this point!' He pauses to let the moment pass before continuing. 'Now I get to ask you for your work yet again. Our band is missing something, it needs a voice. We never had a vocalist and now seems like a good time to find one. I have spoken to several candidates and have narrowed down to one. She has been skeptical to join but [the doors] for recruiting her are closing as we speak.
You say, 'People are strange.'
Erol Xybella says, 'You said it, not me. I need you to speak with her, she is waiting for you in the Plane of Knowledge. Her name is just "Adaha." No surname, that's how you can tell she's a real artist! I beg you adventurer, please convince her to join us.'
- 11. Find "Adaha" in the Plane of Knowledge 0/1 The Plane of Knowledge
Adaha [npc=58795] is at /waypoint 428, -90, -156 right in front of the Nexus stone. She's on Find (Ctrl+F).
You say, 'Hail, Adaha'
Adaha swishes the hair from across the front of her face, placing it behind her ear. Your eyes catch hers and you get lost for just a moment in them. She addresses you, 'Oh, you must be the associate that Erol was talking about. I have done much thinking on this subject and wanted to be clear. I want to join their group, it sounds like a lot of fun! However, I fear that because I am not as worldly travelled, that I may not be of much help for song writing. I would love to sing about the achievements and heroic endeavors of others, but my head feels like a [limp biscuit].'
You say, 'Do you want me to take a look around?'
Adaha smiles as you suggest searching the Plane of Knowledge. 'See! That's exactly why I was here. I was hoping to find a book of heroic deeds or tales that could inspire my song writing. I understood that there was a building here where fellowships are formed. I wanted to start my searching there, as it seems like a good place to keep a record of heroes and their deeds. You are an expert on heroics, can you locate a book I could use? I have never been to this plane before and am very lost. Tell me, does the music ever stop? What is with this clanging?'
- 12. Locate a book of epic deeds 0/1 Plane of Knowledge
This step updates near the bookcase on the east wall inside of the building for fellowships at /waypoint 419, -7, -156.
You are given: Epic Tales of Heroism [item=145669]
Bonus Item: Music Box: Ballad of Legends [item=145691]: Hand in the Epic Tales of Heroism to The Great Hero Ezra [npc=58831] in the Plane of Knowledge at /waypoint 341, 90, -156 outside of the same building near where you pick up the book.
You say, 'Hail, The Great Hero Ezra'
The Great Hero Ezra says, 'The bards will sing of you someday, much like they sing of me today!'
You offered 1 Epic Tales of Heroism to The Great Hero Ezra.
The Great Hero Ezra quickly snatches the book out of your hands, 'A fan! Who should I make this out to?' She opens the book without you giving an answer. She flips through a few pages before she gets a sour look across her face. 'Who are these people? Why don't people understand that your boring life should not be put to paper. Live an adventurous life! Learn new things! At least try to be a hero!' She pulls out a quill, flips to the last page and autographs it with a flourish. 'The only reason anybody would hand me a book is to sign it. Here, you can have it back.'
You are given: Autographed Epic Tales of Heroism
- 13. Give Adaha "Epic Tales of Heroism" 0/1 Plane of Knowledge
You say, 'Hail, Adaha'
Adaha is looking around, searching the horizon, 'Where to start...Where to start...'
You offered 1 Epic Tales of Heroism to Adaha.  (Autographed Epic Tales of Heroism works also)
When handing in "Autographed Epic Tales of Heroism", you are given: Music Box: Ballad of Legends
Adaha takes the book from you. As soon as she takes the book, she begins to look around as if something had changed, 'Oh, the music stopped. I wonder what that was all about. Whatever they were making must be completed because I no longer hear that clanging.' She takes a moment to flip through the pages, her eyes light up and her mouth widens into a smile. 'This is it! Yes! I can use this! Thank you adventurer. Tell Erol that 'Adaha is in', I will meet up with him later.' She is distracted by the book again. 'Oh this is some good stuff!' She gets lost in the pages, completely oblivious to you standing there. It would be best to let her work.
- 14. Return to Erol and let him know that "Adaha is in" 0/1 The Plane of Tranquility
You say, 'Adaha is in'
Your task 'Footloose and Fancy Free' has been updated.
You hope that someday, bards will sing of your epic tales. Who knows? Maybe you will end up in a book of heroic deeds!
You receive 5 silver .
You receive 2 gold .
You receive 2 platinum .
You received 10 Commemorative Coins.
Erol Xybella has been eagerly waiting for your return. As you tell him about Adaha, he yells, 'Woo!', claps his hands loudly and begins to dance a strange little dance before speaking. 'Finally! All this work for this moment. Thank you adventurer. You where a real inspiration to everything that we do here! I hope we cross paths again someday. By then, we might be heroic adventurers ourselves!'
Reward(s):
2pp 2g 5s
10 Commemorative CoinsSubmitted by: GidonoRewards:
- Commemorative Coin [item=116720]
- Music Box: Ballad of Legends [item=145691]

# Champion's Festival: Qeynos Champions' Tale

**Level:** 1 | **Maximum Level:** 125 | **Quest Type:** Quest | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 1
**Maximum Level:** 125
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** Yes
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Quest
**Group Size:** Solo

This task is available during the Champion's Festival event runs starting November 3rd through November 14th.
You can obtain this task from Balhalyne Treherth [npc=59623] in Qeynos Hills at /way +325,-1104,-4 in the southeast part of the zone up against the wall next to a hut. She is on the Find tool (Ctrl+F).
You say, 'Hail, Balhalyne Treherth'
Balhalyne Treherth says, 'The Festival of Champions is here. I have been waiting all year for this. I have been looking forward to the tales of champions. I have been writing a few tales of my own. Like a version of Norrath that is different than our own, and how [that world would] be different.'
You say, 'That world would be different.'
Balhalyne Treherth says, 'I imagine a world where the moon has been ripped apart and put back together. I would dig in that rubble and look for long-forgotten artifacts. I would find swords of unknown origin and study them. Wouldn't that be so much [fun]?'
You say, 'That does sound like fun.'
Balhalyne Treherth says, 'Oh, to spend time dreaming and writing down stories to share. Too bad that I have so many [chores] to work on. '
You say, 'What chores do you have left to do?'
Balhalyne Treherth says, 'Great. Here is the list. I will see you when you get back. '
You have been assigned the task 'Qeynos Champions' Tale'.
- 1. Harvest Shadeweaver Tubers 0/5 Shadeweaver's Thicket
Head to Shadeweaver's Thicket and harvest some tubers.
These are ground spawns (Shadeweaver Tubers) that look like blue collectibles and are at the base of trees. These do respawn in the same areas.
Some locations include:
/waypoint -234, -1698, -164
/waypoint -620, -1444, -206
/waypoint 765, -2042, -188
/waypoint 1521, 1994, 269
/waypoint 149, -1932, -182
- 2. Harvest Warsliks Carrots 0/5 The Warsliks Woods
These are ground spawns (Warsliks Carrots) that look like blue collectibles and are at the base of trees and rocks. Due to the amount of trees in the zone, these can be difficult to spot. These do respawn in the same areas.
Some locations include:
/waypoint -508, -183, -114
/waypoint -222, -462, 8
/waypoint -824, -315, 93
/way/point 74, -812, -18
/waypoint 920, -533, -89
- 3. Harvest Highpass Kelp 0/4 Highpass Hold
These are ground spawns (Highpass Kelp) that look like blue collectibles and are located underwater and are very easy to spot. They do respawn in the same areas.
Some locations include:
/waypoint -252, 569, -50
/waypoint -111, 528, -49
/waypoint -224, 354, -47
/waypoint -202, 436, -47
/waypoint -536, 346, -86
/waypoint -668, 419, -84
- 4. Harvest Shardwurm Meat 0/5 The Great Divide
These (rarely) drop off shardwurms outside the caves (mostly to the south).
- 5. Harvest Innovation Mushrooms 0/5 The Plane of Innovation
These are ground spawns (Innovation Mushrooms) that can be found near see invis mobs around the zone. You may need to clear the area around them before you can get near enough to loot.
Some locations include:
/waypoint 456, 450, -50
/waypoint 631, 497, -50
/waypoint 882, 643, -49
/waypoint 843, 844, -49i
/waypoint 1073, 923, -50
/waypoint 1349, 1064, -49
/waypoint 1574, 933, -50
- 6. Deliver the Shadweaver Tubers                                                   0/5  Qeynos Hills
- 7. Deliver the Warsliks Carrots                                                  0/5  Qeynos  Hills
- 8. Deliver the Highpass Kelp                                                     0/5  Qeynos  Hills

# 25th Anniversary: Chasing What's Not Real

**Level:** 100 | **Maximum Level:** 130 | **Quest Type:** Task | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 100
**Maximum Level:** 130
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** Yes
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Task
**Group Size:** Solo

This is the starting task of the 25th Anniversary. You can obtain it from Alta the Frightened in Crescent Reach. She is on the Find tool (Ctrl-F).
/waypoint -1165, -1474, -55
You say, 'Hail, Alta the Frightened'
Alta the Frightened says, 'No, no... they feel all [wrong].'
You say, 'What is wrong?'
Alta the Frightened says, 'The baby dragons. They are everywhere, but they are also... [not here]. Their nonexistent presence is an affront to our great Mother Veeshan.'
You say, 'What do you mean not here?'
Alta the Frightened says, 'Exactly that! Other things about it are off as well. Colors. Voices. Things are wrong! I swear it. It wasn't just me, there was [another].'
You say, 'Another who saw the baby dragons?'
Alta the Frightened says, 'He preceded the not-dragons, yet spoke endlessly of them. It is probably why he was in Crescent Reach. To [find them]...'
You say, ''Find them'? But there a lot of dragons here already.'
Alta the Frightened says, 'He muttered something about the gnolls, that maybe the gnolls were shown them.' His eyes widen. 'Shown them! Shown them as I have been shown them. The gnolls may know more! It is all wrong... Will you [look for him]?'
You say, 'I can look for him.'
You have been assigned the task 'Chasing What's Not Real'.
Alta the Frightened says, 'Thank you! Thank you, thank you, thank you...'
Visions of dragons, baby dragons, have been spotted. A fearful Drakkin has requested your assistance in unreaveling this mystery.
Alta stated a gentleman was muttering about dragons, and that perhaps the gnolls were shown his vision.
1. Seek a clue among the gnolls - 0/1 - ALL
This step was very vague and took me just blind luck clicking on objects on the ground in areas where gnolls are near where the baby dragons are at which I found in Blackburrow.
In Blackburrow at /waypoint +80, -193 in one of the little cubby areas on the way to Everfrost peaks there is a small hatchet on the ground. Loot it. They respawn quickly.
This axe was discarded quickly, and touching it pushes an echo through your mind: A swing. The axe failed to meet its target, yet there was no fault in the aim. Another swing, another failed connection. Did the blade pass through the small dragon? Beside the axe is a small twig of Luclin-daylight origin, yet not wild. Cultivated, perhaps? What an odd find.
Your task 'Chasing What's Not Real' has been updated.
2. Seek a clue among Luclin's daytime flora - 0/1 - ALL
Quest Text: The axe found in Blackburrow provided the following echo:
A swing. The axe failed to meet its target, yet there was no fault in the aim. Another swing, another failed connection. Did the blade pass through the small dragon? Besides the axe is a small twig of Luclin-daylight origin, yet not wild. Cultivated, perhaps? What an off find.
Another vague step. This is found in Sanctus Seru in an area where there is a walk way with some bushes and some guards in the northwest part of the zone, you'll see a baby dragon. The plant you are looking for is the smallest out of the all in the southeast corner of that area at /waypoint +441, +564, +60. The plant looks like it has blue flowers in it and almost blends into the grass.
Click on it to receive the update.
This bush is out of place compared to the others, its colors counter the uniform appearance of the rest of the Sanctus Seru park. Touching the bush sends another echo, reverberating: Was he intoxicated, or was it just the visions of dragons? This bush, its colorful branches would make an absolutely glorious bouquet. Branches? In a bouquet? It shall be offered to the dragons. The bloody wine cork beneath the bush seems out of place for Sanctus Seru. Where would someone serve wine like blood?
Your task 'Chasing What's Not Real' has been updated.
3. Seek a clue where wine like blood may flow - 0/1 - ALL
Quest Text: The mismatched bush in Sanctus Seru provided the following echo:
Was he intoxicated, or was it just the visions of dragons? This bush, its colorful branches would make an absolutely glorious bouquet. Branches? In a bouquet? It shall be offered to the dragons. The bloody wine cork beneath the bush seems out of place for Sanctus Seru. Where would someone serve wine like blood?
This step is in Dreadspire Keep at /waypoint +3486, +4, +102 in the dining room on a big table. It's a bottle of wine.
The deep red color of this wine makes it difficult to determine if the wine is of the vine or of the vein. It doesn't appear to be the only one present at this dinner party, a popular vintage amongst its mixed company of living and not-so-living. Yet, it too holds an echo, far more faint than the others: Dragons? In Mayong's own Norrathian stronghold? Babies, how mad! It's time to get ready for a dinner party.
Mistmoore Hostess says, 'Oh, that's not for YOU, silly. That was saved for our friend. Our friend. Our friend. Our friend with the dragons. Why did he have dragons?' She suddenly gets very angry, eyes alight with madness. 'Dragons aren't allowed here!'
Mistmoore Hostess says, 'Dragons, dragons, dragorn, dragorn. The friend was going to pay them for something. One gold coin for... dragons? Dragons. Our friend. Into the bloooooooodfields.'
Your task 'Chasing What's Not Real' has been updated.
4. Seek a clue in the Bloodfields - 0/1 - The Bloodfields
Quest Text: The blood wine in Mayong's Dreadspire Keep provided the following echo:
'Dragons, dragons, dragorn, dragorn. The friend was going to pay them for something. One gold coin for... dragons? Dragons. Out friend. Into the blooooooodfields.'
This is found in the Omens of War zone, The Bloodfields. You'll see the baby dragon going back and forth. What you're looking for is a gold coin ground spawn on the top of a wall near a spire portion in the middle of the zone. Not the top bridge you port in on. Go to /waypoint +611, -150, -824 .
This coin isn't Kuuan in nature, but rather Norrathian. Not only that, but general issue, albeit old. Why is it discarded, and here of all places? Yet touching the coin brings forth another echo: He thought maybe, just maybe, with large enough spires, someone might be able to teleport to more dragons. Yet even some of the largest spires have driven men like Greig crazy. Perhaps the great spires of Luclin have answers.
Your task 'Chasing What's Not Real' has been updated.
5. Seek a clue among the great spires of Luclin - 0/1 - ALL
Quest Text: The Norrathian gold coin in the Kuuan Bloodfields provided the following echo:
He thought maybe, just maybe, with large enough spires, someone might be able to teleport to more dragons. Yet even some of the largest spires have driven men like Greig crazy. Perhaps the great spires of Luclin have answers.
This step updates in Mons Letalis on top of the platform in the south portion. You'll see a baby dragon there. Nearby is a box you click on at /waypoint +21, +523, +204 .
These spires did not survive the attempts made to return to teleport prior. An echo rings through a specific fragment on the ground: Confusion. The man found nothing but confusion. If not one stone, then another. If not a confused robed man, then a confused Taelosian. Is this all a GAME to you?
Your task 'Chasing What's Not Real' has been updated.
6. Seek a clue with a confused Taelosian - 0/1 - ALL
This step updates in "Riwwi, Coliseum of Games", in the north part of the zone in the tunnels and in the northwest corner. There is a jail cell and a rock in it at /waypoint +757, +204, -35 . Click on it.
Iniba the Confused says, 'I am not the dragon. I am not the white robed man. Maybe the Heroes preceded the dragons? Did Veeshan seed them that way? He seeks wings of his own creation. A child's tailoring plan will send him to the sky, or crashing to the waters of the Free Port.'
Your task 'Chasing What's Not Real' has been updated.
7. Seek a clue where one might tailor in Freeport - 0/1 - East Freeport
Quest Text: The Stone of Confusion within the coliseum of Riwwi on Taelosia provided the following echo:
'I am not the dragon. I am not the white robed man. Maybe the Heroes preceded the dragons? Did Veeshan seed them that way? He seeks wings of his own creation. A child's tailoring plan will send him to the sky, or crashing to the waters of the Free Port.'
This step updates in East Freeport at the tailoring shop "Leather and Hide", owned by the Tanners, at /waypoint -340, +9, +9 . The scroll is hidden behind a box up against the wall. It's not in plain sight. Click on it.
The tailoring pattern for dragon-like wings looks like it could have been a valid option, but there's no leather materials on Norrath that would safely keep anyone aloft, not even a small light gnome. The pattern holds an echo of something that came before: Imbued. It should be imbued! Large dragon scales would never do, but smaller ones... The largescale dragon death in certain areas of Kunark should have something deep within ancient tunnels.
Your task 'Chasing What's Not Real' has been updated.
8. Seek a clue within the tunnels of Kunark - 0/1 - ALL
Quest Text: The tailoring pattern for dragon's wings found within Eastern Freeport provided the following echo:
Imbued. It should be imbued! Large dragon scales would never do, but smaller ones... The largescale dragon death in certain areas of Kunark should have something deep within ancient tunnels.
This step updates in the Field of Bone. The location is on the west side of this zone, in an underground area. You'll see a bowl laying on the ground near an altar at /waypoint +430, +2951, -79 . Click on it.
The basket might have at one point held dragon scales, yet it has been emptied recently. Someone got to it before you could. The man in the white robe? Touching the basket relays an echo: The moon. The silvery moon. Drinal calls in the silence of a divided Shar Vahl. A letter left in haste in an empty room, never reaching its destination.
Your task 'Chasing What's Not Real' has been updated.
9. Seek a clue within an empty room in Shar Vahl, Divided - 0/1 - Shar Vahl, Divided
Quest Text: The empty basket of dragon scales, found in the Field of Bone on Kunark, provided the following echo:
The moon. The silvery moon. Drinal calls in the silence of a divided Shar Vahl. A letter left in haste in an empty room, never reaching its destination.
Head to "Shar Vahl, Divided" (ToL), to /waypoint -335, +472, -159 . You're looking for a scroll on the table that has one chair in the far southwest building in the city up on the second floor in the west room. The scroll is an actual item this time, so it will go into your inventory. Right-click it while you're in "Shar Vahl, Divided", it won't work it you click it in other zones.
You receive Leave of Absence.
This paper looks to be from a Drinal adherent begging for a leave of absence from their priestly duties to find the source of all dragons. The echo appears trapped within the page. Taking it to Alta might shed some answers.
Your task 'Chasing What's Not Real' has been updated.
You begin casting Examine Clue.
10. Take the latest clue to Alta - 0/1 - Crescent Reach
Quest Text: The Leave of Absence left by Drinal adherant contains an echo, but it is trapped within its confines. Taking it to Alta might shed some answers.
Give Alta the Frightened the Leave of Absence. She returns it to you.
You offered 1 Leave of Absence to Alta the Frightened.
You have been given: Leave of Absence
Your task 'Chasing What's Not Real' has been updated.
Alta the Frightened says, 'This... this pointed you back here? Here, really? Drinal is not known to have any attachment to dragons or our Mother Veeshan, so I don't understand. Take this letter to the empty meeting room off the training area. It seems to point there of all places. I'd do it, but... I have seen too much already.'
You complete the trade with Alta the Frightened.
11. Examine the clue within the empty meeting room - 0/1 - Crescent Reach
Quest Text: Take the Leave of Absence to the meeting room just off the training area within Crescent Reach. It should unlock the echo.
This step is still in Crescent Reach. Move to /waypoint -1417, -883, +35 , which is on the second floor in far southwest big room. Stand in the middle and right click the Leave of Absence scroll.
A man in a white robe and a bunch of baby dragons spawns and walks away. He disappears and the step updates.
You begin casting Examine Clue.
One... two... five... So many visions of baby dragons converge upon you.
A vision of a white robed man, wielding a scythe, walks away and his laughter won't stop. It keeps going. It keeps ringing through. Laughter, dragons, laughter, dragons, it is madness.
Madness.
Madness.
Madness.
Madness until it is gone, like a blink, and you are left with the Combine sigil of Tsaph Katta in your mind.
Your task 'Chasing What's Not Real' has been updated.
12. Seek out and speak with the white robed man - 0/1 - ALL
Quest Text:
Madness.
Madness.
Madness until it was gone. Visions of baby dragons and a human man in white fades only in the Combine sigil of Tsaph Katta. Find the man in the white robe.
This step updates in Katta Castellum at /waypoint -302, +151, +69 in the big building behind the hedges. You're looking for Ghrald McMannus, who is on the second floor of that building in one of the south rooms. He is on the find tool (Ctrl-F). Hail him.
You say, 'Hail, Ghrald McMannus'
Ghrald McMannus furrows his brow as he turns his attention from Gaius towards the adventurer. 'You're here about the [visions] of dragons, yes?'
You say, 'What are the visions?'
Ghrald McMannus says, 'My friend here, Gaius, is the originator of those insistent visions. The man has always been obsessed with dragons, but I thought it a rather healthy obsession, if there ever is one. Now... he is summoning them into being, and by seeing them before him, he's feeding his visions further. Gaius [doesn't know] he's doing it.'
You say, 'He doesn't know? What's going on?'
Ghrald McMannus says, 'I fear it's brought on by [the gods] themselves.'
You say, 'The gods? Really?'
Your task 'Chasing What's Not Real' has been updated.
Ghrald McMannus, friend of Gaius Lucianus who is facing and distributing these visions of dragons through his obsession, appreciates you finding them and has requested your help. Perhaps you both can get to the bottom of what is going on with Gaius.
You receive 5 silver .
You receive 2 gold .
You receive 2 platinum .
You received 10 Commemorative Coins.
Ghrald McMannus says, 'It has all the markings of interference by the gods: the sudden onset of symptoms, the potency of the visions, and the fact they are sticking around when my friend is no illusionist. However, the deity source is unknown. Let me think for a moment; I might have some ideas and need some help from you.'
This leads to the next task, Chasing Madness [quest=12897], obtained by hailing Ghrald McMannus again.
- 2 platinum, 2 gold, 5 silver
- 10 Commemorative Coins [item=116720]
Submitted by: Gidono ; Revamped by iventheassassinRewards:
- Commemorative Coin [item=116720]

Tides of Time Overview.
This is the 8th task in August 2024 of the Year of Darkpaw Tower tasks on the 8th level.
It starts with the collection looking item on the floor near the door, loot it and right click the Broken Key of Fire.

# Erollisi Day: Only Fools Fall In

**Level:** 1 | **Maximum Level:** 130 | **Quest Type:** Task | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 1
**Maximum Level:** 130
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** Yes
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Task
**Group Size:** Solo

This Erollisi Day task starts with Darenne K`Reil [npc=60448] in The Overthere (the original Kunark zone) at /way 2634, 1889, -48 outside the city against the east wall.
You say, 'Hail, Darenne K`Reil'
Darenne K`Reil  sighs, 'Greetings, ______. If you are looking for Erollisi Day treats, I am all out. Someone stole all my new treats for the holiday before they were [done].'
You say, 'What do you mean not done?'
Darenne K`Reil says, 'I was testing new recipes, and they weren't quite right yet. The cookies and brownies were still cooling when they went missing. And I was still adjusting the amount of magic to lime juice in the punch. Who knows what kind of [side effects] they will have.'
You say, 'Side effects? That sounds dangerous.'
Darenne K`Reil says, 'Yes, well I might know who took them if you are [interested] in getting them for me?'
You say, 'I am interested.'
You have been assigned the task 'Only Fools Fall In'.
Darenne K`Reil wants to know who has been stealing her Erollisi Day treats before they have really set. She thinks that Muku Wolfeetz, Toxon Frennor and Lithxn are the thieves. Befriend them and learn if they stole the missing treats.
Speak with Darenne about what has ruined her Erollisi Day Celebration.
- 1. Talk with Darenne about her missing treats 0/1 The Overthere
You say, 'Hail, Darenne K`Reil'
Darenne K`Reil says, 'Those fools hanging out over there keep pestering me for new goodies. I told them that they weren't ready yet, but they were so impatient. I chased them off, but I have a feeling they are still hanging around. Could you check with them and see if you can get the unready treats [back]?'
You say, 'I will get them back.'
Your task 'Only Fools Fall In' has been updated.
Befriend Lithxn and return the missing treat.
Befriend Toxon Frennor and return the missing treat.
Befriend Muku Wolfeetz and return the missing treat.
- 2. Return the stolen Frisky Fudge Brownie 0/1 The Overthere
Lithxn (an Iksar) gives you "I Think I Love You" and rewards you with the Frisky Fudge Brownie
Give the Frisky Fudge Brownie to Darenne K`Reil
You offered 1 Frisky Fudge Brownie to Darenne K`Reil.
Your task 'Only Fools Fall In' has been updated.
Darenne K`Reil says, 'Thank you, _____. That's one of them. '
- 3. Return the stolen Nut Your Day Cookie 0/1 The Overthere
Toxon Frennor (a gnome) gives you the quest "Crazy Little Thing" and will give you the Nut Your Day Cookie
Give the Nut Your Day Cookie to Darenne K`Reil
You offered 1 Nut Your Day Cookie to Darenne K`Reil.
Your task 'Only Fools Fall In' has been updated.
Darenne K`Reil says, 'Thank you, _____. That's one of them. '
- 4. Return the stolen Squeezed Glee 0/1 The Overthere
Muku Wolfeetz (an ogre) asks you to do the quest "Lures Hurt", which rewards you with the Squeezed Glee
Give the Squeezed Glee to Darenne K`Reil
You offered 1 Squeezed Glee to Darenne K`Reil.
Your task 'Only Fools Fall In' has been updated.
Darenne K`Reil says, 'Thank you, _____. That's one of them. '
- 5. Check in with Darenne to see if that's all the missing treats 0/1 The Overthere
You say, 'Hail, Darenne K`Reil'
Your task 'Only Fools Fall In' has been updated.
You have recovered Darenne K`Reil's half-baked Erollisi Day treats and saved some misinformed lovestuck fool from making a mess of the celebration.

# Erollisi Day: Lures Hurt

**Level:** 1 | **Maximum Level:** 125 | **Quest Type:** Task | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 1
**Maximum Level:** 125
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** Yes
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Task
**Group Size:** Solo

This Erollisi Day task starts with Muku Wolfeetz [npc=60445] in The Overthere (old Kunark zone) at /way -3075, 1932, -48 outside the city walls on the east side.
(Note: Before starting, make sure you have a fishing pole, you will need for a later step).
You say, 'Hail, Muku Wolfeetz'
Muku Wolfeetz says, 'Hail, _____. The day is long, and the night is too [short]. '
You say, 'Are you calling me short?'
Muku Wolfeetz says, 'Nay, _____. I hate handling my [tasks] in the day, and don't have enough time in the night.  '
You say, 'What tasks are you working on?'
Muku Wolfeetz says, 'I am working on a secret project and am still collecting all of the [supplies] I need.'
You say, 'I could collect the supplies you need.'
Muku Wolfeetz says, 'Why would you want to [help me]? I am not going to reward a Wood Elf. And I am not telling you what I am working on.  '
You say, 'Don't  think of it as me helping you. Think of it as you helping me.'
You have been assigned the task 'Lures Hurt'.
Muku Wolfeetz says, 'Fine, go collect some bones for me and then we can talk some more. '
Muku Wolfeetz isn't sure about trusting you. You will need to work on getting his trust before you can ask him about Darenne's missing treats. He has a few tasks that he is willing to have you do for him.
Head east along the shore and search for an iksar skeleton's bones.
- 1. Head east past the wreck 0/1 The Overthere
This is a location update at /way 3188.33, -1790.69, -24.38 which is straight east of the city.
Once you get the location update an iksar skeleton spawns and attacks.
- 2. Kill the iksar skeleton 0/1 The Overthere
Kill it. You get Iksar Tailbone [item=151173] on your cursor.
- 3. Return to Muku and talk to him 0/1 The Overthere
You say, 'Hail, Muku Wolfeetz'
Muku Wolfeetz says, 'Hail, ______. Did you get that [iksar tailbone]?'
You say, 'Yes. I have a iksar tailbone. Why did you want this thing?'
Muku Wolfeetz says, 'Well, now. I'm not sure why I would want to tell you that. A guy must have some [secrets].'
You say, ' What kind of secrets?'
Muku Wolfeetz says, 'It is the season of love, and no one ever said what type of love. Maybe I want to do something [nice] for a friend.'
You say, 'That does sound nice. Did you need anything else for that friend?'
Muku Wolfeetz says, 'Hrrm. I do need a part from an [sarnak skeleton].'
You say, 'I can get a part from an sarnak skeleton'
Your task 'Lures Hurt' has been updated.
Muku Wolfeetz says, 'Head a bit south from where you found the first skeleton. There you should be able to find the next. '
- 4. Head south from where you found the skeleton 0/1 The Overthere
This is a location update at /way 1932, -1657, -42. There is a sarnak skeleton near a boulder at this location. It will attack you, kill it. It drops Sarnak Voicebox [item=151174], loot it.
- 5. Return to Muku and hail 0/1 The Overthere
You say, 'Hail, Muku Wolfeetz'
Your task 'Lures Hurt' has been updated.
Muku Wolfeetz says, 'Good to see you again _____. I was worried that I would have to go [save] you. '
You say, ' There is no need to save me. Since we are friends now, do you know anything about Darenne missing treats or who took them?'
Your task 'Lures Hurt' has been updated.
Muku Wolfeetz says, 'I heard about that, I am not sure who took them, but I was given one as a gift. You help me [finish] my gift and I will give you the one I have. '
You say, 'I can help you finish, but I want to know who gave it to you.'
Muku Wolfeetz says, 'Ha. We aren't that good of friends. Once you find the last two items you can go ahead and can make the lure. I can't wait to see your craftmanship. '
- 6. Fish up a cockatrice claw 0/1 The Overthere
Fish along the shore, doesn't matter where along the shore. Catch a Cockatrice Claw [item=151175], don't spill your beer in the process.
....sigh, you spilled your beer didn't you?
- 7. Collect beach grass 0/1 The Overthere
Bunch of Beach Grass [item=151176] looks like a purple collectible on the ground near /way 3556, 1559, 127. Loot it.
- 8. Craft the Totem of Love and Ocean 0/1 ALL
The Cockatrice Claw is a container. Place the Tailbone, Voicebox and the Bunch of Beach Grass inside the claw and combine to make the Totem of Love and Ocean [item=151177].
- 9. Deliver the Totem of Love and Ocean 0/1 The Overthere
Return to Muku and give him the totem. Squeezed Glee [item=151172] (needed for Only Fools Fall In [quest=13292]) will appear on your cursor.
You offered 1 Totem of Love and Ocean to Muku Wolfeetz.
You have been given: Squeezed Glee

# Cabilis Guild Summons: Shaman

**Level:** 1 | **Maximum Level:** 130 | **Quest Type:** Quest | **Repeatable:** No | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 1
**Maximum Level:** 130
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** No
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Quest
**Group Size:** Solo

When your new character enters Norrath for the first time, you might receive this message:
As your reptilian eyes adjust to the darkness of the room, an imposing Iksar turns towards you, addressing you with a sharp hiss. 'I am Prime Hierophant Vek. The time has come young one. You have chosen the path of the Shaman. Open your inventory and read the note within. Once you are ready to begin your training, hand the note to me and we will continue.'
Your new character spawns with a "Guild Summons" in its inventory. Right-clicking this item opens a window showing the following text:
By the will of the Hierophants of Cabilis, you are hereby summoned to the spired crimson towers of the Temple of Terror. You have reached the age of rebirth and it is time for you to begin your teachings of the ancients and learn the ways of the shaman. You shall offer this summons to Prime Hierophant Vek and be welcomed. We await your arrival.
Prime Hierophant Vek is located inside the Temple of Terror in Cabilis East at /waypoint ??? . He stands in front in front of your new character when it enters Norrath for the first time.
Upon giving him the Guild Summons:
Prime Hierophant Vek says 'Welcome, young petitioner. You have been summoned to this temple to join with the Scaled Mystics. Ours is the way of pain and suffering. Here is the weapon of a petitioner. Through you the power of our ancestors shall flow. As your wisdom grows, so shall your power. Someday you may be a vessel for the supreme might of the ancients. Seek knowldege with Oxyn, he is here to help you. Return to me when you have become more experienced in our art, I will be able to further instruct you on how to progress through your early ranks, as well as in some of the various [trades] you will have available to you.'
Your faction standing with Scaled Mystics got better.
Your faction standing with Legion of Cabilis got better.
You gain experience!!
You receive ???.
You say, 'what trades?'
Prime Hierophant Vek says 'I thought you might be one who was interested in the various different trades, but which one would suit you? Ahh, alas, it would be better to let you decide for yourself, perhaps you would even like to master them all! That would be quite a feat. Well, lets not get ahead of ourselves, here, take this book. When you have finished reading it, ask me for the [second book], and I shall give it to you. Inside them you will find the most basic recipes for each trade. These recipes are typically used as a base for more advanced crafting, for instance, if you wished to be a smith, one would need to find some ore and smelt it into something usable. Good luck!'
You receive Tradeskill Basics Vol. I.
You say, 'what second book?'
Prime Hierophant Vek says 'Here is the second volume of the book you requested, may it serve you well!'
You receive Tradeskill Basics Vol. II.
