# 27th Anniversary: #2 - Melic Memoirs

**Level:** 40 | **Maximum Level:** 130 | **Quest Type:** Task | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 40
**Maximum Level:** 130
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** Yes
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Task
**Group Size:** Solo

Jharin Kevva is located in Toxxulia Forest. She is on find (CTRL-F).
You say, 'Hail, Jharin Kevva'
Jharin Kevva gives little attention to Jeffroex. 'Leave me. I have [important things] to attend to.'
Missing dialogue
You receive Jharin Kevva's Signet.
1. Take Jharin Kevva's Signet to Pastseeker Rhondarra in New Tanaan 0/1 - The Plane of Knowledge
Pastseeker Rhondarra is located on the 4th floor of the Great Library in The Plane of Knowledge. /waypoint +120, +1056, +98
You say, 'Hail, Pastseeker Rhondarra'
Pastseeker Rhondarra says, 'Welcome, traveler! I have come to New Tanaan seeking knowledge of my ancestors that has not before been revealed to me by the spirits. I have found a couple of books that tell of the predecessors to the Vah Shir. You may borrow the books if you like, they will be returned by the magic of New Tanaan when you are through with them.'
Hand her Jharin Kevva's Signet.
Pastseeker Rhondarra says, 'So, Kevva's doing more homework, is he? And sending an adventurer on his errands.' The soft chuckle rumbles through her throat like a purr, the familiarity between the two Vah Shir apparent in her teasing amusement. 'Well, how can I help the two of you? Do you [need] a book from this great Library?'
You complete the trade with Pastseeker Rhondarra.
2. Speak with Rhondarra about Kevva's request 0/1 - The Plane of Knowledge
You say, 'I need a story. An epic tale.'
Pastseeker Rhondarra says, 'There are thousands upon thousands of epic stories along these shelves. That is: unless you need [something] so old it's new.'
You say, 'That something is right.'
Pastseeker Rhondarra smiles a sharp, toothy smile, her eyes twinkling. 'Typical Kevva. It looks like I'm running you on some errands as well, then. I've business to handle here at the Library, but I know just the people to seek down to grow your collection of epic tales.' She pulls out a stylus from her pocket and a spare scrap of paper, commenting as she scribbles down names and generic locales, 'Talk to them. Ask them for their stories. Note down whatever you can. Our friend Kevva, and the whole of New Tanaan here, will both greatly appreciate your work in this.'
You receive Jharin's Pack.
3. Find Lenik Gemborn 0/1 - Crystal Caverns
Before you move to him, kill mobs near the zone-in until you find and pre-loot a Ry`Gorr Toolbelt.
--You have looted a Ry`Gorr Toolbelt from a Ry`Gorr watchman's corpse.--
You receive Ry`Gorr Toolbelt.
Lenik Gemborn is on find (CTRL-F). /waypoint -221, +187, -382
You say, 'Hail, Lenik Gemborn'
Lenik Gemborn says, 'Hello, and I hope you are well this fine day.'
You say, 'Tell me your story'
Lenik Gemborn says, 'Huh? Why me?' The Coldain dwarf seems genuinely confused. 'Historian Baenek is the one who holds our city's [knowledge]. Turn around, head down the ramp, and it's just a good few strides to his room from there.'
You say, 'I don't just want knowledge, but an epic tale of an equally epic adventure.'
Lenik Gemborn pauses with a furrow of his brow as he assesses Jeffroex. 'Bards are persistent, I can tell you that. Fine... Fine!' The Coldain lets out a puffed breath in exasperation. 'Your friend wins. But I need some payment. Get me a Ry`Gorr Toolbelt; I've no need for bloodied pieces of flesh, and mining picks are a silver a dozen. I just want proof of clearing a few out.
4. Fulfill Lenik Gemborn's request 0/1 - Crystal Caverns
If you haven't pre-looted the toolbelt already, kill orcs in the mines until you find a Ry`Gorr Toolbelt.
Missing dialogue
Lenik Gemborn says, 'Let me know if your bard friend finds it a worthy telling. I still think you should have gone to Baenek instead...'
You offered 1 Ry`Gorr Toolbelt to Lenik Gemborn.
Lenik Gemborn grips the Ry`Gorr Toolbelt in his hand, his stiff fingers crushing the hardy leather. 'Sorry. That was theraputic.' He tosses the toolbelt behind him, and the sound of heavy metal and leather slamming into the cold stone wall reverberates. 'If you want context... talk to Historian Baenek, because he has held onto our legacy more than any one man should.' He passes a few papers, written in fine text, towards Jeffroex. 'My story. I'd been gathering it for more than a few years... If you wanted an epic tale, you came to the wrong dwarf, but I can tell you that I hold the blood of [Glight].'
You complete the trade with Lenik Gemborn.
You receive Lenik's Story.
Missing dialogue for the trigger phrase "Glight".
5. Find Brinaghan the Reposed 0/1 - The Estate of Unrest
Before you move to her, pluck and pre-loot four white flowers (Sorrow of the Tranquil) from the garden and the hedge maze. They are quick respawning ground spawns.
/waypoint +335, -47, +4 ; /waypoint  +324, -144, +4
/waypoint +385, -257, +4 ; /waypoint  +345, -77, +4
You receive Sorrow of the Tranquil.
You receive Sorrow of the Tranquil.
You receive Sorrow of the Tranquil.
You receive Sorrow of the Tranquil.
Brinaghan the Reposed is at the end of the basement. She is on find (CTRL-F).
/waypoint +464, +62, -34
You say, 'Hail, Brinaghan the Reposed'
Brinaghan the Reposed says, 'Go back. You... shouldn't be here...'
You say, 'Tell me your story'
Your task 'Melic Memoirs' has been updated.
Brinaghan the Reposed says, 'I... don't have an... epic... story. Wrong place. Wrong time. Nothing [more]'
You say, 'I think there is more to it.'
Brinaghan the Reposed exhales a breath that comes out choked from lungs that don't truly function. 'Did... [Quellious] send you?'
You say, 'No, it wasn't Quellious.'
Brinaghan the Reposed says, 'It's a... shame. Priest, then?... [Bard]?...'
You say, 'Yes, a bard sent me.'
Brinaghan the Reposed says, 'Ha. Ha... ha.' Her laugh seems oddly genuine but an unfamiliar expression for her. 'Story time, then. Bring me... a few flowers... Sorrow of Quellious. Sorrow... Only blooms here,
above, since... Since...'
6. Fulfill Brinaghan the Reposed's request 0/4 - Estate of Unrest
